recalls.name: 2018 Schwinn Abbott Adult Men's Full Suspension Mountain Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The downtube on the bicycles can crack, posing a fall hazard
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the recalled bicycles and contact Pacific Cycle to receive a free replacement bicycle
recalls.description: This recall involves Schwinn Abbott Adult Men's Full Suspension Mountain Bicycles. The bicycles are black with green, yellow and blue accent colors on the downtubes. The bicycles were sold with 29 inch tires.
recalls.image: https://www.cpsc.gov/s3fs-public/2018 Schwinn Abbott Adult Men’s Full Suspension Mountain bicycle.png
recalls.injuries: Pacific Cycle has received 37 reports of cracks in the bike's downtube. One injury has been reported, involving cuts and abrasions.

recalls.title: Yvolve Sports Recalls Electric Skateboards Due to to Fall Hazard; New Instructions and Warning Labels Provided
recalls.name: Neon one wheel electric skateboards
recalls.hazard: The tire on the skateboard can deflate, posing a fall hazard to the user.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the skateboards immediately and contact Yvolve Sports to receive a new permanent warning label and updated instructions on how to properly inflate the tire. New instructions can also be obtained through the firm's website at https://www.neonlyghts.com/pub/media/manuals/Neon_Nitro_8_IM.pdf
recalls.description: This recall involves the Neon Nitro 8, a self-balancing, single-wheeled, battery-powered, electric skateboard from Yvolve Sports under the Neon brand.
recalls.image: https://www.cpsc.gov/s3fs-public/Neon Nitro 8 one wheel electric skateboard (top view)_0.png
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 128 reports of flat tires. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Canyon Recalls Mountain Bikes Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Mountain bikes
recalls.hazard: The chainstays can crack, which can lead to failure of the chainstay, rear wheel detachment and loss of control, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled mountain bikes and contact Canyon to receive free replacement and installation of chainstays. Canyon is contacting all known purchasers directly.
recalls.description: This recall involves model year 2018 Canyon Spectral full-suspension mountain bikes with aluminum chainstays. The bicycle's chainstays are the aluminum tubes that run from the bottom bracket to the axle of the rear wheel.
recalls.injuries: The firm is aware of 20 chainstays cracking which could lead to failures. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Spiraledge Recalls Yoga Backless Chairs Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Everyday Yoga Backless Yoga Chairs and Everyday Yoga Tall Backless Yoga Chairs
recalls.hazard: The chairs can break at the seat or back welded support rod connecting the back legs of the chair, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled yoga chairs and contact Spiraledge to receive a full refund of the purchase price in the form of a store gift card. Spiraledge is contacting purchasers of the yoga chairs directly.
recalls.units: About 12,400 (in addition, about 120 were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: This recall involves the Everyday Yoga Backless Yoga Chairs and Everyday Yoga Tall Backless Yoga Chairs. Both are metal folding chairs primarily used for restorative yoga, with a welded support rod on the rear legs (none in the front) and no back support.
recalls.injuries: Spiraledge has received three reports of the chairs breaking, including one minor injury reported.

recalls.title: Marker Recalls Kingpin Ski Bindings Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Kingpin 10 and Kingpin 13 alpine touring ski bindings
recalls.hazard: The steel pins in the toe unit can break and reduce the release force of the binding, causing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these bindings and return them to a Marker authorized retailer to obtain a free replacement toe unit. Consumers should bring their boots to be sure their bindings are adjusted correctly.
recalls.units: About 4,100 (in addition, about 2,200 were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: This recall involve s 2017-2018 Kingpin models 10 and 13 ski binding, with a black body and gold or copper accent coloring. The bindings are used with alpine touring ski boots with metal pintech inserts in the toe of each boot.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Yamaha Recalls Golf Cars, Personal Transportation and Specialty Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Yamaha golf cars, personal transportation and specialty vehicles
recalls.hazard: The accelerator pedal return spring can break, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled vehicles and contact a Yamaha golf car dealer to schedule a free repair. Yamaha is contacting all registered owners directly.
recalls.description: This recall involves the following model year 2016 through 2018 gas and electric-powered golf cars, personal transportation and specialty vehicles. The vehicles were sold in various colors including blue, green, red, white, tan and silver.
recalls.injuries: Yamaha has received 417 reports of incidents involving spring failures. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Clean Republic Recalls Hill Topper Electric Bike Motor Controllers Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
recalls.name: Hill Topper Electric Bike motor controller circuit board
recalls.hazard: Water can enter the motor controller and cause it to accelerate on its own, posing a crash and injury hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled motor controller circuit boards and kits and contact the firm for a free replacement motor controller circuit board.
recalls.description: This recall involves Hill Topper Electric Bike Kits with motor controller circuit boards used to convert regular bicycles to electric bicycles. The motor controller circuit boards, 24V/250W and 36V/350W, were sold separately as well as part of the kits.
recalls.image: https://www.cpsc.gov/s3fs-public/Recalled Hill Topper electric bike kit_0.JPG
recalls.injuries: The firm has received six reports of a rider losing control of his bike when the motor accelerated without rider input, including one reported injury resulting…

recalls.title: BMC Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Timemachine 01 bicycles
recalls.hazard: Variations in tire dimension, tire pressure, head set play and ride load, can result in insufficient space between the front wheel and downtube, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the recalled bikes and contact their local BMC authorized dealer for a free inspection and, if needed, a free replacement fork. Until the replacement forks are available in September/October 2018, the firm is providing consumers with a free 23C replacement tire, if needed, to ensure adequate clearance.
recalls.description: This recall involves all model year 2017 and 2018 Timemachine 01 bicycles and model year 2018 Timemachine 01 framesets. The product is a road bike for triathlons and time trials. BMC is printed on the downtube.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received four reports of fall incidents in the U.S., including one report of a broken finger.

recalls.title: Additional Incidents Prompt Johnson Health Tech to Reannounce Recall of Matrix Fitness Ascent Trainers and Ellipticals Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Ascent Trainer® by Matrix and Matrix fitness elliptical
recalls.hazard: Moisture from user perspiration or cleaning liquids can build up in the power socket on the unit, causing a short circuit, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Exercise facilities should immediately unplug the machines and contact Johnson Health Tech North America to schedule a free repair. Machines can be used in self-powered mode without needing to be plugged into an electrical outlet. Johnson is contacting purchasers of the recalled ellipticals directly
recalls.units: About 3,000 (The trainers and ellipticals were previously recalled in January 2014.)
recalls.description: This recall involves previously recalled Matrix Fitness Ascent trainers® and Elliptical trainers installed from November 2011 through December 2012.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 11 additional reports of sparking, smoking, "shorting out," and/or melting at the power cord and socket. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Trek Recalls Bontrager Line Pro Bicycle Pedals Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bontrager Line Pro flat bicycle pedals
recalls.hazard: The spindle of one or both of the pedals can break, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycle pedals and take them to a Trek retailer for a free repair.
recalls.units: About 9,630 pairs (in addition, 600 pairs were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: This recall involves all Bontrager Line Pro flat bicycle pedals. These aluminum pedals come in orange and black. "Line Pro" and "Bontrager" are printed on the body of the pedal.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received five reports of broken spindles in the bicycle pedals. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Jimmy Hack Golf Recalls Golf Swing Trainers Due to Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Orange Whip golf swing trainers
recalls.hazard: The orange ball can detach from the trainer while in use, posing an injury hazard to the user and bystanders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled golf swing trainers and contact Jimmy Hack Golf to receive a free replacement product.
recalls.description: This recall involves the Orange Whip golf swing trainer models OWT and OWM. The recalled trainers have a black grip and flexible shaft with a weighted orange ball attached to it.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 36 reports of the ball detaching from the trainer. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Burton Recalls Snowboard Boots Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Snowboard boots
recalls.hazard: The boots can release from the binding unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard to the user.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled snowboard boots and contact Burton to receive a free new heel cleat. Burton is contacting all known purchasers directly.
recalls.description: This recall involves Step On snowboard boots from the winter 2017-2019 seasons. The recalled boots were sold in a variety of colors. The model name is printed on the inside of the boot tongue.
recalls.injuries: Burton has received seven reports of the boots releasing from the binding unexpectedly. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Camso Recalls Dirt to Snow Bike Conversion Kits Due to Crash and Impact Hazards
recalls.name: Camso dirt to snow bike conversion kits
recalls.hazard: The bolts on the brakes can loosen, posing a crash or impact hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bikes with the recalled conversion kits and contact an authorized Camso dealer for a free repair.
recalls.units: About 480 (In addition, 430 were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: This recall involves model year 2018 Camso DTS 129 and Yeti Snow MX kits that are used to convert off road motorcycles or dirt bikes to track and ski vehicles.
recalls.injuries: Camso has received two reports involving the DTS 129 brake disc bolts loosening and seven reports involving the Yeti Snow MX brake disc bolts loosening.

recalls.title: Helmets R Us Recalls Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Rollerblade® helmets
recalls.hazard: The helmets fail to meet the federal safety standard, posing a risk of head injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled helmets and contact Helmets R Us to receive a free replacement helmet. Helmets R Us is contacting all known purchasers directly.
recalls.description: This recall involves Rollerblade-branded Helmets R Us helmets, used in schools' physical education programs. The recalled helmets are white and Rollerblade is printed on the side in black. They were manufactured from September 2011 through April 2017.
recalls.image: https://www.cpsc.gov/s3fs-public/Recalled rollerblade-branded Helmets R Us helmets.JPG
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: IKEA Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: SLADDA bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle belt can break, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and return them to any IKEA store for a full refund.
recalls.units: About 4,900 (In addition, about 200 were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: This recall involves IKEA 26 inch and 28 inch SLADDA bicycles. The recalled bicycles are a light grey and have an aluminum frame. IKEA is printed at the bottom of the seat tube near the crank.
recalls.injuries: None reported in the U.S.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles with Stout Cranks Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
recalls.name: Specialized bicycles with Stout cranks
recalls.hazard: The driveside crankarm can disengage and cause the rider to lose control, posing fall and injury hazards.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles with Stout cranks and contact an Authorized Specialized Retailer for instructions on how to receive a free replacement crankarm.
recalls.description: This recall involves Specialized Fuse Comp and Fatboy SE bicycles with Stout cranks. The bikes come in Gloss Hyper/Black Clean and Satin Gloss Black/Rocket Red for Fuse Comp and Gloss Warm Charcoal/Black/Gallardo Orange and Satin Oak Green/Blac/Rocket Red for…
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Group Rossignol Recalls LOOK Pivot Ski Bindings Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: LOOK Pivot Ski Bindings
recalls.hazard: The heel piece on the ski binding can come loose, posing a fall hazard to the skier.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled ski bindings and contact LOOK to arrange for a free inspection and replacement.
recalls.units: About 6,900 (In addition, 590 were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: This recall involves 2017-2018 model year LOOK Pivot brand ski bindings. The heel piece can loosen and allow the boot to detach from the ski. The LOOK Pivot ski bindings were sold in black, white and yellow.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Octane Fitness Recalls Cross Trainers Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Octane Fitness XT-One elliptical cross trainers
recalls.hazard: The incline lead screw can shear off, causing the foot pedals to drop unexpectedly, resulting in a fall hazard to the user.
recalls.remedy: Gym and Fitness Center operators should immediately stop using these recalled cross trainers and contact Octane Fitness LLC for repair instructions. The firm is contacting all known purchasers of the recalled cross trainers directly.
recalls.description: This recall involves the Octane Fitness XT- One elliptical cross trainer. "Octane Fitness" is printed on the rear of the keypad and the side of the cross trainer. The cross trainers measure 33 inches by 99 inches.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received seven reports of the foot pedal dropping unexpectedly, including one report of a scrape to the knee or leg area.

recalls.title: Louis Garneau Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
recalls.name: Bicycle helmets
recalls.hazard: The bicycle helmets do not comply with the impact requirements of the federal safety standard for bicycle helmets, posing a risk of head injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled helmets and contact Louis Garneau for instructions on how to receive a free replacement helmet.
recalls.units: About 650 in the U.S. (In addition, about 550 were sold in Canada.)
recalls.description: This recall involves Louis Garneau Course Helmets with model number LG1261 printed on the inside of the helmet. "Garneau," "Course" and "LG" are printed on both sides of the recalled bicycle helmets. They were sold in matte black and matte fluo yellow.
recalls.image: https://www.cpsc.gov/s3fs-public/Recalled Louis Garneau Course Helmet in matte black.png
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Allen Sports Recalls Folding Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: UltraX and Ultra1 Folding Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bike's frame can break during use causing the bicycle to collapse, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and email Allen Sports at customerservice@allensportsusa.com with photo of the bicycle to receive full refund instructions.
recalls.description: This recall involves Allen Sports model Ultra1 and UltraX carbon fiber folding bicycles. "ULTRA X" or "ULTRA ONE" are printed on the bicycle's frame. Both bicycles were sold in black, have 20 speeds and wheel sizes of 451MM.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received two reports of the frame breaking causing the rider to fall. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Monster Moto Recalls Mini Bikes Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Monster Moto Classic 212cc mini bikes
recalls.hazard: The fuel tank venting system can leak, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the mini bikes and contact Monster Moto for a free repair kit or to arrange a free repair at an authorized repair center.
recalls.description: This recall involves model "MM-B212" off-road mini bikes. The recalled bikes have a black powder-coated, gusset-reinforced, welded tube steel frame.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 38 reports of gasoline leaks. No injuries or fires have been reported.

recalls.title: Yamaha Recalls Golf Cars and Personal Transportation Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Yamaha Golf Cars and Personal Transportation Vehicles (PTVs)
recalls.hazard: The brake cables on the golf cars and PTVs can fail, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these recalled Golf Cars and PTVs and contact a local Yamaha Golf Car dealer to schedule a free repair. Yamaha is contacting all registered owners directly.
recalls.description: This recall involves the following model year 2015 through 2018 gas and electric-powered golf cars , PTVs and utility vehicles. The vehicles were sold in various colors including blue, green, red, white, tan and silver.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 285 reports of brake cables failing. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The fork on the bicycle can break and cause the rider to lose control, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact an Authorized Specialized Retailer for instructions on how to receive a free installation of a new fork.
recalls.units: About 5,550 in the U.S. (In addition, about 390 were sold in Canada and 260 in Mexico.)
recalls.description: This recall involves all model year 2018 Specialized Allez (Base), Allez Sport, and Allez Elite road racing bicycles. The recalled bicycles have an alloy frame and composite fork.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received one report of cracking in the fork. No crashes or injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Rocky Mountain Bicycles Recall Mountain Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Mountain bicycles
recalls.hazard: The brake cable housing was not secured properly during manufacturing, which can cause brake failure, posing a crash hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bicycles immediately and contact an authorized Rocky Mountain dealer for free inspection and free repair.
recalls.units: About 1,300 (in addition, 1,800 were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: This recall involves all model year 2018 Altitude, Instinct and Pipeline mountain bicycles. The carbon fiber and aluminum bicycles were sold in different colors. The model name is printed on a sticker on the top tube of the bicycles.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Brompton Bicycle Recalls Bicycles Due To Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Folding Brompton bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's bottom bracket can break during use, posing a fall hazard.

recalls.injuries: Camso has received 17 reports involving the DTS 129 brake systems not functioning correctly. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: SRAM Recalls Bicycle Brakes Due to Crash and Injury Hazards

recalls.title: Pro-Tec Recalls Multisport Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury

recalls.title: Smith Recalls Ski and Snowboard Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury

recalls.description: This recall involves 5-Point Camlock harness belts intended for use on off-highway vehicles. The belts have part numbers 53001B, 53007B and 53009B.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Superpedestrian Recalls Electric Bicycle Conversion Wheels Due to Fall and Crash Hazards (Recall Alert)

recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Advanced Composites Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)

recalls.injuries: The firm has received three reports of the belay device's handle over-rotating and braking malfunction. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Pulse Performance Products Recalls Krusher Scooters Due to Fall Hazard

recalls.title: VanMoof Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall and Impact Hazards

recalls.description: This recall involves VanMoof B-Series and S-Series commuter-style bicycles manufactured between 2014 and 2016. All S series bikes have a grey anodized frame and all B series bikes have a white powder coated frame.
recalls.image: https://www.cpsc.gov/s3fs-public/VanMoof1 B-series city bicycles 3 speed diamond frame with integrated lock.jpg
recalls.injuries: The firm has received two reports of riders injured when road objects created an obstruction between the bike fender and the front wheel.

recalls.title: Chromag Bicycle Stems Recalled by Riser Holdings Due to Fall and Injury Hazards

recalls.title: Look Cycle Recalls Aerostems and Road Bikes Due to Fall, Crash Hazards

recalls.title: Haibike Recalls Electric Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard

recalls.title: S.R. Smith Recalls Helix Pool Slides Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Helix pool slides

recalls.title: Pulse Performance Recalls Children's Electric Scooters Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target

recalls.title: Boosted Recalls Electric Skateboards Due to Fire Hazard

recalls.title: Specialized Recalls Road Bicycles Due to Injury Hazard

recalls.title: Glion Electric Scooters Recalled by Probity Cell Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)

recalls.title: Advanced Sports International Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard

recalls.title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls Commuter Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard

recalls.title: URBAN626 Recalls Electric Scooters Due to Fall Hazard

recalls.name: Rocky Mountain Bicycles

recalls.title: Black Diamond Recalls Camming Climbing Devices Due to Fall Hazard

recalls.title: Black Diamond Recalls Climbing Ascenders Due to Fall Hazard

Instructions for inspection are also available at https://warranty.bdel.com/IndexRecall/Landing. Only those ascenders having an unformed rivet need to be returned for replacement.

recalls.title: Black Diamond Recalls Via Ferrata Climbing Equipment Due to Fall Hazard

Instructions for inspection are also available at https://warranty.bdel.com/ViaFerrataRecall/Landing. Only those sets that lack the safety stitching need to be returned for replacement.

recalls.description: This recall involves snowboard boots with the M3v2 secondary reel dials, which are used to adjust the fit at the forefoot and tongue of the boots.
recalls.injuries: The firm received two reports of incidents. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Head USA Recalls Ski and Snowboard Helmets Due to Head Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Ski and snowboard helmets
recalls.hazard: The helmets do not comply with the impact requirements of safety standards for helmets, posing a risk of head injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled helmets and contact Head USA to receive a free replacement helmet.
recalls.units: About 260 in the United States (in addition, 180 were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: This recall involves six models of HEAD ski and snowboard helmets: Agent, Alia, Andor, Arise, Arosa and Avril. They were sold in sizes M/L and XL/XXL in black, blue, green white and yellow, with straps in a variety of colors.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Chillafish Recalls Children's Balance Bikes Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Children's bikes
recalls.hazard: Overinflated tires can cause the wheel rims to crack and send pieces of the plastic rim flying, posing a laceration hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop children from using the recalled bikes until the tires are deflated to a pressure at or below 32 psi and contact Chillafish for a free repair. Chillafish is contacting consumers directly.
recalls.units: About 29,000 (in addition, 268 were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: This recall includes all Chillafish BMXie, Chillafish Jack and Chillafish Josie balance bikes. The bikes were designed for children ages 2 to 5 and have no pedals and no chains. BMXie bikes are made of plastic.
recalls.injuries: Chillafish has received 19 reports of plastic separating from the rims, including two reports of consumers being cut by flying plastic when pieces of the…

recalls.title: QBP Recalls Stolen Series BMX Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Stolen series BMX bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycles fail to meet the federal bicycle standard. The bicycle's front wheel can detach due to improperly fitting retention washers, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled BMX bicycles and return them to the store where purchased for a free inspection and free replacement wheel retention washers.
recalls.description: This recall involves Stolen series BMX bicycles, including Stolen Agent 16CB and 16FW, Stolen Compact, Stolen Casino and Stolen Stereo models. "Stolen" and the model name are printed on the frame of the bicycles.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received one report of an incident. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Origin8 Recalls Folding Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Origin8 folding bicycles
recalls.hazard: The frame on the folding bicycles can break, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bicycles immediately and return them to the place where purchased for a free replacement bicycle.
recalls.description: This recall involves three models, the F1, F3 and F7. The F1 model is a single-speed folding bike which came in matte black and can be identified by the "F1" on the top tube.
recalls.injuries: Origin8 has received 13 reports of welds on the frame cracking or failing. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Focus Bicycles Recalls Izalco Max Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Focus Izalco Max Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The headset could cause the carbon-fiber fork steer tube to crack, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact Focus Bicycles to schedule a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves the 2014-2015 Focus Izalco Max bicycles with Acros-brand upper headsets. The headsets are black with the word "Acros" printed in white on the upper headset.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 11 reports of incidents outside the United States, including one reported injury in France.

recalls.title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Mountain Bikes with OEM Carbon Fiber Seatposts Due to Risk of Injury, Fall Hazards
recalls.name: Mountain Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The carbon seat post originally sold with the bicycle can crack and break, posing injury and fall hazards to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact their local Felt Bicycles dealer for a free inspection and seat post replacement.
recalls.description: This recall involves all model year 2015 Felt Double Double 30, NINEe 20 and Edict 1 mountain bicycles. The bicycles were sold with carbon fiber seat posts. The model name is printed on the top tube of the bicycles.
recalls.injuries: Felt has received 10 reports of the seat post cracking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: BRP Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Ski-Doo Snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: Internal damage to the fuel hose can cause a leak, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled vehicles and contact BRP to schedule a free repair. BRP is notifying registered consumers directly about this recall.
recalls.description: This recall involves 68 models of 2016 Ski-Doo snowmobiles equipped with a 600 HO E-TEC engine or an 800R E-TEC engine. The VIN is scribed on the vehicle description decal, which is located on the right hand side of the tunnel.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Kona Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Kona Wo bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle fork can crack or break, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact Kona or an authorized Kona dealer for a free replacement and installation of the bicycle fork.
recalls.description: This recall involves all 2014 Kona Wo bicycles with a charcoal black frame and silver decals. The word "Wo" is on the top tube of the frame and the word "Kona" is on the down tube of the frame and on the side of the seat.
recalls.injuries: Kona has received one report of the bicycle fork breaking at the junction of the crown. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Club Car Recalls Gas Golf and Transport Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Precedent Gas Golf and Transport Vehicles
recalls.hazard: An improperly factory-installed hose clamp can rub and wear a hole in the fuel tank, causing a leak and posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the vehicles and contact Club Car to schedule a free repair. Club Car is contacting owners of the recalled golf and transport vehicles directly.
recalls.description: The 2014-2016 Precedent gas golf and transport vehicles, which vary in size, models and colors, are used for short-distance transportation. The recalled vehicles can be identified by the model and serial numbers.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received three reports that the air intake hose clamp rubbed the fuel tank. No incidents of fire or injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: QBP Recalls WeThePeople BMX Bicycles and Cranksets Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: WeThePeople Envy BMX bicycles and Eclat Aeon cranksets
recalls.hazard: The left end of the bicycle crankset spindle can break, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the recalled bicycles and cranksets and return to the store where purchased for a free inspection and free replacement spindle.
recalls.units: About 70 bicycles and about 170 cranksets (in addition, about 40 bicycles and about 40 cranksets were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: The recall involves WeThePeople Envy BMX bicycles and aftermarket ECLAT Aeon BMX cranksets. The Envy BMX bicycles have a 20.6 or 21 inch chromoly frame, painted dark gold. The bicycle bottom bracket has an "ENVY20.6" or "ENVY21" stamp.
recalls.injuries: WeThePeople has received five reports of the crankset spindles breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Burley Design Recalls Child Bicycle Trailers Due to Injury Risk
recalls.name: Child bicycle trailers
recalls.hazard: Trailers with black plastic tow bar receivers can separate from the tow bar when they appear to be connected, posing a crash hazard to the child in the trailer.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycle trailers and contact Burley for a free safety strap kit with tools and instructions for installation and a coupon for a 20 percent discount on the purchase of any Burley accessory. Consumers should also inspect the black plastic tow bar receiver. If it appears to be cracked or damaged, consumers should also request a free replacement tow bar receiver.
recalls.units: About 34,000 (in addition about 820 were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: This recall involves seven models of Burley Design child bicycle trailers manufactured from 2009 to 2015. The trailers allow cyclists to tow children behind their bicycles while riding.
recalls.injuries: Burley Design has received 35 reports of trailers with black plastic tow bar receivers separating from the tow bar, including two incidents that resulted in…

recalls.title: Innopower Recalls Hawk Climbing Sticks Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Climbing Sticks
recalls.hazard: Folding steps can bend or break during use, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the climbing sticks and contact Innopower for information on returning the folding steps for a free replacement.
recalls.description: This recall includes 2014 and 2015 Hawk 2085 RAZOR 3PK (32 inches long), the 2085-1 RAZOR 1PK (32 inches long), and the 2015 Hawk 2084 RAZOR SHORTMAX 4PK (20 inches long) and 2084-1 RAZOR SHORTMAX 1PK (20 inches long) climbing sticks.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received reports of five incidents of steps breaking. Only minor injuries, including scratches and bruises, have been reported.

recalls.title: Big Game Recalls Tree Stands Due to Fall
recalls.name: Climbing tree stands
recalls.hazard: The cable assembly on the climbing tree stand can release, posing a fall hazard to the user.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled tree stands and return them for free replacement cables.
recalls.description: This recall involves three model year 2014 Big Game climbing tree stands models: CL050 (The Outlook) with batch number 9B-0414, CL100-A (The Cobalt) with batch numbers 9B-0214 and 9B-0514, and CL500-AP (The Fusion) with batch numbers 9B-0214 and 9B-0514.
recalls.injuries: Big Game has received one report of the cable assembly releasing which resulted in injuries to the knee, wrist and hip.

recalls.title: Global Manufacturing Company Recalls API Outdoors Tree Stands Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Climbing tree stands
recalls.hazard: The cable assembly on the climbing tree stand can release, posing a fall hazard to the user.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled tree stands and return them for free replacement cables.
recalls.description: This recall involves model year 2014 API Outdoors climbing tree stands model GCL300-A (The Marksman) with batch numbers 9G-0114 and 9G-0614. The climbing tree stands are used to hunt from an elevated position and were sold with an accessory bag.
recalls.injuries: Global Manufacturing Company has received one report of the cable assembly releasing; which resulted in a broken vertebra, fractured rib and sprained shoulder.

recalls.title: Thirteen Manufacturers, Distributors Recall Bicycles with Front Disc Brakes to Replace Quick Release Lever Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles equipped with front disc brakes and quick release levers
recalls.hazard: An open quick release lever on the bicycle's front wheel hub can come into contact with the front disc brake rotor causing the front wheel to come to a sudden stop or separate from the bicycle, posing a risk of injury to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately and contact the recalling company for free installation of a new quick release on the front wheel.
recalls.units: About 1.3 million (in addition about 245,000 bikes were sold in Canada and about 9,000 were sold in Mexico)
recalls.description: This recall involves bicycles equipped with front disc brakes and a black or silver quick-release (QR) lever on the front wheel hub. Bicycles that do not have disc brakes are not included in this recall.
recalls.injuries: There have been three incidents reported in which an open quick release lever on a bicycle's front wheel hub came into contact with the bike's front disc brake…

recalls.title: Wishbone Design Recalls Recycled Edition Bikes Due to Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Recycled Edition Bikes
recalls.hazard: The handlebar can pinch fingers placed at the center where the handlebar connects to the bike frame.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bike, take it away from children and contact Wishbone or the store where the bike was purchased for a free neoprene cover for the handlebar.
recalls.units: About 400 (an additional 4,600 were sold outside the United States)
recalls.description: The Wishbone Recycled (RE) Bikes are made from recycled black plastic materials with 12-inch, air-filled white rubber tires. The adjustable seat height ranges from 9 to 20 inches. The bikes weigh about 10 pounds.
recalls.injuries: The firm received reports of four incidents, including two injuries. One required stitches and one required restorative surgery.

recalls.title: Mini Bikes Recalled by Baja Motorsports Due to Fall and Crash Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Tractor Supply Company
recalls.name: Mini bikes
recalls.hazard: The front fork can separate from the wheel, posing fall and crash hazards to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled mini bikes and contact Baja Motorsports to schedule a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves Baja Motorsports gas-powered mini bikes manufactured during November 2014 and December 2014. The recalled mini bikes have a black frame with a black padded seat, a storage tank and fenders that are camouflage, side reflectors, a headlight…
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 22 reports of the front forks separating from the wheel, including 11 reports of minor injuries.

recalls.title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls Cannondale Mountain Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Cannondale mountain bicycles with OPI stem/steering tube
recalls.hazard: The OPI stem/steering tube assemblies can fail, posing a risk of injury from a fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycle and take it to the nearest authorized Cannondale dealer for a free repair. Cannondale dealers will fit a locking reinforcement wedge assembly inside the OPI stem/steering tube and replace the clamp bolts.
recalls.units: About 23,000 (in addition, about 800 were sold in Canada)
recalls.description: This recall involves all model year 2011 through 2015 Flash, FSi , F-4, F-5, F-29, Lexi, RZ, Scalpel and Trigger Cannondale mountain bicycles, with OPI stem/steering tube assemblies "OPI" is printed diagonally across the stem/steering tube in black letters.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Huffy Recalls Bicycles with Front Disc Brakes to Replace Quick Release Lever Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Huffy bicycles equipped with front disc brakes
recalls.hazard: An open quick release lever on the bicycle's front wheel hub can come into contact with the front disc brake assembly, causing the front wheel to come to a sudden stop or separate from the bicycle, posing a risk of injury to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately and contact Huffy for a free replacement quick release lever for the front wheel.
recalls.description: The recalled products are all model year 2014 Huffy TR 745 and TR-S 740 bicycles with 27.5-inch wheels. "Huffy" is on the downtube of the frame of both bicycles and model name TR 745 or TR-S 740 is on the rear portion of the frame.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Trek Recalls Superfly Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Seatpost Can Crack and Break
recalls.name: Trek 9.8 Superfly FS SL, X1 and XT bicycles
recalls.hazard: The seatpost can crack and break, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact an authorized Trek retailer for a free replacement seatpost plus a $20 coupon toward any Bontrager merchandise. The coupon can be used through December 31, 2015.
recalls.description: This recall involves model year 2015 Trek 9.8 Superfly FS SL, X1 and XT bicycles equipped with Bontrager Approved Carbon seatposts. Recalled bicycles have a serial number ending in J or K. The serial number is located on the bottom of the bicycle frame.
recalls.injuries: Trek has received two incidents report involving the recalled bicycles. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Breezer Recalls Downtown Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard; Pedals Can Come Off
recalls.name: Breezer Downtown Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle pedal can separate from the spindle (axle) during use and cause the rider to lose control, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bicycles and return then to a Breezer dealer for a free pedal replacement.
recalls.description: This recall involves Breezer Bicycles models Downtown 3, Downtown 3-ST, Downtown 8, Downtown 8-ST, Downtown EX and Downtown EX-ST. The main frame is made of steel and has either a single or dual water bottle mount, and the wheel sets are aluminum.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 12 reports of pedals separating from the spindle. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Öhlins Front Forks for Motocross Bikes Recalled by Öhlins USA Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Öhlins RXF 48 front forks for motocross bikes
recalls.hazard: The front fork can break or detach, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using motocross bikes with these front forks immediately and contact Öhlins for free replacement and installation of a new cartridge kit in the fork.
recalls.description: This recall involves Öhlins RXF 48 mm front bike forks for motocross bikes. The fork legs are yellow with a large white "Ö" and a small "TTX" on the front. The fork legs measure about 37 inches long.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: E-Z-GO Recalls Gas-Powered Golf, Shuttle and Utility Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Golf cars, shuttles and off-road utility vehicles
recalls.hazard: The gas tank can leak, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled vehicles and contact E-Z-GO or an authorized dealer for a free repair. E-Z-GO and E-Z-GO dealers are contacting known owners.
recalls.description: This recall involves E-Z-GO gas-powered TXT Fleet golf cars, E-Z-GO Freedom TXT, TXT2+2 and Valor golf cars, E-Z-GO Express, E-Z-GO Terrain and Cushman Shuttle vehicles with bench seats for the driver and passengers.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Yamaha Recalls Golf Cars and Personal Transportation Vehicles Due to Risk of Injury, Death (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Yamaha Golf Cars and Personal Transportation Vehicles (PTV)
recalls.hazard: The front wheel hubs on the golf cars and PTVs can crack causing the front wheels to detach, posing a crash hazard that could result in injury or death to the user or bystander.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these recalled Golf Cars and PTVs and contact their local Yamaha Golf Car dealer to schedule a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves five 2015 and one 2016 model-year golf cars and PTVs. Recalled models include 2015 "The DRIVE PTV", "The DRIVE EFI", "Adventurer One", "The DRIVE", "The DRIVE Electric" and 2016 "The DRIVE A.C." The Yamaha logo is printed on the front of…
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Bicycles with SR Suntour Bicycle Forks Recalled by SR Suntour Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles with SR Suntour bicycle forks
recalls.hazard: The bolt that attaches the upper part of the bicycle's fork to the lower part of the fork can break or separate and cause the front wheel to come off the bicycle. This is a crash hazard for riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles with the recalled SR Suntour bicycle forks and return the bicycle to the place of purchase for a free inspection and repair.
recalls.units: About 68,000 in the United States and 33,600 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves Cannondale, Diamondback, Giant, GT, INA International, Nishiki, Schwinn, Scott and Trek brand bicycles with SR Suntour bicycle forks models M3010, M3020, M3030, NEX and XCT.
recalls.injuries: There have been 15 reports of the bolts breaking or separating from the bicycles, including two reports of minor injuries, including abrasions, cuts and…

recalls.title: Colnago Recalls Bicycles and Frame Kits Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles and bicycle frame kits
recalls.hazard: The front brakes can detach from fork during use, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bicycles and bicycle frame kits and contact Colnago America for a free inspection. If the hole in the front fork for the brake mounting bolt is not at least 12 mm in depth, the front fork will be replaced free of charge.
recalls.units: About 400 in the United States and 34 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves all Colnago CF10 and Colnago V1-r racing bicycles and bicycle frame kits that fit 28-inch wheels. "Colnago for Ferrari" is on the downtube and the Ferrari logo is on the seat tube of the CF10.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls GT Fury Mountain Bicycles Due to Crash, Injury Hazards
recalls.name: GT downhill mountain bicycles
recalls.hazard: The front wheel hub can break and cause the disc brake system to fail, posing crash and injury hazards to the consumer.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and return them to the nearest authorized GT dealer to have the complete front wheel replaced free of charge.
recalls.description: This recall involves all 2015 model year GT Fury Elite and GT Fury Expert downhill mountain bicycles. The recalled 2015 Fury Elite model is white with blue and red accents. The recalled 2015 Fury Expert model is metallic grey with lime green accents.
recalls.injuries: Cycling Sports Group has received two reports of broken hubs. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Valor Athletics Recalls Olympic Weight Bench due to Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Weight bench
recalls.hazard: The weld joining the front leg to the main frame can break, posing an injury hazard to the user.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bench and contact Valor Fitness for a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves Valor Fitness BF-38 Flat/Incline/Decline Olympic Benches. The benches are used to perform various free weight exercises.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Cruiser Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Felt Cruiser bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's brakes can fail, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact your local Felt bicycle dealer for a free inspection and replacement of the rear hub cog/driver.
recalls.description: This recall involves beach cruiser style Felt Deep Six and El Guapo model bicycles with one speed and coaster brakes. "Felt" and "Deep Six" or "El Guapo" are printed on the bicycle's frame.
recalls.injuries: Felt Bicycles has received 26 reports of incidents with the recalled bicycles. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Trek Recalls Bicycles Equipped with Front Disc Brakes to Replace Quick Release Lever Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Trek bicycles equipped with front disc brakes
recalls.hazard: An open quick release lever on the bicycle's front wheel hub can come into contact with the front disc brake assembly, causing the front wheel to come to a sudden stop or separate from the bicycle, posing a risk of injury to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately and contact an authorized Trek retailer for free installation of a new quick release on the front wheel. Trek will provide each owner who participates in the recall with a $20 coupon that is redeemable by December 31, 2015 toward any Bontrager merchandise. (The coupon has no cash value.)
recalls.units: About 900,000 in the U.S. and 98,000 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves all models of Trek bicycles from model years 2000 through 2015 equipped with front disc brakes and a black or silver quick release lever on the front wheel hub that opens far enough to contact the disc brake (see Figures 1 and 2).
recalls.injuries: Trek reports three incidents, all including injuries. One incident resulted in quadriplegia. One incident resulted in facial injuries.

recalls.title: Gorsuch Recalls ERTLRENZ Ski Boot Heat Liners Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Ertlrenz Trim Heat and Foam Heat ski boot liners
recalls.hazard: Liner can overheat when charging, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the heat liners and return the product with accessories (charger/remote control) to Gorsuch LTD or a Gorsuch store for repair or replacement.
recalls.description: The ERTLRENZ Trim Heat and Foam Heat are handmade, customized, black inner heat liners for ski boots. Every product is accompanied by a charger and a remote control for the heating system.
recalls.injuries: Gorsuch received three reports of the heat liners smoldering during the charging process. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Civia Cycles Recalls Hyland Bicycles, Aluminum Civia Fenders Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Hyland Bicycles and Aluminum Fenders
recalls.hazard: The fender mounting bracket can break or bend, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding bicycles with the recalled fenders and contact an authorized Civia Cycles dealer to receive a $60 credit.
recalls.description: This recall includes all Civia aluminum fenders sold separately as aftermarket sets and all Civia Hyland bicycles sold with the fenders as original equipment.
recalls.injuries: Civia has received one report in which a consumer stated that a bracket broke and resulted in the consumer suffering a cervical spine injury and nerve damage.

recalls.title: Husky Vertical Bike Hooks Recalled by Waterloo Industries Due to Risk of Injury; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
recalls.name: Husky® Securelock™ Vertical Bike Hooks
recalls.hazard: The mounted bike hooks can unexpectedly detach, allowing the bike to fall. This poses a risk of injury to bystanders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled hooks and return them to the nearest Home Depot store for a full refund.
recalls.units: About 105,000 in the U.S. and 15,000 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves Husky® Securelock™ vertical bike hooks used with a Husky Trackwall garage storage system. The 3 by 3.5 inch black metal plate is mounted to the grooves in the Trackwall and the bike's tire is attached to a hook protruding from the plate.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 22 reports of the bike hooks falling from the mounted Trackwall, including 12 reports of property damage to bicycles and/or nearby…

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Aerobars Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Aerobars Bicycle Handlebars
recalls.hazard: The bolt used to affix the aerobars to the bicycle can loosen, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled aerobars and contact Specialized Bicycle Components to receive replacement extension mounting hardware.
recalls.description: This recall involves carbon and alloy Aerobars sold individually and with model years 2012 through 2015 Specialized Shiv bicycles and model year 2013 Specialized Transition Apex bicycles.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received four reports of the Aerobars bolt loosening. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: SCARPA North America Recalls Ski Boots with Tronic System Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: F1 EVO Ski Boots with Tronic system component
recalls.hazard: The Tronic system, can unexpectedly switch from ski mode to walk mode, not allowing the boot to release from the binding, posing a fall or injury hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the boots and contact SCARPA North America for a full refund.
recalls.units: About 2100 in U.S. and 250 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves the men's and women's SCARPA F1 EVO ski boots with the Tronic system component. The Tronic system locks the boot into the ski binding.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received two reports of torn knee ligament injuries following falls, when the boots failed to release from the binding.

recalls.title: Flow Sports Inc. Recalls Snowboard Bindings Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Flow 2014 Flite-series snowboard bindings
recalls.hazard: A pin can disengage and cause the binding to open, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled snowboard bindings and contact Flow Sports for a free repair or to return the bindings for free replacement bindings or a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves Flow 2014 Flite-series snowboard bindings with model names Flite, Haylo, Micron Youth, Flite LTD and Flite MTN.
recalls.injuries: Flow Sports has received 30 reports of the pins disengaging from the bindings. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: SCOTT Recalls Vanish Evo Bicycle Helmets Due to Head Injury Hazard
recalls.name: 2015 SCOTT® Vanish Evo Bicycle Helmets
recalls.hazard: The bicycle helmets do not comply with the impact requirements of the CPSC safety standards for bicycle helmets.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bicycle helmet and take it to an authorized SCOTT dealer for a refund of the purchase price.
recalls.description: The helmets have the brand name "SCOTT" printed on the outer shell of the helmet on the left side. For the Vanish Evo black and gray helmets, the lettering is black; for the Vanish Evo white and gray helmets, the lettering is white.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: SRAM Recalls Zipp 88 Bicycle Wheel Hubs Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
recalls.name: Zipp 88 aluminum hubs for bicycle wheels
recalls.hazard: The hub flange ring on the front hub can fail posing a crash and injury hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles equipped with the recalled Zipp 88 front hub and contact SRAM for a free replacement hub.
recalls.description: The aluminum hub shell is silver. The outside flange ring is gray aluminum in the standard option and blue, gold, gray, pink or red in the ZedTech options. The diameter of the two clinch nuts is approximately 1 inch.
recalls.injuries: The company reports two incidents of collapsed front wheels. Both resulted in stitches, bruises and lacerations, plus a concussion in one case.

recalls.title: Marin Mountain Bikes Recalls Children's Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Handlebars Can Loosen
recalls.name: 2014 Marin MBX 50 and Tiny Trail Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The handlebars can loosen or separate during use. This can cause the rider to lose control and/or crash, posing the risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycle and contact Marin for a replacement handlebar stem.
recalls.units: About 400 in the U.S. and 50 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves Marin 2014 model MBX 50 and Tiny Trail boy's and girl's bicycles with 16-inch knobby tires. The single speed bicycles have high-rise handlebars and training wheels. The boy's bicycles were sold in red and have serial number HA14980XXXXXX.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Bicycle Helmets Recalled by UVEX Sports Due to Risk of Head Injury
recalls.name: UVEX Bicycle Helmets
recalls.hazard: The anchor for the helmet's chinstrap can fail, causing the helmets to slide off the head, posing a head injury hazard. The bicycle helmets also do not comply with the impact requirements of the CPSC safety standards for bicycle helmets.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the helmets and contact UVEX for a free compliant helmet or a refund of the purchase price.
recalls.description: This recall involves seven models of UVEX helmets. The helmets come in a variety of colors with different colored chin straps. The helmets have a model number inside the helmet under the fitting pad on the top right side.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Salsa Cycles Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Risk of Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Salsa Bearpaw Bicycle Forks
recalls.hazard: The bicycle fork can bend or break, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles equipped with the recalled Salsa Bearpaw forks and contact a Salsa dealer for a free inspection and replacement fork.
recalls.description: This recall involves all aluminum Salsa Bearpaw forks sold separately and on Mukluk bicycles. The forks have date code 20130524, 20130710 or 20130826 stamped on the fork steerer, followed by "CWI2201BAN2" and a Salsa compass graphic on the bend of the fork…
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Cyclocross Bicycles Due to Risk of Injury
recalls.name: Felt Cyclocross Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The frame of the bicycle could break, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact their local Felt Bicycles dealer for a free inspection and frame replacement.
recalls.description: This recall includes Felt Cyclocross bicycles 2015 models F65X and F85X. The 2015 F65X bicycle has a satin black aluminum frame with "Felt" printed in white letters and a diagonal wide white stripe next to a thin white stripe on the frame.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Black Diamond Equipment Recalls Whippet Ski Poles Due to Risk of Injury
recalls.name: Ski poles
recalls.hazard: The stainless steel pick in the handgrip can break and fail to slow or stop users from sliding downhill on a snow or ice covered slope, posing a risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled ski poles and contact Black Diamond to receive a free replacement for the upper shaft.
recalls.description: This recall includes Black Diamond Whippet and Whippet Carbon ski poles manufactured May 2013 through January 2014. The Whippet is gray with two telescoping shafts and the Carbon Whippet is black with three telescoping shafts.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Louis Garneau Recalls Aerodynamic Bicycle Helmets Due to Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycle helmets
recalls.hazard: In cold temperatures, the helmet can fail to protect the wearer from impact injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled helmets and return them to Louis Garneau USA for a refund or replacement with a similar helmet.
recalls.description: This recall involves Louis Garneau P-09 aerodynamic bicycle helmets with model number 1405362. The helmets are shaped like tear drops with a rounded front and a short, tapered tail.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Orbea Recalls Avant Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Avant Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle front fork can crack, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact Orbea for a free replacement and installation of the bicycle front fork.
recalls.description: This recall involves all Avant bicycles and carbon framesets sold with hydraulic disk brakes and all Avant bicycles and carbon framesets that are capable of being configured with hydraulic disc brakes.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: NRS Recalls Water Sports Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
recalls.name: NRS water sports helmets
recalls.hazard: The rivets holding the chin strap to the helmet can fail and cause the helmet to fall off in an incident, posing a risk of head injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled helmets and return them to the place where purchased or NRS for a free replacement helmet or a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves NRS "Chaos Side Cut" helmets used for water sports, including rafting, kayaking, stand-up paddling and canoeing. The helmet's hard shell is available in yellow, red, blue or white. "NRS" is printed on the front and back of the helmet.
recalls.injuries: NRS has received four reports of the helmet's rivets failing. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Attwood Recalls Kayak and Watersports Storage Hanger Due to Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Kayak and Watersports Storage Hanger
recalls.hazard: The length adjustment buckles release unexpectedly, causing the item being stored to fall and injure people nearby
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled storage hangers and return them to Attwood or the store where the item was purchased for a full refund or replacement.
recalls.description: This recall involves kayak and watersports storage hangers sold as a pair of blue and black fabric straps that measure approximately 1 inch wide and 84 inches long when unbuckled.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Dynacraft Recalls Avigo Youth Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Toys "R" Us
recalls.name: Avigo 20-inch Turn N' Burn Youth Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The front wheel on the bicycle can detach, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycle and contact Dynacraft to arrange for a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves 20-inch Avigo Turn N' Burn youth bicycles with model number 8107-62. The model number and date of manufacture, "08202013," are printed on a data label on the frame's seat tube.
recalls.injuries: Dynacraft has received one report of a consumer who fell and sustained scrapes and abrasions when the front wheel detached.

recalls.title: East Coast Cycle Supply Recalls Trayl TRN Mountain Bikes Due to Crash Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Sports Authority (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Mountain bikes
recalls.hazard: The brakes can fail to stop riders within the distances required by federal regulation, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and return them to Sports Authority for a free repair. East Coast Cycle Supply is contacting consumers directly.
recalls.description: This recall involves all Trayl TRN 29-inch hardtail mountain bikes. The bike has a black and green frame with a white front fork. The word Trayl is in white on the underside of the down tube and in green on the top side of the down tube.
recalls.injuries: East Coast Cycle Supply has received one report of the braking system taking longer to stop than allowed by federal regulation. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls GT Brand Mountain Bicycles Due to Crash, Injury Hazards
recalls.name: GT downhill mountain bicycles
recalls.hazard: The wheel hubs can break and cause the brake system to fail, posing crash and injury hazards to the consumer.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bicycles and return them to the nearest authorized GT dealer to have the complete front and rear wheels replaced free of charge.
recalls.units: About 120 in the U.S. and 32 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves all 2014 GT Fury Expert and 2014 GT Fury Team downhill mountain bicycles. The recalled Fury Expert model is blue with red and white accents. The recalled Fury Team model is black with lime green and blue accents.
recalls.injuries: Cycling Sports Group has received five reports of broken hubs. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Scott, Trek Recall Bicycles with SR Suntour Front Forks Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: SR Suntour forks on model year 2011 through 2013 Scott and Trek bicycles
recalls.hazard: The front fork can break, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles. Consumers with recalled Scott bicycles should take them to an authorized Scott dealer for a free repair of the NEX model or a free replacement lower fork for the NCX model. Consumers with recalled Trek bicycles should take them to an authorized Trek dealer for a free repair of NEX, XCM and XCT models or a free replacement of the NRX model.
recalls.units: About 5,200 forks on Scott bicycles and about 120,000 forks on Trek bicycles
recalls.description: This recall involves SR Suntour front forks on 13 models of Scott and 11 models of Trek 2011, 2012 and 2013 bicycles. Recalled Scott bicycles have 700c wheels, disc brakes and one of the following Suntour front fork models: NEX or NCX.
recalls.injuries: Scott has received one report of a broken SR Suntour fork. No injuries were reported. Trek has received 28 reports of broken forks.

recalls.title: Stile Products Recalls Tern Folding Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Frames Can Crack
recalls.name: Tern Folding Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bike's frame can crack at the hinge on the top tube, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bicycles and contact Stile Products or take the bike to an authorized dealer. Consumers will receive a free replacement frame and have it installed at no cost or they can upgrade their bike to one of three designated models at an additional cost.
recalls.units: 650 in the U.S. and about 20 in Canada
recalls.description: The recall involves Link Uno, Link D7i, Link D8, Link P9, Link P7i, and Link P24h models of Tern brand adult folding bikes. These six models were sold in black/blue, black/green, black/gray, black/red dark gray/light gray, gray/orange and white/pink color…
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries reported in the U.S. The firm has received 11 reports of the bicycle frames cracking including five reports of minor scrapes and…

recalls.title: SCOTT Recalls Speedster Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2014 SCOTT® Speedster 30 and 40, and Contessa Speedster 25 and 35 road bicycles
recalls.hazard: The steerer tube in the front fork can break, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the bicycle and take it to an authorized SCOTT dealer. Consumers with a recalled bicycle will receive a free replacement fork and have it installed at no cost.
recalls.description: This recall involves model year 2014 SCOTT men's and women's road bicycles, models Speedster 30, Speedster 40, Contessa Speedster 25 and Contessa Speedster 35. The bikes have the brand name "SCOTT" and the model name "Speedster" on the frame.
recalls.injuries: Scott USA has received one report of a fork breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: BMC Recalls Three Models of Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Bicycle Forks Can Break
recalls.name: BMC Alpenchallenge, Masschallenge and Urbanchallenge Bicycles with Aprebic Forks
recalls.hazard: The bicycle forks can crack or break above the brake mount posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these recalled bicycles immediately and contact their local BMC authorized dealer for instructions on receiving a replacement fork.
recalls.description: The recall involves certain models of Alpenchallenge, Urbanchallenge and Masschallenge bicycles equipped with full carbon Aprebic bike forks model ACC-A704DN50B. The fork model number is printed behind the top arch.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls Cannondale Tandem Road Bicycles Due to Risk of Injury
recalls.name: 2014 Cannondale Tandem Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle fork can break and cause the riders to lose control, posing a risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bicycles and return them to the nearest authorized Cannondale dealer to receive a free replacement fork.
recalls.description: This recall involves three models of 2014 tandem Cannondale bicycles, road 1, road 2 and 29 tandem. The road 1 and 29 tandem bicycles were sold in black with white graphics and the road 2 was sold in white with red and black graphics.
recalls.injuries: Cycling Sports Groups has received two reports of loose steerer tubes. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Triathlon Bicycles Due to Risk of Injury
recalls.name: 2008 Felt S22 and S32 Triathlon Bicycles and 2010 Felt S32, B12, B14 and B16 Triathlon Bicycles.
recalls.hazard: The steer tube on the bicycle fork can break and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact their local Felt Bicycles dealer for a free inspection and steer tube replacement.
recalls.units: About 3,300 (2,100 additional units with the same steer tube were previously recalled in June 2010) in U.S. and about 190 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall includes all 2008 Felt S22 and S32 triathlon bicycles, and 2010 S32, B12, B14 and B16 triathlon bicycles. The bicycles have aluminum frames with carbon fiber forks and aluminum steer tubes. The Felt logo is on the seat, frame and tires.
recalls.injuries: Felt Bicycles has received 18 reports of the bicycle forks breaking, including five reports of minor injuries.

recalls.title: E-Z-GO Recalls Golf, Shuttle, Off-Road Utility Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Golf cars, shuttles and off-road utility vehicles
recalls.hazard: The steering wheel nut may not have been tightened sufficiently, reducing the driver's steering control. This can result in a crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled vehicles and contact E-Z-GO or an authorized dealer for a free repair. E-Z-GO and E-Z-GO dealers are already contacting known owners.
recalls.description: This recall involves E-Z-GO, Cushman and Bad Boy Buggies brand gas- and electric-powered, four-wheeled vehicles with bench seats for the driver and passengers.
recalls.injuries: The firm is aware of one incident reportedly involving an insufficiently tightened steering wheel nut and reduced steering control, in which the vehicle went…

recalls.title: Snowboard Bindings Recalled by K2 Sports Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: K2 Kwicker and Kwicker BC snowboard bindings
recalls.hazard: The bindings can release unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard to snowboarders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bindings and contact K2 Sports to arrange for free replacement bindings and installation. K2 Sports is contacting its customers directly.
recalls.description: This recall involves Kwicker and Kwicker BC snowboard bindings. Kwicker bindings are black and silver with a green release lever knob and have item number B1304028010 printed on the binding's box.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: BMC Recalls Stromer Electric Bicycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
recalls.name: Stromer ST1 electric bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle fork can break, posing a crash and injury hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the bicycle and take it to an authorized Stromer dealer. Consumers with a recalled bicycle will receive a free replacement fork and have it installed at no cost.
recalls.units: About 1,300 in the U.S. and 11 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves all 2013 Stromer ST1 women's and men's pedal-assist electric bicycles, models M33 Elite and P48 Platinum. The bikes were sold in three colors; black, red and white.
recalls.injuries: BMC has received one report of a fork breaking, resulting in minor scrapes and bruises to the rider.

recalls.title: Mammut Recalls Crevasse Rescue Devices Due to Risk of Injury
recalls.name: Mountain climbing rescue devices
recalls.hazard: The pull cord lock cam can fail, posing a risk of death and injury during a rescue.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled RescYou devices and contact Mammut for a free replacement crevasse rescue device.
recalls.units: About 70 in the U.S. and 80 in Canada
recalls.description: The recall involves Mammut's RescYou crevasse rescue devices with batch numbers 12-12 and 03-13. The crevasse rescue devices are pulley systems used for ski mountaineering and mountain climbing to lift a skier or climber who has fallen into a crevasse.
recalls.injuries: None

recalls.title: Rollerblade USA Recalls Tempest Inline Skates Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Rollerblade® Tempest Inline Skates
recalls.hazard: The mounting holes in the boot and frame can be misaligned causing the boot to separate from the frame and posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the skates and contact Rollerblade USA for a free inspection and free replacement if the mounting holes on their skates are misaligned.
recalls.description: The recalled Tempest skates are high performance training or racing skates sold in a variety of color combinations. They contain silver frame mounting bolts that attach a boot to an aluminum frame that holds four wheels.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: BRP Recalls Ski-Doo and Can-Am Lithium-ion Rechargeable Batteries and Heated Gloves Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Ski-Doo® and Can-Am® heated gloves and Lithium-Ion Rechargeable Batteries.
recalls.hazard: The glove's lithium-ion rechargeable battery pack can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately disconnect all battery packs from the electrical connections and remove the battery. Avoid charging the battery packs and contact an authorized dealership or BRP directly for a full refund. Customers can keep the gloves. A full reimbursement of the paid price up to $199.99 plus taxes will be offered for a returned charger and the 2 battery packs. A full reimbursement of the paid price up to $49.99 plus taxes will be offered for the return of additional 2 battery packs.
recalls.units: About 450 in U.S. and 1,200 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves BRP Ski-Doo and Can-Am heated gloves and replacement Lithium-Ion rechargeable batteries. The gloves are only available in black and are sold with two lithium-ion rechargeable batteries and a charger.
recalls.injuries: BRP has received three reports of batteries overheating while charging, two in Canada and one in United States.

recalls.title: Club Car Recalls Golf and Transport Vehicles Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Precedent I2 golf and transport vehicles
recalls.hazard: The hip restraint on the passenger side can fracture, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the transport vehicles and contact Club Car for a free replacement of the passenger side hip restraint. Club Car is contacting its customers directly.
recalls.description: The recalled vehicles are various sizes, models and colors of model year 2012 Precedent I2 golf and transport vehicles used for short-distance transportation. The vehicles can be identified by model and serial number.
recalls.injuries: Club Car has received one report of injury involving bruised ribs when a passenger fell from the vehicle.

recalls.title: 3T Design Recalls Cervélo Bicycles with Aduro Aero Handlebars Due to Risk of Injury
recalls.name: Cervélo P5 bicycles with 3T Aduro aero handlebars
recalls.hazard: The forward extension mounts can detach from the base bar while riding causing the rider to lose control, posing a risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact 3T Design to have the recalled handlebars replaced free of charge with a modified set of Aduro aero handlebars installed with the high or low mount. Consumers who also purchased the ultra-low mount can receive: a full refund for the ultra-low mount and a free modified Aduro aero base bar for use with the originally purchased low mount or replacement of the Aduro aero handlebars with 3T Mistral aero handlebars with a low-position mount, which places a rider in a position similar to the Aduro ultra-low position mount.
recalls.units: About 1,300 in the U.S. and about 225 in Canada
recalls.description: The recall includes 2012 and 2013 Cervélo P5 bicycles equipped with 3T Aduro aero handlebars. The bicycles are black with red and white stripes. "P5" is on the seat tube, "Cervélo" is on the top tube and a large "é" is on the down tube in white lettering.
recalls.injuries: 3T Design has received 28 reports of incidents, including one report of a broken collar bone and four reports of abrasions.

recalls.title: West Marine Recalls Folding Bicycles; Frames Can Break Causing Riders to Fall
recalls.name: Folding Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's frame can break during use, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and return them to West Marine for a free replacement folding bicycle.
recalls.description: This recall involves two models of folding bicycles, the Jetty Express 2 and the Port Runner 2, that are designed for use in and around docks and marinas. The Jetty Express 2 has a blue and white frame and folds at a hinge in the middle.
recalls.injuries: West Marine has received three reports of the bicycle's frame breaking, resulting in bruises and scrapes to a rider.

recalls.title: Reebok-CCM Recalls Senior Hockey Elbow Pads Due to Risk of Elbow Injury
recalls.name: EP20K Senior (SR) Hockey Elbow Pads
recalls.hazard: The molded foam padding inside the elbow pads can become cracked, fractured or split, which poses a risk of injury to the elbow.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled elbow pads and return the product to place of purchase for a full refund or replacement, or return the product directly to Reebok-CCM Hockey Inc. for a replacement.
recalls.units: About 2,100 in the United States and 1,600 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves the Reebok EP20K Senior (SR) Hockey Elbow Pads with, all-foam elbow caps. The pads are white with grey and black colored fabric.
recalls.injuries: The company reports one incident in Canada which resulted in a broken elbow.

recalls.title: Matrix Fitness Ascent Trainers and Ellipticals Recalled by Johnson Health Tech Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Ascent Trainer® by Matrix and Matrix Fitness Elliptical
recalls.hazard: Moisture from user perspiration or cleaning liquids can build up in the power socket on the unit, causing a short circuit, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Exercise facilities should immediately unplug the machines and contact Johnson Health Tech North America to schedule a free repair. Units are self-powered and can be used without being plugged into an electrical outlet.
