recalls.description: This recall involves all Matrix Fitness Ascent Trainers® and Elliptical trainers installed from November 2011 through December 2012. All Ascent Trainers and Ellipticals have a swing-arm handle design, with pedals that rotate in an elliptical path.
recalls.injuries: The company reports 44 incidents of sparking, smoking, charring and/or melting at the power cord and socket.

recalls.title: SRAM Recalls Hydraulic Bicycle Brakes Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
recalls.name: SRAM Hydraulic Road Rim Brakes and Hydraulic Road Disc Brakes for bicycles
recalls.hazard: The brake systems can fail, posing a crash and injury hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles equipped with the recalled SRAM brake systems and contact any SRAM dealer to arrange for a free replacement product to be installed and to receive a $200 product voucher or cash per customer.
recalls.description: The recalled bicycle brake models include SB Red Hydraulic Road Disc, SB Red Hydraulic Road Rim, SB 700 Hydraulic Road Disc and SB 700 Hydraulic Road Rim, used as either front or rear brakes.
recalls.injuries: The firm received 95 reports of brakes failing in the U.S. One minor injury was reported in the U.S. and another in Australia

recalls.title: Cybex International Recalls Decline Free Weight Benches Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Olympic Decline free weight bench
recalls.hazard: The frame of the bench can collapse forward onto the user, posing fall and injury hazards.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the benches immediately and contact Cybex to arrange for instructions for inspecting the frames for cracks or weakness and for installing the free repair.
recalls.description: The Decline model free weight benches are designed for use in professional gyms and come in three model numbers: 16060, 16061 and 16062.
recalls.injuries: The firm received nine reports of frames fatiguing near the weld point. No injuries were reported.

recalls.title: Specialized Recalls Source Eleven and Source Expert Disc Bicycles Due to a Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2012 Source Eleven and Source Expert Disc bicycles with Supernova Switchable Dynamo Front Hubs
recalls.hazard: The set screws in the front hub of the recalled bicycles can loosen and stop the front wheel from turning, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Customers should immediately stop riding the recalled bicycles and bring them to an authorized Specialized dealer for a free replacement front wheel and new Supernova front hub. For a list of authorized dealers go to www.specialized.com/ and click on Dealers in the upper right hand corner of the page.
recalls.description: The recalled products are 2012 model year Source Eleven and Source Expert Disc bicycles with Supernova Switchable Dynamo Front Hubs as part of the original equipment.
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries were reported.

recalls.title: Fox Factory Recalls Evolution Mountain Bike Suspension Forks Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Evolution 2013 Mountain Bike Suspension Forks
recalls.hazard: The suspension fork's damper cylinder/piston can separate and cause the front wheel to detach, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles with recalled Fox Factory suspension forks and bring them to the place of purchase for a free repair. Consumers can check their serial number at www.ridefox.com/, see the link at the lower left of the page, or contact Fox for assistance with discerning whether their bicycle has the recalled product and for instructions on how to return the recalled product and receive the free repair if they cannot bring their bicycle or fork to the place of purchase.
recalls.units: About 11,250 in the U.S. and 1,250 in Canada
recalls.description: The recalled suspension forks are model year 2013, 32 and 34 Evolution Series with 120mm to 160mm of travel. The Evolution name and logo are on a sticker on the front fork with the FOX brand name logo.
recalls.injuries: Fox received one report of an incident resulting in shoulder injuries in Italy.

recalls.title: Trek Recalls Madone Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard; Front Brake Can Fail
recalls.name: Trek model year 2013 Madone bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's front brake can fail, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and take the bicycles to a Trek dealer for a free replacement front brake system.
recalls.description: This recall involves model year 2013 Trek Madone bicycles with model numbers 5.2, 5.9, 6.2, 6.5, 7.7 or 7.9, and serial numbers starting with WTU and ending with G or H. A list of all serial numbers included in the recall is at www.trekbikes.com.
recalls.injuries: Trek has received five reports of loose front brake attachment bolts. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: SRAM Recalls Derailleurs for Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycle chain derailleurs
recalls.hazard: The rear derailleur's rear pivot pin can loosen or dislodge causing the rear derailleur to jam or interfere with the wheel, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles with the recalled SRAM RED derailleurs and return the bicycles to the place of purchase or any SRAM dealer for a free replacement, including installation. Consumers who bought the derailleurs as a stand-alone product can take them to the place of purchase for a free replacement or, for those who can make the equipment change themselves, contact SRAM for instructions on how to return the recalled product for the free replacement.
recalls.description: The SRAM RED WiFLi Rear Derailleur is a device that moves a bicycle chain gears on the rear wheel. The name SRAM RED and the serial number of the derailleur are located on the back of the inner pulley wheel cage plate and visible when looking thru the spokes…
recalls.injuries: The firm has received reports of 43 incidents in the U.S. with one report of scrapes and bruises.

recalls.title: K2 Sports Recalls Kickboards/Scooters Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: K2 Revo Kick kickboards/scooters
recalls.hazard: The front assembly of the kickboards/scooters can break and the handle can detach or partially detach, causing loss of control or loss of balance. This poses a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled kickboards/scooters and contact K2 Sports for a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves K2 Revo Kick kickboards/scooters with item code I10700100. Revo Kick and the item code are printed on a sticker on the underside of the deck.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Burley Design Recalls Tailwind Racks for Trailercycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Tailwind bicycle racks for trailercycles
recalls.hazard: The top portion of the tailwind rack that connects trailercycles to a towing bicycle can break and allow the trailercycle to disconnect, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the Tailwind Racks immediately and contact Burley to receive a free replacement rack. Burley will replace recalled Tailwind Racks with a steel Moose Rack.
recalls.units: About 4,150 in the U.S. and 17 in Canada
recalls.description: The Tailwind Racks are used for hitching children's trailercycles to adult size bicycles. The aluminum racks were sold individually, in black or silver, or with Kazoo or Piccolo brand trailercycles in black only.
recalls.injuries: The firm received 11 reports of Tailwind Racks breaking, including one report of a minor leg injury in the U.S. and one report of a broken leg in the UK.

recalls.title: ElliptiGO Recalls Elliptical Cycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: ElliptiGO outdoor elliptical cycles
recalls.hazard: The front fork on the ElliptiGO cycles can separate and the drive arm axles can detach during use, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using recalled ElliptiGO cycles until they have the fork upgraded with a safety retrofit and/or upgraded replacement drive arm axles installed. Consumers with affected cycles can contact ElliptiGO online at www.elliptigo.com/safety to locate the authorized repair center closest to them.
recalls.units: About 7,000 in the U.S. and 200 in Canada
recalls.description: The ElliptiGO 3C, 8C and 11R models are outdoor elliptical cycles used by adults for exercise. It is a scooter-like device that combines an elliptical trainer with a bicycle.
recalls.injuries: ElliptiGO has received one report of the fork separating and ten reports of the drive arm detaching.

recalls.title: Baja Motorsports Recalls Mini Bikes Due to Fall, Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Mini Bike
recalls.hazard: The front fork can separate from the wheel, posing fall and crash hazards to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled mini bikes and contact Baja Motorsports to schedule a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves Baja Motorsports MB200 gas-powered mini bikes manufactured from August 2010 through August 2012. The recalled mini bikes have a black frame with a black padded seat, a gas tank and fenders that are black, red or yellow, side reflectors…
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 13 reports of front forks separating from the wheel. Minor injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Club Car Recalls Golf and Transport Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Precedent golf and transport vehicles
recalls.hazard: Improper assembly can cause the front wheel spindles to crack causing the wheel to become loose affecting the steering, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Club Car is providing a free inspection and repair of the wheel hub retaining nut. The firm is contacting its customers directly.
recalls.description: The recalled vehicles include various sizes, models and colors of model year 2013 Precedent golf and transport vehicles used for short-distance transportation. The electric or gas powered vehicles seat two or four people.
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Giant Bicycle Recalls XtC Bicycles and Seatposts Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Giant brand bicycles and carbon seatposts
recalls.hazard: The bicycle seatposts on the affected bicycles and the after-market seatposts can crack, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumer should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and seatposts and contact a Giant Bicycle dealer for a free replacement seatpost.
recalls.description: This recall includes 2013 model year Giant XtC Advanced SL 29er 0 and 29er 1 series bicycles and 27.2 mm carbon fiber seatposts sold separately. The SL 29er 0 model bicycle is white, black and blue. The SL 29er 1 model is white, black and red.
recalls.injuries: Giant Bicycles received five reports of the bicycle seatposts breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Cannondale Recalls Slice RS Bikes Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: Cannondale Slice RS bicycles and framesets
recalls.hazard: The brake plates can loosen and break, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumer should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and return the bike to a Cannondale retailer for a free repair, a Cannondale Terramo helmet and Classic Jersey. Cannondale is contacting its customers directly.
recalls.description: This recall includes all 2013 model year Cannondale triathlon and time trial Slice RS bikes including the Black Edition, Ultegra and Ultegra Di2 bicycles and framesets. The Black Edition bikes come in black and the word Cannondale is in green on the top tube.
recalls.injuries: Cannondale received one report of a loose brake plate. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Stile Products Recalls Tern Folding Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Tern folding bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bike's frame can crack at the hinge on the top tube, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the bicycle and contact Stile Products or take the bike to an authorized dealer. Consumers will receive a free frame and have it installed at no cost.
recalls.description: The recall involves Eclipse S11i and Verge S11i, X10, X20 and X30h models of Tern brand folding bikes. The 24-inch wheel Eclipse model was sold in a silver/black color combination.
recalls.injuries: Stile Products has received two reports of incidents of the frame hinge cracking, resulting in minor scrapes and bruises.

recalls.title: Salsa Cycles Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Salsa Bicycle Forks
recalls.hazard: The bicycle fork can bend above the disc brake mount, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles equipped with the recalled Salsa Vaya and La Cruz bicycle forks and contact a Salsa dealer for a free inspection, replacement fork or a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves all Salsa Vaya bicycle forks stamped with the batch codes 2011 02 21, 2011 04 11, 2011 06 14 and 2011 09 09 and all Salsa La Cruz bicycle forks stamped with the batch codes 2011 03 01, 2011 04 08, 2011 05 30 and 2011 09 09.
recalls.injuries: Salsa Cycles has received eight reports of forks bending above the disc brake mount. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: GNU Snowboard Bindings Recalled by Mervin Manufacturing Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: GNU Snowboard Bindings
recalls.hazard: The ankle straps can break posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bindings and contact Mervin Manufacturing for instructions for receiving free replacement straps.
recalls.units: About 6,800 pairs in the U.S. and 1,200 in Canada
recalls.description: The recalled snowboard bindings include men's, youth, and women's sizes. The bindings attach to the snowboard with screws, and to the snowboard boot with straps with buckles. The brand name "GNU" is imprinted on the front of the straps or on the baseplate.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 30 reports of the binding straps breaking. No injuries were reported.

recalls.title: Surly Bikes Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Surly Pugsley Bicycle Forks
recalls.hazard: The bicycle fork can bend above the disc brake mount, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles equipped with the recalled Surly bicycle fork and contact a Surly dealer for a free inspection and replacement or a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves Surly Pugsley 100mm and 135mm bicycle forks made of tubular chromoly steel. "Surly" is printed on both legs of the fork. "Pugsley" is printed on the fork's packaging and on the frame of bikes with the recalled forks.
recalls.injuries: Surly Bikes has received one report of a fork bending above the disc brake mount. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Louisville Slugger OneX Fastpitch Softball Bats Recalled by Hillerich & Bradsby Due to Injury Hazard from Breakage
recalls.name: Louisville Slugger® OneX Fastpitch softball bat
recalls.hazard: The bat's barrel can separate from the handle during use and strike people nearby.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bat and contact Hillerich and Bradsby for a free replacement bat and the choice of an additional free item.
recalls.description: The recalled bats include all OneX style bats. The composite bat has a white and grey shell with blue and yellow lettering. "Louisville Slugger oneX" appears twice on the barrel, in yellow in one place and in blue lettering on the other side.
recalls.injuries: Approximately170 bat handle separations have been reported to the company. The company is aware of one report of a barrel from a broken bat hitting a player in…

recalls.title: 3T Design Recalls Cervélo Bicycles with Aura Pro Handlebars Due to Risk of Injury
recalls.name: Cervélo Bicycles with Aura Pro Handlebars
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's handlebar clamps can detach during riding causing the rider to lose control, posing a risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using their bicycles immediately and contact 3T Design to obtain a free repair kit that includes four replacement bolts and instructions. Consumers can follow the instructions to replace the handlebar's bolts or take the bicycle to a Cervélo authorized dealer for a free repair.
recalls.units: About 623 in the United States and 53 in Canada
recalls.description: The Aura Pro custom bicycle handlebars are original equipment on the 2013 Cervélo P-Series bicycles which come in black, gray and red color combinations.
recalls.injuries: 3T Design has received one report of an incident resulting in minor injuries.

recalls.title: Bell Sports Recalls BMX Bike Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury; Sold Exclusively at Toys R Us
recalls.name: Bell Full Throttle Bike Helmets
recalls.hazard: The buckle on the helmet's safety strap can release in an accident and allow the helmet to fall off the rider, posing a risk of head injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled helmets and contact Bell Sports for instructions on receiving a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves Bell Full Throttle, full coverage bicycle motocross (BMX) helmets with a chin bar. The all-black helmets have UPC code 035011 937052 and part number 1009159 printed on a label on the side of the helmet shell.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: WRSI Recalls Kayaking and Rafting Helmets Due to Head Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Whitewater Kayaking and Rafting Helmets
recalls.hazard: The chinstrap buckle can fail, posing a head injury hazard to users.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the helmets immediately and contact WRSI for a free replacement or full refund.
recalls.units: About 2,000 in the United States and 200 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves WRSI Moment and Trident models whitewater kayaking and rafting helmets. They have a black chinstrap with a black plastic buckle and were sold in sizes S/M and M/L. "WRSI" is printed under or on top of the helmet's visor.
recalls.injuries: WRSI is aware of 10 incidents of chinstrap failures. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Magura USA Recalls Bicycle Hydraulic Disc Brakes Due to Collision Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycle Hydraulic Disc Brakes
recalls.hazard: The brakes can fail in low temperatures, posing a collision hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding bicycles equipped with the recalled brakes and contact Magura USA for a free repair.
recalls.description: Magura MT 6 and MT 8 hydraulic disc brakes are being recalled. The brakes consist of a brake lever and master cylinder that attach to the handlebars, a hose that runs between the master cylinder and the caliper which attaches to the rear wheel.
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Yuba Bicycles Recalls Mundo Cargo Bikes Due to Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Cargo Bikes
recalls.hazard: Passengers' feet can get caught in the rear wheel, posing a foot injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled cargo bikes and contact Yuba Bicycles to receive free wheel covers/wheelskirts and have them installed at no cost.
recalls.description: The recalled bicycles are Mundo V4 cargo bikes. The 26-inch bicycles have steel frames, aluminum fenders on the front and rear wheels, and a wood utility deck mounted on the rear cargo rack. The bikes come in orange, black or blue.
recalls.injuries: Yuba Bicycles is aware of two reports of passengers having their feet caught in the rear wheel. No injuries were reported.

recalls.title: Dynacraft Recalls Hello Kitty City Motor Scooters Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Toys R Us
recalls.name: Motor Scooters with Hello Kitty graphics
recalls.hazard: The scooters can accelerate suddenly while in use, causing the rider to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the City Scooter, disconnect the battery and return it to the nearest Toys R Us store to receive a full refund or store credit.
recalls.description: This recall involves electric, battery-operated City Scooters that are pink and black with Hello Kitty graphics on the front panel, footboard and rear fenders. The scooters were manufactured between September 9, 2012 and December 3, 2012.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received nine reports of incidents of City Scooters accelerating unintentionally, including three with minor injuries that include a bloody nose…

recalls.title: Dynacraft Recalls Monster High City Motor Scooters Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
recalls.name: Motor Scooters with Monster High graphics
recalls.hazard: The scooters can accelerate suddenly while in use, causing the rider to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the City Scooter, disconnect the battery and return it to the nearest Walmart store to receive a full refund or store credit.
recalls.description: This recall involves electric, battery-operated City Scooters that are purple and black with Monster High graphics on the front panels, seat and rear fenders. The scooters were manufactured between October 5, 2012 and November 7, 2012.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received nine reports of incidents of City Scooters accelerating unintentionally, including three with minor injuries that include a bloody nose…

recalls.title: BRP Recalls Ski-Doo Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Ski-Doo® snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: The fuel pump inlet fitting can come into contact with the oil tank and break, leading to a fuel to leak, which poses a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled vehicles and contact a BRP dealer to schedule a free repair. BRP has notified registered consumers directly about this recall.
recalls.description: The snowmobile has the model name printed on the vehicle's side panel. The 2013 models included in the recall are: Name Engine Type Freeride™ 800R E-TEC Grand Touring LE 600HO E-TEC GSX® LE 600HO E-TEC GSX® SE 600HO E-TEC GSX® SE 800R E-TEC MX Z® TNT® 600HO…
recalls.injuries: The firm has received three reports of fires. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Club Car Recalls Golf and Transport Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Precedent golf and transport vehicles
recalls.hazard: The fuel hose could separate from the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should contact any Club Car dealer for a free inspection and repair of the fuel hose system. The firm is contacting consumers directly.
recalls.description: The recalled vehicles are model year 2013 gas-powered golf and transport vehicles used for short-distance transportation. The vehicles come in five models and colors and can be identified by model and serial number, which can be found on a plate above and to…
recalls.injuries: Club Car has received three reports of a fuel hose separating from the tank. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Sportspower Expands Trampoline Recall Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
recalls.name: Sportspower BouncePro 14' Trampolines
recalls.hazard: The enclosure netting surrounding these trampolines can break, allowing children to fall through the netting and be injured.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the trampolines and contact Sportspower to receive a replacement enclosure netting.
recalls.units: About 120,000 (92,000 units were recalled in May 2012)
recalls.description: This recall is an expansion of the May 2012 recall of brown tetlon netting to now include black tetlon netting. This involves Sportspower BouncePro 14' Trampolines with model TR-1686-TPR. UPC code 687064045552 or 687064042100 is printed on the product's box.
recalls.injuries: Sportspower has received an additional nine reports of the enclosure netting breaking since the May 2012 recall.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Specialized Bicycle Components Tarmac SL4 Crux Secteur Road Bicycles and Frame Sets
recalls.hazard: The steerer tube in the front fork can break, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bicycles and take them to an authorized dealer for free inspection and, if needed, a free repair.
recalls.description: The 2012 and 2013 model road bicycles and framesets come in various colors and have the brand name "Specialized" on the frame. The model name "Tarmac SL4," "Crux" or "Secteur" is also located on the frame.
recalls.injuries: Two incidents were reported, one involving a fall with facial injuries and lacerations requiring stitches.

recalls.title: Muddy Outdoors Recalls Climbing Sticks Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death
recalls.name: Muddy Outdoors Tree Climbing Sticks
recalls.hazard: The climbing sticks can break, posing risk of serious injury or death to users.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled climbing sticks and return them to Muddy Outdoors for a refund or a free replacement product.
recalls.description: The recalled Muddy Outdoors climbing sticks are used to climb trees. They consist of a 20-inch black center stick with tree cleats and fold-out steps on each end. A black and burnt orange-colored rope fastened by a cam cleat secures the stick to the tree.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received four reports of the climbing sticks breaking. There have been no reported injuries.

recalls.title: Bicycles Recalled by Wilier Triestina Due to Fall Hazard; Bicycle Fork's Steerer Tube Can Break
recalls.name: Izoard XP Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle fork's steerer tube can break while in use, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bicycles immediately and have an authorized Wilier bicycle dealer check for the serial number on the fork and, if it is included in the recall, the dealer will install a new Izoard replacement fork at no charge.
recalls.description: This recall involves Wilier Triestina model Izoard XP bicycles or framesets that were sold with carbon/alloy forks with serial numbers between LH0001 and LH4000. The serial number is located on the steerer tube of the fork, around six inches from the crown.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Norco Recalls Havoc Bicycles Due to Risk of Injury
recalls.name: 2011 Havoc Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle frame can crack at the joint where the top tube meets the down tube. A cracked tube can separate and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of injury or death.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bike and return it an authorized Norco dealer for a replacement.
recalls.description: This recall involves 2011 Havoc 24-inch and 26-inch bicycles. The 24-inch bicycles were sold in semi-matte grey and the 26-inch in semi-matte red. On some of the bicycles, "Norco" is printed on the firm's crest that is affixed to the head tube.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received three reports of cracked frames. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Trampolines Recalled by Sportspower Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Sports Authority
recalls.name: Trampolines
recalls.hazard: The trampoline's metal legs can move out of position and puncture the jumping area, posing a risk of injury, including deep, penetrating puncture wounds, cuts and bruises to children and adults on the trampoline.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled trampolines and contact Sportspower to receive a free repair kit.
recalls.description: This recall involves Sportspower Parkside model TR-14FT-COM trampolines. The trampolines are 14 feet in diameter and were sold with an enclosure net. The trampolines have blue or light blue fabric on the safety matting and enclosure pole sleeves.
recalls.injuries: Sportspower is aware of one incident of the trampoline leg separating from the frame while in use, causing the leg to puncture through the jumping surface.

recalls.title: Bike Friday Recalls Tikit Folding Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Tikit Folding Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The tikit bike's handlebar stem can break and cause the rider to lose control, posing a fall hazard to the consumer.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the bicycle and contact Bike Friday to schedule a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves all models of tikit brand folding bicycles. The 16-inch wheel custom bicycles were sold in various colors. The Bike Friday tikit brand decal is affixed to the bike frame.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received six reports of breaking handlebar stems, resulting in two reports of injuries including scrapes, bruises and a head laceration that…

recalls.title: Joss Rock Climbing Cam Units Recalled by Sierra Trading Post Due to a Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively by Sierra Trading Post
recalls.name: Joss rock climbing cam
recalls.hazard: The recalled cams can fail unexpectedly after being set, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product and return it to Sierra Trading Post for a full refund including shipping.
recalls.description: The Joss cam is a mechanical device placed in the crack of a rock to support a climber's weight. The cam is operated by a trigger that retracts the aluminum lobes, allowing the device to be placed and secured in the crack of a rock.
recalls.injuries: One incident reported in Europe. No deaths or injuries reported in the U.S.

recalls.title: Diamondback Bicycles Recalled Due to Fall or Crash Hazard
recalls.name: 2013 Diamondback Steilacoom RCX bicycles
recalls.hazard: Bicycles assembled with incorrect headset parts could cause the steerer tube to fail, causing the rider to lose control and fall or crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding their bicycle and take it to an authorized Diamondback dealer to have it inspected. Bicycles found to have the incorrect headset parts will have the fork replaced and assembled with the correct headset parts at no charge.
recalls.description: Bicycles included in the recall are the 2013 Diamondback Steilacoom RCX, which are black in color and sold in various sizes ranging from 50-cm to 59-cm. "RCX" is printed on the top tube of the bicycle. The bicycle is for use on or off-road.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: FLO Cycling Recalls Rim Tape Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycle Wheel Rim Tape
recalls.hazard: The rim tape can fail and break under pressure. When this happens, the inner tube of the bicycle can puncture or burst. This poses a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should contact FLO Cycling to receive a $5 refund for each wheel purchased. The firm is contacting consumers who purchased wheels with the recalled rim tape directly.
recalls.description: The rim tape is a yellow plastic strip that was provided for free with the purchase of FLO 60, FLO 90 and FLO DISC wheels. The number 700X18 A/V is printed on the tape.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received four reports of exploding inner tubes and flat tires. No injuries were reported.

recalls.title: ElliptiGO Recalls Elliptical Cycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: ElliptiGO 11R outdoor elliptical cycles
recalls.hazard: The drive arm on the ElliptiGO cycles can crack or break during use, posing a fall hazard to the user.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the ElliptiGO 11R cycles included in the recall immediately and contact the firm to receive free replacement drive arms to be installed by an authorized dealer.
recalls.description: The ElliptiGO 11R is an outdoor elliptical cycle used by adults for exercise. It is a scooter-like device that combines an elliptical trainer with a bicycle.
recalls.injuries: ElliptiGO has received three reports of the drive arm cracking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
recalls.name: Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The front fork can break, posing fall and injury hazards to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles and return them to an authorized Specialized retailer for the free installation of a free replacement fork.
recalls.description: This recall involves some 2008 and 2009 models women's and men's Globe model bicycles. Recalled models include the Globe Elite, Globe Sport, Globe Sport Disc, Globe Centrum Comp, Globe Centrum Elite, Globe City 6, Globe Vienna 3, Globe Vienna 3 Disc, Globe…
recalls.injuries: Specialized has received four reports of front forks breaking, resulting in facial fractures, head and shoulder injuries and cuts.

recalls.title: Club Car Recalls Golf Cars and Utility Vehicles Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Golf cars and utility vehicles
recalls.hazard: The fuel tank filler neck can crack and allow fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled vehicles immediately and contact Club Car for a free replacement fuel tank. The firm is directly contacting consumers who purchased the vehicles.
recalls.description: This recall involves the following 2012 Club Car gasoline and diesel golf cars and utility vehicles. The model and serial numbers are located on a decal above the passenger's side floor board. "Club Car" is printed on the front of the vehicles.
recalls.injuries: Club Car has received 10 reports of incidents involving fuel tank filler necks cracking. No injuries or fires have been reported.

recalls.title: Meijer Stores Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Various models of Huffy, Iron Horse, Mongoose, Northwoods, Pacific, Razor and Schwinn bicycles
recalls.hazard: Pedals on the bicycles can loosen or detach during use, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and return them to any Meijer store for a full refund or a replacement bicycle of the same type and value. Consumers will also receive a $10 store coupon.
recalls.description: This recall involves two-wheeled youth and adult Huffy, Iron Horse, Mongoose, Northwoods, Pacific, Razor, and Schwinn bicycles measuring 20" or more. They were assembled on-site at Meijer stores by Serv-U-Success of Grandville, Mich.
recalls.injuries: There are 29 reports of pedals detaching or coming loose during use, including 16 reports of minor injuries.

recalls.title: Shimano Recalls to Repair PRO VIBE Bicycle Handlebars Due to a Fall Hazard
recalls.name: PRO VIBE Carbon bicycle handlebars
recalls.hazard: The recalled handlebars can break during riding, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles with the recalled handlebars and contact Shimano for information about obtaining a free replacement from an authorized retailer in their area.
recalls.description: The recalled bicycle handlebars, intended for high-end road racing bikes, are compact and drop-shaped . The handlebars are sold separately and they have two labels with "Pro Vibe" logo directly printed on them.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Expands Recall of Bike Brake Levers Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycle Brake Levers
recalls.hazard: The adjuster cap and brake cable can slide out of position and make the brakes non-operational. This can cause a rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding modules equipped with TL-83 brake levers and return the levers or modules to an authorized Specialized Bicycle Components retailer for free replacement brake levers.
recalls.units: About 100 (about 600 of the 2010 and 2011 Shiv Modules and 2012 Shiv TT modules were recalled in April 2012)
recalls.description: This recall includes Tektro TL-83 brake levers sold on 2012 S-Works Shiv bicycle frame modules, 2012 S-Works Shiv TT bicycle frame modules, and sold as aftermarket service parts for these modules.
recalls.injuries: Specialized is aware of one incident worldwide in which the rider lost the function of both brakes.

recalls.title: Eecycleworks Recalls Bicycle Brakes Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycle brakes
recalls.hazard: The bridge of the brakes can crack, posing a fall hazard to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding bicycles with the recalled brakes and contact eecycleworks or the retailer where they purchased the brakes for a free replacement bridge.
recalls.description: This recall involves "eebrake" model aftermarket brakes sold between September, 2008 and March, 2011 for use on adult road racing bicycles.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received two reports of brakes cracking, one of which resulted in scrapes and bruises.

recalls.title: Kickboard USA Recalls Children's Scooter Due to Laceration Hazard
recalls.name: Scooter
recalls.hazard: The one-piece plastic platform that covers the front wheel base can break, posing a laceration hazard to children.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take this product away from children and contact Kickboard USA for a free replacement product.
recalls.description: This recall is for the three-wheeled Mini Micro scooter for children ages 3-5. The scooter was sold in the following colors: blue, orange, pink and aqua.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Club Car Recalls Golf and Transport Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Golf cars and transport vehicles
recalls.hazard: The fuel hose can separate from the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled golf cars and transport vehicles and contact Club Car for a free inspection and repair of the fuel hose system. The firm is contacting its customers directly.
recalls.description: The recalled vehicles are various sizes, models and colors of 2012 gas-powered golf and transport vehicles used for short-distance transportation. The vehicles can be identified by model and serial number.
recalls.injuries: Club Car has received one report of a fuel hose separating from the tank. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Trampolines Recalled by Panline USA Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Alex ® Model 786X Little Jumpers Trampoline
recalls.hazard: The handlebar can break, causing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product immediately and contact the firm for instructions on receiving a replacement trampoline.
recalls.description: The product is a small, toddler-sized trampoline with a yellow and blue colored handlebar over the top of the trampoline for toddlers to hold on to while jumping.
recalls.injuries: None.

recalls.title: Big Cat Human Powered Vehicles Recalls Bicycle Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Catbike Musashi recumbent bicycle
recalls.hazard: The bicycle frame can crack, which can cause the rider to lose control and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycle and contact a Catbike dealer for a free frame replacement.
recalls.description: This recall involves model year 2010 Catbike Musashi recumbent bicycles. The bicycles were sold in the following colors: black, white, silver, yellow, orange, red, lime green, pink, blue, candy purple, candy red, candy green, candy blue and sparkle orange.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Nautilus Recalls Bowflex Dumbbells Due to Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Bowflex® SelectTech® 1090 Dumbbells
recalls.hazard: The weight selector dial on the units can fail, causing weight plates to fall when the dumbbell is lifted from its cradle, posing an injury hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled dumbbells immediately and contact Nautilus for a free repair kit.
recalls.description: These black steel dumbbells are sold in pairs and can have a weight capacity of 10 to 90 pounds. The word 'BOWFLEX' is written in grey along the top of each handle.
recalls.injuries: Nautilus Inc. has received 16 reports of the weight selector dial failing, including three reports of injuries to the user's foot or leg.

recalls.title: Bicycle Stems Recalled by Ridley Bikes Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 4ZA Threadless Carbon Bicycle Handlebar Stems
recalls.hazard: The bicycle handlebar stems can crack or break, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using their bicycles and contact the bicycle retailers where the stems were purchased to obtain a free replacement stem. Other bicycle shops can handle the replacement process by contacting the manufacturer's current distributor, Quality Bicycle Products, Inc.
recalls.description: The recall involves all 4ZA 31.8 threadless bicycle handlebar stems sold as individual aftermarket components. The stems are black and have the words "4ZA Cycling Performance" painted on the carbon extension between the steerer clamp and handlebar clamp.
recalls.injuries: The firm received one report of a handlebar stem breaking resulting in minor injuries.

recalls.title: Aqua-Leisure Recalls Children's Trampolines Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Toys "R" Us Stores
recalls.name: First Fitness® Trampolines with Handlebars
recalls.hazard: Metal fatigue can cause the handlebar to break away during use, posing a risk of laceration from exposed metal surfaces or other injury from a fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled trampolines from children and contact Aqua-Leisure's recall hotline for a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves First Fitness Kid's First trampolines with handlebars. The child-size toy trampolines have a red and blue metal handlebar, a blue nylon deck guard and a black jumping deck. "First Fitness" is embossed on the jumping deck in white letters.
recalls.injuries: Aqua-Leisure has received four reports of handlebars breaking from the metal connection joint during use. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Climbing Ropes Recalled by Porter Athletic Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Porter Athletic Climbing Ropes
recalls.hazard: The climbing rope can slip through the clamp that connects at the top, posing a fall hazard for climbers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these recalled climbing ropes. Porter Athletic is repairing the recalled ropes at no cost. Shipping will be provided free of charge to the consumer. The firm is contacting customers directly.
recalls.description: This recall involves two models of Porter Athletic climbing ropes.Model number 00118 is a white soft dacron rope with vinyl boot end sold in 12', 16', 20' and 24' lengths.
recalls.injuries: Porter has received three reports of the rope slipping through the clamp, including one that resulted in back and wrist injuries.

recalls.title: Salsa Cycles Recalls Bicycle Racks Due to a Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Salsa Minimalist bicycle racks
recalls.hazard: The L-shaped mounting straps used to attach the bicycle rack to the front of the bicycle can break and cause the rack to fall while the bicycle is in use, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately remove the recalled bicycle racks and contact an authorized Salsa dealer for inspection, re-mounting or refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves all Salsa Minimalist bicycle racks sold after January 2011. The racks are made of tubular aluminum with a black or silver finish, and can be installed on either the front or rear of a bicycle.
recalls.injuries: Salsa Cycles has received two reports of bicycle racks breaking at the mounting straps, resulting in minor injuries from falls.

recalls.title: Reported Death, Severe Neck Injuries Prompt Recall of Banzai Inflatable Pool Slides Sold by Walmart and Toys R Us
recalls.name: Inflatable Banzai Falls in-ground Pool Slides
recalls.hazard: During use, the slide can deflate, allowing the user to hit the ground underneath the slide and become injured. The slide is also unstable and can topple over in both still and windy conditions and carries inadequate warnings and instructions.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the product and return it to the nearest Walmart or Toys R Us for a full refund. Consumers can also cut the two safety warning notices out of the slide and just return that portion.
recalls.description: The recall involves Banzai in-ground pool water slides designed for use with in-ground pools. The vinyl slides have a blue base, yellow sliding mat and an arch going over the top of the slide.
recalls.injuries: A 29-year-old Colorado mother died in Andover, Mass. after fracturing her neck going down a Banzai in-ground pool water slide which had been placed over the…

recalls.title: Trampolines Recalled by Sportspower Limited Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
recalls.name: Sportspower BouncePro 14' Trampolines
recalls.hazard: The netting surrounding these trampolines can break, allowing children to fall through the netting and be injured.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the trampolines immediately and contact Sportspower to receive replacement black netting for the trampoline.
recalls.description: The recall involves the Sportspower BouncePro 14' Trampolines with brown mesh netting. UPC codes 68706404210, and 68706404244 are printed on the trampoline box.
recalls.injuries: Sportspower has received 17 reports of the net breaking, resulting in 11 injuries including broken bones, back and neck injuries, and contusions.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bike Brake Levers Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycle Brake Levers
recalls.hazard: The adjuster cap and brake cable can slide out of position and make the brakes non-operational. This can cause a rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding bicycle frame modules equipped with TL-83 brake levers and return the levers or modules to authorized Specialized Bicycle Components retailers for free replacement brake levers.
recalls.description: The recalled products are Tektro TL-83 brake levers. TL-83 levers are designed exclusively for use with aerodynamic handlebars (aerobars) sold as original equipment on 2010 and 2011 S-Works Shiv bicycle frame modules and 2012 S-Works Shiv TT bicycle frame…
recalls.injuries: Specialized is aware of one incident worldwide in which the rider lost the function of both brakes.

recalls.title: GT, Giant and Trek Bicycles with SR Suntour Suspension Forks Recalled by SR Suntour Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: GT, Giant and Trek Bicycles with SR Suntour Suspension Forks
recalls.hazard: The suspension fork's internal support tubes can break and cause the rider to lose control, fall and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using bicycles with these forks immediately and return the bicycles to any authorized GT, Giant or Trek dealer for a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves the following GT, Giant and Trek bicycles with SR Suntour suspension forks. "SR Suntour" and the date code are printed on the back of the fork crown.
recalls.injuries: SR Suntour has received 12 reports of incidents with the suspension forks, including two injuries involving a laceration and a chipped tooth.

recalls.title: Additional Fire Incidents Prompts Baja Motorsports to Reannounce Dirt Bike Recall
recalls.name: Baja Motorsports DR50, DR70 Baja Dirt Bikes
recalls.hazard: The fuel tank can leak, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled dirt bikes and contact Baja Motorsports to schedule a free repair.
recalls.units: About 4,300 (This recall was first announced in March 2011)
recalls.description: This recall involves all model DR50 and DR70 Baja dirt bikes with vehicle identification number (VIN) beginning with "L98," the letter "B" as the 10th character of the VIN and having a yellow dot or line marked on or near the VIN.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 16 reports of fires from leaking fuel, including two reports of minor burns to consumer's legs and one report of a minor burn to a…

recalls.title: Public Bikes Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2010 through 2012 Model Year Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The pedals can crack and break, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the recalled bicycles and contact Public Bikes or an authorized Public Bikes dealer for free replacement pedals. The recalled pedals have a black spindle, the replacement pedal spindles are chrome.
recalls.description: This recall involves 18 models of women's and men's Public Bikes. The bicycles are various colors and sizes. "Public" or "Publicbikes.com" is printed on either the bicycle chain guard or the rear fender.
recalls.injuries: Public Bikes has received 24 reports of pedals cracking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Todson Recalls Bicycle Child Carrier Seats Due to Laceration and Fingertip Amputation Hazards
recalls.name: Topeak Babyseat™ II Bicycle Carrier Seats
recalls.hazard: A child can place his or her fingers in the opening at the grab bar's hinge mechanism. When the consumer lifts the grab bar to remove the child from the seat, the child's fingertips can be caught in the hinge mechanism, posing a laceration and fingertip…
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled carrier seats and contact Todson to receive a free hinge cover retrofit kit.
recalls.description: This recall involves Topeak Babyseat II bicycle carrier seats with model numbers TCS2100, TCS2101 and TCS2102. Model numbers are printed on the product's packaging.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received two reports of incidents including near amputations that resulted in stitches and a crushed finger.

recalls.title: Lacrosse Helmets Recalled by Easton Sports Due to Facial Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Easton Raptor Lacrosse Helmets
recalls.hazard: The chin bar can break, causing the wearer to suffer a jaw or facial injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these helmets immediately and contact Easton Sports for a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves all Easton Raptor Lacrosse Helmets. "Easton" is printed on either side of the back of the helmet and on the jaw strap. "RAPTOR" is printed low on the back of the helmet in the center.
recalls.injuries: Easton Sports has received six reports of the chin bar cracking or breaking on impact with a ball or lacrosse stick, including one laceration injury.

recalls.title: Bon Hiver Recalls Freebase Snowboard Bindings Due To Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Snowboard Bindings
recalls.hazard: The binding's base plate can fracture from impact during use, posing a fall hazard to snowboarders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bindings and return them to Bon Hiver for a free repair and a 20 percent refund of the purchase price.
recalls.description: The recalled products are Bon Hiver Freebase snowboard bindings in the following models: 11 Series - Assault or Infrared, 13 Series - Arsenal or Hellfire and 18 Series - Stealth or Storm. The bindings are sold in pairs.
recalls.injuries: Bon Hiver has received two reports of the base plates fracturing during use. There have been no reports of injuries or property damage

recalls.title: Gore Recalls Ride-On Bicycle Brake Cables Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycle Brake Cables for Road Bikes
recalls.hazard: When the brake cables are installed on Campagnolo® style brake levers, they can detach, causing the brakes to fail and posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using their bicycles with these recalled brake cables if they are installed on a Campagnolo-style brake lever and contact Gore for a free replacement cable kit. Gore will reimburse consumers for the repair cost.
recalls.units: About 9,700 in the United States and about 200 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves GORE® Ride On® Low Friction System brake cables for road bikes and GORE® Ride On® Professional System brake cables for road bikes. The cables are silver and are available with housings in black, white, blue or red.
recalls.injuries: The company is aware of one report of a brake cable detaching. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Fuji Recalls Women's Cruiser Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Fuji Saratoga Women's Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's frame can break in the center of the downtube during use, causing the rider to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding the recalled bicycle immediately and return it to any authorized Fuji Bicycle dealers for a free replacement frame.
recalls.description: The recalled bicycles are Fuji women's cruiser bicycles. The 2008 through 2010 models Saratoga 1.0, Saratoga 2.0, Saratoga 3.0 and Saratoga 4.0 are included. The bicycles are various colors.
recalls.injuries: The company is aware of 12 reports of bicycle frames breaking, including two injuries, a head laceration requiring 20 stitches and scrapes and bruises.

recalls.title: Shimano Recalls PRO Atherton Mountain Bike Handlebar Stems Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Mountain Bicycle Handlebar Stem
recalls.hazard: The bolts holding the front plate of the stem to the stem body can be pulled out of the threads while the bike is being ridden, causing the rider to lose control of the bike and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles with PRO Atherton handlebar stems and take them to an authorized retailer to determine if the stem on their bike is subject to the recall. Authorized retailers will replace 18mm bolts with 21mm bolts free of charge.
recalls.units: 213 in the United States; 83 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves PRO Atherton direct mount bicycle handlebar stems with the model number PRSS0049 and supplied from October 2009 to November 2010. The stem consists of a metal alloy body and front plate and four alloy bolts.
recalls.injuries: Shimano has received one report of an incident in which the rider fell and received torso and arm injuries.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Expands Recall of Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2012 Bicycles with Advanced Group carbon forks
recalls.hazard: The brake component housed within the bicycle's carbon fork can disengage from the fork and allow the brake assembly to contact the wheel spokes while rotating, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles and return them to an authorized Specialized retailer for a free repair or replacement carbon fork.
recalls.description: This recall involves the 2012 Tricross Sport and 2012 Tricross Comp model bicycles. The bicycles are various colors and have the brand name "Specialized" on the lower front frame tube. The model name "Tricross Sport" or "Tricross Comp" is on the top tube.
recalls.injuries: None

recalls.title: Columbia ParCar Recalls for Repair Golf, Service, Utility Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Golf, service and utility vehicles
recalls.hazard: The lower steering yoke can loosen where it attaches to the steering rack and pinion, causing the driver to lose control of the vehicle and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should contact local ParCar dealer for a free inspection and repair as required.
recalls.description: The recalled items are 2009, 2010 and 2011 Columbia ParCar golf carts, low-speed service and utility vehicles. They are 36- or 48-volt electric vehicles manufactured from July 1, 2008 through June 30, 2011.
recalls.injuries: No injuries were reported.

recalls.title: Bicycle Handlebars Recalled by Euro Asia Imports; Handlebars Can Break Resulting in Loss of Control and Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycle Handlebars
recalls.hazard: The recalled bicycle handlebars can break while the user is riding the bike, resulting in loss of control and a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled handlebars and contact Euro Asia Imports to receive free replacement handlebars.
recalls.units: About 2,000 in the United States and 70 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves Nitto aluminum bicycle handlebars with model number B259AA. They were sold in the following colors: red, blue, black, gold, green, pink and silver. "NITTO" and "B259" are printed at the end of the handlebars.
recalls.injuries: Two incidents of the handlebars breaking have been reported, including one involving a fall and a cut to the rider's leg.

recalls.title: Giant Bicycle Recalls Two Models; Forks Can Break Causing Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2012 Model Year Giant Defy Advanced and Avail Advanced Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The fork can crack, posing a fall hazard to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the recalled bicycles and contact any authorized Giant Bicycle dealer for a free inspection and replacement of the fork.
recalls.description: This recall involves all 2012 model year men's Giant Defy Advanced 0, 1 and 2 model bicycles and the women's Giant Avail Advanced 0, 1, and 2 model bicycles. "Giant" and the model name are printed on the bicycle. The bicycles are various colors and sizes.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Chariot Carriers Recalls Child Bicycle Trailers and Conversion Kits Due to Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Chariot bicycle trailers and bicycle trailer conversion kits
recalls.hazard: The bicycle trailer's hitch mechanisms can crack and break, causing the trailer to detach from the bicycle. This poses an injury hazard to children in the bicycle trailer.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycle trailers and bicycle trailer conversion kits and contact Chariot Carriers for a free repair kit which the consumer can install.
recalls.units: About 44,000 bicycle trailers and 70,000 bicycle trailer conversion kits
recalls.description: Chariot Carriers convert to strollers, jogging strollers and bike, hike or ski trailers. This recall involves Chariot bicycle trailers and bicycle trailer conversion kits.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 24 incident reports worldwide, three of which occurred in the United States, involving the bicycle trailers and the conversion kits.

recalls.title: Bicycle Helmets Recalled by Triple Eight Distribution Due to Risk of Head Injury
recalls.name: Bicycle helmets for children and youth
recalls.hazard: Product testing demonstrated that these helmets do not comply with CPSC safety standards for impact resistance. Consumers could suffer impact head injuries in a fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product immediately and contact Triple Eight for a full refund.
recalls.description: The recalled items are multi-purpose helmets also sold for use as bicycle helmets. Little Tricky helmets are marketed for children and youth, and feature a large Little Tricky logo on both sides of the helmet.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: E-Z-GO Recalls Golf Cars, Shuttles and Off-Road Utility Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: TXT golf cars, Cushman shuttle vehicles and Bad Boy off-road utility vehicles
recalls.hazard: The threaded end of the rack rod ball joint can break and the ball joint can become displaced, causing the driver to lose steering control. This can result in a crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled vehicles and contact E-Z-GO or an authorized dealer for a free repair. E-Z-GO and E-Z-GO dealers are contacting known owners.
recalls.description: The recalled vehicles are gas- and electric-powered, four-wheeled vehicles with bench seats for the driver and passengers. The following models are included: Model Serial Number E-Z-GO TXT Fleet golf cars 2748187 thru 2770316 E-Z-GO Freedom TXT golf cars…
recalls.injuries: The firm is aware of 71 reports of the ball joint breaking, 13 of which resulted in the ball joint displacing. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Club Car Recalls Golf Cars Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Golf cars
recalls.hazard: The fuel tank seam can separate and allow fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled golf cars and contact Club Car for a free inspection and replacement of the fuel tank. The firm is directly contacting consumers who purchased the golf cars.
recalls.description: This recall involves following 2011 Precedent golf cars. The model and serial numbers are located above the passenger's side floor board. "Club Car" is printed on the front of the golf cars.
recalls.injuries: Club Car has received three reports of incidents involving fuel tank seams splitting. No injuries or fires have been reported.

recalls.title: Nautilus Recalls Schwinn Elliptical Exercise Equipment Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Elliptical Exercise Trainer
recalls.hazard: The foot plates can detach from the machine during use, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled models immediately and contact Nautilus for a free repair kit that includes an extended warranty.
recalls.description: Elliptical exercise trainer equipment sold under the model name Schwinn 460. The machine is 73 inches tall and 54 inches long. It is made of gray anodized aluminum with two moving and two fixed handlebars all with black rubberized padding.
recalls.injuries: Nautilus has received nine reports of foot plates detaching or breaking during use. One incident resulted in a consumer striking his knee.

recalls.title: Bicycles Recalled by Trek Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Trek 2012 FX and District bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bolt that secures the seat saddle clamp to the seat post can break posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding the bicycles immediately and contact an authorized Trek dealer for a free replacement bolt.
recalls.description: The bicycles affected by this recall include the following models: Model Year 2012: Trek 7.2 FX, 7.3 FX, 7.4 FX, AND 7.5 FX; District, and 9th District bicycle models: WSD, Livestrong and Disc models.The model name is found on the bicycle's frame.
recalls.injuries: Trek has received four reports of incidents with one injury involving a broken tooth and lip injury.

recalls.title: Bridgeway Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle chain can break, causing a rider to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycle and contact the company for a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves "NEXT"-branded men's 26-inch hybrid bicycles. The bicycles are red or orange. "Power X" and "Suspension" are printed on the frame. Model numbers LBH2611M and LBH2611M2 are included in this recall.
recalls.injuries: The firm is aware of 11 reports of incidents, including nine reports of injuries, including lacerations and contusions.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles with Advanced Group carbon forks
recalls.hazard: The brake component housed within the bicycle's carbon fork can disengage from the fork and allow the brake assembly to contact the wheel spokes while rotating, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles and return them to an authorized Specialized retailer for a free repair or replacement carbon fork.
recalls.description: This recall involves the following nine, 2011 model year bicycles with Advanced Group carbon forks: Sirrus Expert, Sirrus Comp, Sirrus Elite, Vita Expert, Vita Comp, Vita Elite, Vita Elite Step Thru, Tricross Sport, Tricross, and Tricross Comp.
recalls.injuries: The company has received two reports of the brake component disengaging from the carbon fork. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Weehoo Recalls Bike Trailers Due to Fall and Crash Hazards
recalls.name: Weehoo iGo Bicycle Pedal Trailers
recalls.hazard: The receiver on the trailer's seat post hitch can crack and cause the trailer to detach, posing fall and crash hazards to the child in the seat.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled iGo trailers and contact Weehoo for the repair. Consumers will receive a steel reinforcement sleeve to be installed over the receiver.
recalls.description: This recall involves 2011 Weehoo iGo bicycle trailers manufactured between April 2011 and July 2011. The trailer has a steel frame with an adjustable seat for passengers 38 to 52 inches tall, two pedals with straps, an enclosed sprocket and chain, a 20-inch…
recalls.injuries: CPSC and Weehoo have received one report of the trailer's receiver cracking while in use. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Ski Helmets Recalled by Swix Sport USA due to Head Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Uvex Funride Ski Helmets
recalls.hazard: The helmet provides insufficient shock absorption and resistance to penetration, posing a head injury hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product immediately and return it to the store where purchased for a full refund or store credit.
recalls.description: Uvex Funride ski helmets come in two adult sizes XS-M, and L-XL. Individual sizing is adjusted by a small dial located at the rear of the helmet. The helmets feature a chin strap, ear protection and the word "Uvex" printed toward the back of the helmet.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Mizuno USA Inc. Recalls Baseball and Softball Gloves Due to Presence of Mold
recalls.name: Baseball and Softball Gloves
recalls.hazard: Some gloves were found to contain a variety of molds that could cause respiratory or other infections in individuals with chronic health problems, or in individuals who have impaired immune systems.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the gloves and contact Mizuno USA to receive a full refund.
recalls.description: The recalled items are leather Mizuno baseball and softball gloves. The gloves have a sewn-in white label on the heel of the glove with the words "Made in Vietnam" and the model number.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Club Car Recalls Golf Cars and Hospitality, Utility and Transport Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Golf cars and hospitality, utility and transport vehicles
recalls.hazard: The brake pedal mounting blocks can crack and separate, resulting in a loss of braking ability. This can result in a crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled Club Cars and contact the firm to receive free brake pedal replacement mounting blocks. Club Car is contacting all known owners of the recalled vehicles.
recalls.units: About 800 (This recall was first announced in November 2010)
recalls.description: The recalled vehicles are model 2011 DS golf cars and hospitality, utility and transport vehicles used for short-distance transportation. The Club Car has various models, colors and sizes including 2 to 6 passenger seating vehicles.
recalls.injuries: Club Car has received no reports of brake pedal mounting blocks breaking in the field. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Quality Bicycle Products Recalls Civia Bicycle Racks Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Carrier rack for mounting over front bicycle wheel
recalls.hazard: The bicycle rack's mounting bracket can crack or break. When this happens, the rack can fall onto the bicycle's front wheel, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should remove this rack from their bicycles immediately and contact the store where purchased for a full refund or replacement.
recalls.description: This recall involves Civia Loring bicycle racks. They have black aluminum tubing with bamboo panels and mount to the bicycle's front fork. The word "Civia" is printed on the rack's side panels.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received one report of a rack mounting bracket breaking while the rider was on the bicycle, resulting in minor cuts.

recalls.title: Bicycle Helmets Recalled by Bell Sports Due to Head Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Full-face bicycle helmets
recalls.hazard: The plastic buckle that connects the chin straps can fail, causing the helmet to come off the wearer's head. This poses a head injury hazard to riders in the event of a fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the helmets immediately and contact Bell Sports for a replacement or refund.
recalls.units: About 31,100 in the United States, and about 2,500 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves Bell Exodus full-face helmets with a plastic buckle on the chinstrap and model and part numbers listed below. The helmets have an angled visor and were sold in youth size.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received one report of a buckle failing during an accident, resulting in an injury that required stitches below the wearer's eye.

recalls.title: Children's Scooters Recalled by Kiddieland Due to Laceration Hazard
recalls.name: Lights and Sounds Children's Scooters
recalls.hazard: A child's finger can get caught in the hinge mechanism between the steering column and the platform, posing a laceration hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled scooters away from children and contact Kiddieland for a free repair kit.
recalls.units: About 16,000 in the United States and 700 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves three models of Kiddieland "Lights and Sounds" three-wheeled scooters including a red Spiderman, a blue Thomas & Friends™ and a pink girl's scooter. The scooters have buttons on the handle that play music and sounds.
recalls.injuries: CPSC and Kiddieland have received two reports of children whose fingers got caught in the hinge mechanism and required stitches.

recalls.title: Lithium-Ion Batteries Used with Bicycle Lights Recalled by GeoManGear Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Lithium-Ion batteries used with Magicshine bicycle lights
recalls.hazard: The lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled batteries. The company is notifying all known consumers. Consumers who have purchased the recalled batteries from GeoManGear and have not been contacted should visit www.MagicshineBatteryRecall.com to register to receive a free replacement battery.
recalls.units: About 16,600 in the United States and 1,500 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves Magicshine Series I and Series II lithium-ion batteries. The batteries were sold with bicycle light sets with the following models: Magicshine 900 Lumen (MJ-808), 1400 Lumen (MJ-816) and Tail light (MJ818).
recalls.injuries: The company has received three reports of batteries overheating and causing minor fires and property damage. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Rogue Fitness Barbell Brackets Recalled by Coulter Ventures Due to Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Rogue Fitness Barbell Brackets
recalls.hazard: The weld between the bracket and the pin that holds the barbell bracket in place on a weightlifting rack can break, causing the weights to fall, and posing an injury hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled barbell brackets and contact Coulter to receive free replacement brackets.
recalls.description: This recall involves Rogue Fitness J-Cup brackets used to hold barbells on weightlifting racks. The black metal brackets are used with the Rogue Fitness SPX Squat Press Stand, R-3 Racks, R-4 Racks and Infinity Rigs.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received three reports of the weld between the bracket and the pin breaking, including one report of a consumer who received a sprained wrist.

recalls.title: Rocky Mountain Bicycles Recalled by Procycle Due to Fall Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Rocky Mountain Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The front fork steering tube can break, posing a fall injury hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately and contact Procycle with your serial number to determine if it is included in the recall and to arrange for a free replacement of the fork.
recalls.description: The recalled bicycles have Rocky Mountain Bicycle printed on the frame. Only bicycles with certain serial numbers, located on the bottom side of the bicycle, are included in this recall.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received four reports of injuries, including three reports of cuts and scrapes and one report of a broken wrist.

recalls.title: Baja Motorsports Recalls Dirt Bikes Sold Exclusively at Pep Boys Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
recalls.name: Dirt Bikes
recalls.hazard: Fuel can leak from the fuel tank, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled dirt bikes and contact Baja Motorsports to schedule a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves all model DR50 and DR70 Baja dirt bikes with VIN numbers beginning with "L98." The model number and VIN are located on the product data plate, which is located on the side of the "goose neck" (where the handle bars meet the body of the…
recalls.injuries: The firm has received six reports of fires from fuel leakage including one report of minor burns to a consumer's legs.

recalls.title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2011 Felt Adult bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's fork can break, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact their local Felt Bicycles dealer to receive a free inspection and repair.
recalls.description: The recall includes all 2011 Felt F3, F4, F5 and F75 bicycles with carbon fiber frames and carbon fiber forks. - 2011 F3 - These bicycles are satin carbon/satin white with red decals. - 2011 F4 - These bicycles are satin carbon/satin white with grey decals.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: REI Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Novara Fusion Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The alloy steerer tube could separate from the fork causing the rider to lose control, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the bicycles and contact their local REI store or the REI customer service center to arrange for a replacement fork to be installed free of charge.
recalls.description: This recall involves Novara Fusion bicycles with serial numbers U95Y07321, U96Y28393, or in the sequential range of the last four digits U96Y28876 through U96Y29128. Serial numbers are located on the underside of the bike.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received one report of a steerer tube detaching. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Snow Bikes Recalled by Tech 4 Kids Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: OUTER EDGE Snow Bikes
recalls.hazard: The front ski can crack or break, causing the snow bike to stop suddenly and posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled snow bikes and return them to the store where purchased for a full refund.
recalls.description: The recall includes OUTER EDGE brand Snow MX-Ski-Doo® and the Snow MX-X Games™ snow bikes. The Snow MX-Ski-Doo snow bike is yellow and black with "Ski-Doo" printed on the steel frame and on the front ski.
recalls.injuries: Tech 4 Kids has received three reports of consumers falling off the recalled snow bikes and sustaining injuries as a result of the defective front ski cracking…

recalls.title: Marker Völkl USA and Kästle Recall Ski Bindings Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Marker and Kästle Twin Cam 12.0 ski bindings
recalls.hazard: Steel springs in the heel pieces of the bindings could break, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these recalled ski bindings and return Marker bindings to a Marker authorized retailer or return Kästle bindings to a Kästle authorized retailer for a free replacement heel binding. Consumers should bring their ski boots to be sure that the replacement bindings are adjusted correctly.
recalls.description: This recall includes the following 2010-2011 model year Marker and Kästle Twin Cam ski bindings with maximum release/retention settings of 12.0.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Trimmers/Brushcutters Recalled by STIHL Incorporated Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
recalls.name: STIHL FS 310 Bike Handle Trimmer/Brushcutter
recalls.hazard: Vibration from the ignition module may cause the trimmer head to loosen and detach from the mounting, posing an injury hazard.
recalls.remedy: STIHL informed purchasers for whom they had addresses directly by letter after April 15, 2010. Consumers should stop using this trimmer/brushcutter immediately and take it to an authorized STIHL dealer for a new ignition module, which will be installed at no cost to the consumer.
recalls.description: The recalled bike handle trimmer/brushcutter has "STIHL" printed on the engine head. The model number FS 310 is located in two places, on the shaft and on the flywheel housing below the starter grip.
recalls.injuries: The company received three reports of incidents and no reports of injuries.

recalls.title: Seattle Bike Supply Recalls Redline Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Redline D640 Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The head tube can separate from the frame, causing the rider to lose control and fall. This poses a risk of serious injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact a local Redline bicycle dealer to receive a free frame replacement.
recalls.description: This recall involves all 2008 Redline D640 bicycles. The bicycles were sold in black and have aluminum frames. "REDLINE" is written down the frame's tube. The model number is written on the frame's top tube.
recalls.injuries: Seattle Bikes is aware of eight reports of head tubes separating from the frame, including four reports of minor scrapes and cuts.

recalls.title: Full Speed Ahead Crank Sets Used By Numerous Bicycle Manufacturers Recalled Due To Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Full Speed Ahead BB30 Gossamer crank sets installed on numerous makes of bicycles
recalls.hazard: If the fixing bolt is over-tightened on the non-drive crank arm, the bolt shoulder can crack or break. If this occurs, the non-drive arm can fall off the bicycle causing the rider to crash and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles that have the recalled crank arm sets and return bicycle to the dealer. The dealer will install the new non-drive crank arm free of charge.
recalls.description: A crank set is the component of the bicycle that the chain and pedals attach to for pedaling. The recalled models are either painted black with "Gossamer" printed in white on the arm or white with "Gossamer" printed in black on the arm.
recalls.injuries: Full Speed Ahead has received 11 reports of incidents, including two cases where injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: BRP Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Explosion Hazard
recalls.name: Ski-Doo® Snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: Electrostatic changes can accumulate and spark in the fuel tank when the engine is left idling, posing an explosion hazard that could result in serious injuries or death.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these vehicles immediately and contact any Ski-Doo dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repair.
