Registered owners have been directly notified about this recall by mail. All models already repaired under previous recalls due to laceration hazard from projectiles, fire hazard, or explosion must be repaired again.
recalls.description: This recall involves Ski-Doo® model names listed below. Model names are located on the side panel. Model Year Name Color 2005 Expedition TUV 600 H.O.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received three reports of explosions, one involving minor burns to face and hands.

recalls.title: Giant Recalls Anthem X 29er Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2011 Model Year Anthem Giant Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The frame can crack at the junction of the seat post and top tube, posing a fall hazard to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the recalled bicycles and contact any authorized Giant Bicycle dealer for a free inspection and repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves 2011 model year Giant Anthem X 29er 1, 2 and 3 model bicycles. The bicycles were sold in small, medium and large. "Giant" and the model name are printed on the bicycle.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Rollerblade USA Recalls to Repair Inline Skates Due to Risk of Injury
recalls.name: Spark, Spitfire Inline Skates
recalls.hazard: The frame mounting bolts and wheel axle bolts can be loose on new skates. Loose wheels or frames on the skates can cause the rider to fall, posing a risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately inspect all wheel-axle and frame-mounting bolts to ensure that they are properly tightened. Rollerblade USA recommends regular inspection and tightening of bolts. After wheel-axle and frame mounting bolts are inspected and tightened if needed, products are acceptable for sale and use. Video instructions on bolt tightening and maintenance are available at www.rollerblade.com
recalls.description: This recall involves the following models of inline skates purchased since September 2009. - Spark Pro, Men's (SKU# 00792200816), Black - Spark Pro, Women's (SKU# 007923007E2), Anthracite (Grey) - Spark 80, Men's (SKU# 00702800956), Black - Spark 80, Women's…
recalls.injuries: Rollerblade USA has received 31 reports of loose bolts, including one report of a fall resulting in minor injuries that required medical attention.

recalls.title: Club Car Recalls Golf Cars and Hospitality, Utility and Transport Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Golf cars and hospitality, utility and transport vehicles
recalls.hazard: The brake pedal can crack and separate, resulting in a loss of braking ability. This can result in a crash.
recalls.remedy: Club Car is providing a free inspection and replacement of the brake pedal. The company is contacting its customers directly.
recalls.description: The recalled vehicles are Model 2010 DS golf cars and hospitality, utility and transport vehicles used for short-distance transportation. They are various sizes, models and colors.
recalls.injuries: Club Car has received two reports of brake pedals breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Bicycles Recalled by Easton Sports; Seat Post Poses Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles with 2010 EC90 Zero seat posts
recalls.hazard: The carbon top clamp of the seat post can crack, posing a fall hazard to the user.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the bicycles and contact any authorized Easton Sports for a free replacement top seat clamp.
recalls.description: This recall involves bicycles with 2010 EC90 Zero seat posts. The EC90 Zero seat posts are black with red and gray graphics. "EC90" is printed on the post.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: The Hive Announces Recall to Repair Revl Carbon Road Bicycle Brakes Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Revl carbon bicycle brakes
recalls.hazard: The cable clamping area of the bicycle brakes can crack over time, causing the brakes to fail. This could pose a fall or crash hazard to the cyclist.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using their bicycles with these recalled brakes and contact The Hive for replacement parts and instruction to repair their brakes or contact their retailer to perform the repair free of charge.
recalls.description: The recall involves black Revl carbon road bicycle brakes with date codes 41B, 44B, 45B, 53B, 13C and 16C printed on the underside of the carbon brake arms. "Revl" is printed on the brake.
recalls.injuries: No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Bravo Sports Recalls Trampolines Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bravo Sports Trampolines
recalls.hazard: Incorrectly assembled trampolines can allow the top rails and legs to bend or break during normal use, resulting in partial collapse of the trampoline. This poses a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled trampolines. Consumers should contact Bravo Sports for instructions on how to inspect the trampoline for top rail damage and to request revised assembly instructions. Top rails and legs damaged due to assembly errors will be replaced at no charge by Bravo Sports.
recalls.description: This recall involves AirZone and Variflex trampolines with model numbers 137083 (with wheels), 137536, 137683, 138088, 138467, 138472, 138489, 139275, 139283, 139284, 139300 and 139706. The model number is found on the safety label sewn to the pad cover.
recalls.injuries: Bravo has received 247 reports of top rails bending or breaking during normal use.

recalls.title: Sunrise Medical Recalls Quickie® Shark Bikes Due to Footrest Failure
recalls.name: Quickie® Shark Bikes
recalls.hazard: The custom footrests can break, posing a risk of injury to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bikes and contact Sunrise Medical or their Sunrise Medical dealer for instructions on how to obtain replacement footrests.
recalls.description: This recall involves Quickie® Shark bikes with custom footrests that are designed for use by disabled persons. Model numbers included in the recall are SB472900001 and SB471900001. Model and serials numbers are printed on the right side of the bike frame.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Brine Recalls VIP Lacrosse Gloves Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
recalls.name: Youth and Adult Brine VIP Lacrosse Gloves
recalls.hazard: Screen printing ink used on the silver triad logo on the back of the glove contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the gloves and contact Brine for a replacement or refund.
recalls.units: About 7,000 in the United States and 30 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves black and white Brine VIP lacrosse gloves sold in three sizes: 10, 12 and 13 inches. The name "Brine" is printed in white and a silver triad symbol is printed on the back of the glove on the wrist cuff.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Baja Motorsports Recalls Mini Bikes and Go-Carts Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
recalls.name: Baja Motorsports Mini Bikes and Go-Carts
recalls.hazard: The gas cap can leak or detach from the fuel tank on the recalled mini bikes and go-carts, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled mini bikes and go-carts and contact Baja Motorsports for a free replacement gas cap and to schedule a free repair of the fuel line and throttle cable.
recalls.description: This recall involved Baja Motorsports mini bikes with model numbers beginning with HT65, MB165, WR65, MB196, DB30, WR90 and DR90 and go-carts with model numbers BB65, SD65, DN65 and TR65.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received at least 9 reports of the gas caps leaking and detaching, including one report of a serious burn injury to a child.

recalls.title: Muddy Outdoors Recalls Climbing Sticks Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2009 Muddy Outdoors tree climbing sticks
recalls.hazard: Bolts that secure the cam locks to the frame of these climbing sticks that retains the rope around the tree can break, allowing the cam locks to detach from the frame.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these climbing sticks and return the climbing sticks to Muddy Outdoors for a refund, exchange or manufacturer's credit.
recalls.description: The recalled climbing sticks are used for climbing a tree and include 2009 year Model 70301 - Muddy Outdoors climbing stick (a 20-inch single climbing stick) and 2009 year Model 70304 - Muddy Outdoors climbing stick (4-pack of 20-inch climbing sticks).
recalls.injuries: CPSC has received two reports of bolts breaking on a climbing stick. No reports of injuries.

recalls.title: Seattle Bike Supply Recalls Bicycles and Framesets Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2010 Redline Conquest Cyclocross Bicycles and Framesets
recalls.hazard: The bicycle fork's legs can separate from the fork crown and cause the rider to lose control, posing a fall hazard and risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and framesets and contact their local Redline bicycle dealer to receive a free fork replacement.
recalls.description: This recall involves all 2010 Redline Conquest Cyclocross bicycles and framesets. The bicycles and framesets were sold in yellow and black, and have aluminum frames and aluminum forks with aluminum steering tubes. "Redline" is printed on the bicycle frame.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received five reports of cracks near the fork's crown.

recalls.title: Campus Cruisers Recalls Bicycles Due to Front Fork Failure
recalls.name: Eastside Fix Bicycle Forks
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's front fork can crack or break, causing a sudden loss of steering control and posing a fall hazard to bicyclists.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding bicycles with the recalled front forks. Consumers can contact their local Campus Cruisers dealer to schedule a free repair. Consumers who are not near an authorized dealer should contact Campus Cruisers for assistance.
recalls.description: This recall involves Campus Cruisers' Eastside Fix model bicycles. The single speed bicycle has an aluminum frame and fork. The bicycles were sold in royal blue with a white leather seat and white gel grips on the handlebars.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received four reports of lateral cracks beneath the front fork's crown. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2009 Felt model B12, B16 and S32 road bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's fork steer tube can break, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact your local Felt Bicycles dealer to receive a free inspection and repair.
recalls.description: The recall includes all 2009 Felt model B12, B16 and S32 road bicycles. 2009 B12 - These bicycles are gloss silver/carbon and have carbon fiber frames with carbon fiber forks with aluminum steer tubes.
recalls.injuries: Felt Bicycles has received seven reports of the bicycle forks breaking. Minor injuries, including bumps and bruises were reported in one of the incidents.

recalls.title: Children's Jewelry Recalled by SmileMakers Due to High Levels of Cadmium
recalls.name: Children's Happy Charm Bracelets and Football Rings
recalls.hazard: The metal substrate in the jewelry contains high levels of cadmium. Cadmium is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled jewelry away from children and discard the product.
recalls.description: This recall involves "Happy" charm bracelets and football rings. The "Happy" charm bracelet is comprised of colorful beads on a small elastic band to which a metal charm in the shape of a butterfly, moon or sun is attached.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Ski Boot Sole Pads with Steel Inserts and All-Terrain Ski Boots configured with them Recalled by Salomon USA Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Salomon "Quest Touring Pads" and Salomon "Quest Pro Pebax" and "Quest Pro" touring-style ski boots
recalls.hazard: The toe portion of the boot pad may unexpectedly release from the touring-style ski binding on a ski, posing a fall or injury hazard to the user.The computers can overheat, posing a burn hazard to the consumer.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled sole pads and ski boots and return them to any authorized Salomon ski dealer for a refund of their purchase price.
recalls.units: About 175 pairs of "Quest Touring Pads" about 83 pairs of "Quest Pro Pebax" and "Quest Pro" ski boots
recalls.description: This recall involves the Salomon "Quest Touring Pads" distributed as sole pads only, and Salomon "Quest Pro Pebax" and "Quest Pro" ski boots configured with the recalled sole pads.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received one report of injury, involving a fractured leg and knee injuries.

recalls.title: BRP Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: BRP Ski-Doo® Snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: Friction between the fuel hose and the electronic control unit can cause the fuel hose to wear and leak fuel, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these snowmobiles immediately and contact their local Ski-Doo snowmobile dealer to schedule a free repair. Registered owners have been directly notified about this recall by mail.
recalls.description: This recall involves the Ski-Doo snowmobiles model year 2010 Expedition TUV 1200 and model year 2010 Expedition TUV SE 1200. The model year and name are displayed on each side of the snowmobile and on a decal on the right side of the snowmobile.
recalls.injuries: BRP has received six reports of fuel leaks, three of which resulted in vehicle fires. One of the incidents involved a rider suffering superficial burns.

recalls.title: Basketball-Shaped Chair and Ottoman Sets Recalled by Colleen Karis Designs Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard; Sold at HomeGoods Stores
recalls.name: All-Star Basketball Chair and Ottoman Sets
recalls.hazard: Surface paints on the lettering on both sides of the basketball chair could contain excessive levels of lead which is a violation of the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the chair and ottoman away from children and return the chair and ottoman set to Colleen Karis Designs for a full refund.
recalls.description: The vinyl chair is round in shape to resemble a basketball, orange/brown in color and measures about 20 inches in diameter. "All-Star" is printed on both sides in black. "Colleen Karis Designs" is printed on a tag on the bottom of the chair.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Utility Snow Sled Hitch Recalled by Pelican International Due to Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Utility sled tow hitch
recalls.hazard: The screw(s) in the hitch can become loose and fall off due to vibrations when items are being towed, allowing the sled and hitch to detach from the towing vehicle. This poses an injury hazard to the user and bystanders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the sled tow hitch and contact the firm to receive a free replacement kit and installation instructions.
recalls.description: The tow hitch pivot is black metal and measures about 9.25 inches in length and 3.25 inches in diameter. The hitch is used in connection with the Pelican Snow Trek Utility sled.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 10 reports of the screw coming loose. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Rome Snowboards Recalls Bindings Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Snowboard Boot Bindings
recalls.hazard: The snowboard binding's base plate can break at cold temperatures, posing a fall hazard to snowboarders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled snowboard bindings and contact Rome Snowboards for free replacement bindings.
recalls.units: About 2,900 in the United States and 220 in Canada
recalls.description: This recall involves the Rome Snowboards Co. 2010 United snowboard bindings. The bindings come in black and red color themes and in sizes small, medium and large. Rome is printed on the highback.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received 14 reports of base plates breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Bicycles Recalled by Nirve Sports Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Chopper-style bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle stem on the handlebars can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious fall and injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the bicycles and return them to the place of purchase for free repair.
recalls.units: About 725 units: Red Star 100, Skulls 285 and Cannibal Chopper 340
recalls.description: This recall involves three models: Red Star, Skulls and Cannibal chopper-style bicycles with the model names printed on the chain guard.
recalls.injuries: Nirve Sports has received reports of cracked handlebar stems, which all occurred during assembly of the bicycle. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2010 26" Epic and 26" Era Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The shock absorber mount can break and the shock absorber can make contact with the wheel spokes, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles and contact a Specialized dealer for a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves alloy seat stays on the following 2010 Specialized 26" Era and 26" Epic bicycles: 2010 Epic Marathon Carbon, 2010 Epic Marathon Frame, 2010 Epic Expert Carbon, 2010 Epic Expert, 2010 Epic Comp Carbon, 2010 Epic Comp, 2010 Era FSR Expert…
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Sportime Recalls Sports Balls Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
recalls.name: TechnoSkin Foam Balls and Sportime TechStitched Soccer Balls
recalls.hazard: Surface paints on the sports balls contain excessive levels of lead which is a violation of the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled products away from children and contact Sportime for instructions to receive a full refund or replacement product.
recalls.description: The recall involves the following SchoolSmart TechnoSkin Coated Foam Balls and TechStitched Soccer Balls. The TechnoSkin Foam Balls measure between 2 ¾ and 8 ¼ inches in diameter. The Sportime TechStitched Soccer Ball is a standard size soccer ball.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: BRP Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Laceration Hazard from Projectiles
recalls.name: BRP Ski-Doo snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: The drive pulley bolts on the snowmobiles can break due to oil contamination during the assembly process. This can cause debris to come off the vehicle and act as projectiles, posing a laceration hazard to riders or bystanders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these snowmobiles immediately and contact their local Ski-Doo snowmobile dealer to schedule a free repair. All known owners of the recalled snowmobiles have been directly notified about this recall by mail.
recalls.units: About 1,500 (This recall was first announced in May 2008 and reannounced in June 2008)
recalls.description: The recall involves Ski-Doo model year 2009-2010 SKANDIC SWT V-800 and model year 2010 GSX 1200, GTX 1200, MXZ 1200, and Renegade 1200 Snowmobiles.
recalls.injuries: BRP has received three reports of projectiles flying off of the snowmobiles, including one report of a minor foot injury.

recalls.title: Civia Cycles Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Hyland Bicycles and Carbon Bicycle Forks
recalls.hazard: The bicycle fork can crack or break, posing a fall hazard to the consumer.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles with the recalled forks and contact an authorized Civia Cycles dealer for a free replacement fork. All known users have been contacted.
recalls.description: This recall involves all Civia Hyland bicycles sold with original equipment carbon fiber forks and all Civia Carbon forks sold as aftermarket products. The forks are black and have the word "Civia" forged into the fork dropout.
recalls.injuries: Civia Cycles has received two reports of forks cracking and one report of a fork breaking resulting in an abrasion on face and bruised ribs.

recalls.title: Bauer Recalls Children's Hockey Sticks Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
recalls.name: Youth and Junior Hockey Sticks, Shafts, and Blades
recalls.hazard: Paint and decals on the sticks, shafts and blades contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled sticks, shafts and blades away from children immediately and contact Bauer for a replacement or refund.
recalls.units: About 67,000 in the United States and 60,000 in Canada
recalls.description: The following hockey sticks, shafts and blades are involved in the recall: Description Pieces Countries Sold Nike Bauer Supreme One50 Junior Stick sticks, shafts and replacement blades U.S. and Canada Nike Bauer Supreme One70 Junior Stick player stick U.S.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Sport Obermeyer Ltd. Voluntarily Recalls Girls' Jackets with Drawstrings at the Waist Due to Entrapment Hazard
recalls.name: Posey, Lily, Rose and Daisy Girls' Ski Jackets
recalls.hazard: The jackets have a drawstring at the waist which can pose an entrapment hazard to children.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately remove the drawstrings from the jackets to eliminate the hazard or return it to Sport Obermeyer, Ltd. for a full refund.
recalls.description: The recalled girls' jackets have drawstrings at the waist, sold in sizes 1 to 8 and the names and corresponding style numbers are: Lily #91549, Rose # 91552, Daisy #91555, Posey #91558. The style number is printed on the tag inside the neck of the jackets.
recalls.injuries: No injuries reported.

recalls.title: Ventus Bicycle Aerobars Recalled by 3T Cycling Srl Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Ventus Ltd™ and Ventus Team™ Bicycle Aerobars
recalls.hazard: The two rubber hand grips on the aerobars (handle bars) can loosen or slip off during use, posing a fall or injury hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Contact BikeMine to receive a free redesigned rubber grip set and adhesive kit or information on how to bring your Ventus bar to a local retailer for a repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves all Ventus Ltd, Ventus Ltd 17, Ventus Ltd Gold, Ventus Ltd Track, Ventus Team and Ventus Team 17 bicycle aerobars.
recalls.injuries: Two incidents were reported to 3T involving adults with minor abrasions.

recalls.title: Do It Best Recalls Bicycle Bells Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
recalls.name: Bicycle Bells
recalls.hazard: The red paint on the bicycle bells contains excessive lead levels, violating the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately remove the bicycle bells and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves children's bicycle bells. The bells are red, black and white and has "I ? My Bike" printed on the top. The green and white packaging reads "bike bell" and "$1."
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Sportime Recalls Children's Floor Hockey Sets Due to Lead Paint Hazard
recalls.name: BigBox Hockey Sets
recalls.hazard: The surface coating on the boards, which are assembled together to form the floor hockey playing-field, contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled product away from children and contact Sportime to obtain a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves all sets of BigBox Hockey, each consisting of six boards, measuring 6' long by 10" tall. The boards come in six colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Johnson Health Tech North America Recalls Horizon Fitness and LIVESTRONG™ Fitness Elliptical Trainers Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Horizon Fitness and LIVESTRONG™ Fitness Elliptical Trainers
recalls.hazard: The foot pedal can become disengaged, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the elliptical machines immediately and contact Johnson Health Tech NA to schedule a free in-home replacement of the defective pedals.
recalls.description: The recalled products are elliptical trainers branded under the Horizon Fitness and LIVESTRONG Fitness names. The brand name is located at the top of the console display with the model numbers just below and the serial numbers are located on the front support…
recalls.injuries: The firm is aware of 58 reports of foot pedal disengagements. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Bicycles and Framesets Recalled By Seattle Bike Supply Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2010 Redline Conquest Pro Bicycles and Framesets
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's fork legs can separate from the fork crown and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious injury if the rider falls.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and framesets and contact their local Redline bicycle dealer to receive a free inspection and fork replacement.
recalls.description: This recall involves all 2010 Redline Conquest Pro Cyclocross bicycles and framesets. The bicycles and framesets were sold in pearl white/blue and have aluminum frames with carbon fiber forks and aluminum steerer tubes.
recalls.injuries: The firm is aware of three reports of forks separating with minor injuries reported in one of the incidents.

recalls.title: CO2 Bicycle Tire Inflators Sold at Walmart Recalled by Todson Inc. Due to Risk of Injury
recalls.name: CO2 bicycle tire inflators
recalls.hazard: The pressurized cartridge containing carbon dioxide (CO2) can forcefully separate from the pump head, posing a risk of injury to the consumer.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the inflators and return them to Walmart for a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves Zefal CO2 bicycle tire inflators with a small pressurized carbon dioxide cartridge. The metal cartridge is threaded into the inflator head, which allows for the controlled release of carbon dioxide into the bicycle inner tube.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Salomon USA Recalls Ski Bindings Due to Unexpected Release, Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Alpine Ski Bindings
recalls.hazard: The toe component of the ski bindings could fail to fully secure the ski boot to the ski binding, causing the binding to release unexpectedly. This could cause the skier to lose control or fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these ski bindings immediately and return the Salomon-brand ski bindings to any authorized Salomon ski dealer, or return the Atomic-brand ski bindings to any authorized Atomic ski dealer, for a free inspection and replacement of the toe component.
recalls.description: This recall involves the Salomon alpine ski bindings with models LZ 7, LZ 8, LZ 9, LZ 7 SR, LZ 8 SR, LZ 8 SC, and J LZ 9 and the Atomic ski bindings with model Evox 2.8, Evox 2.8+, Evox 2.8++, and FFG 8.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received two reports of injuries, including a broken leg and a knee injury.

recalls.title: Gorilla Inc. Recalls EXO-Tech Safety Harness Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: EXO-Tech Safety Harness
recalls.hazard: The webbing of the waist belt on the safety harness is not routed through the lineman's loop located on the front of the harness near waist level.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the harness and contact Gorilla Inc. to receive a refund.
recalls.description: This safety harness, used as a fall restraint for hunting, is comprised of two leg straps and two shoulder straps, which connect to a waist belt and padded back support.
recalls.injuries: No incidents were reported.

recalls.title: Bicycles Recalled by Easton Sports; Stem Failure Poses Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles with EA30 Stems
recalls.hazard: The bicycle stem can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious injury if the rider falls.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the bicycles and contact any authorized Easton Sports for a free replacement stem.
recalls.description: This recall involves bicycles with EA30 stems. The EA30 stems are black with white-and-gray graphics and feature a four-bolt stem face cap. "EA30" is printed on the stem. EA30 stems sold as aftermarket items are included in this recall.
recalls.injuries: The company received a report of a stem breaking, causing a minor injury to the rider.

recalls.title: Electra Bicycle Company Expands Recall of Bicycles with Front Trays or Baskets; Trays and Baskets Can Come Loose and Pose Fall Hazard to Riders
recalls.name: 2009 Model Electra Bicycles with Front Trays or Baskets
recalls.hazard: The front tray or basket on the bicycles can come loose and contact the front tire, posing a fall hazard to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles and contact an Electra Bicycle dealer for a free inspection and repair of the trays that came as original equipment on the bicycles, or a refund for trays and baskets purchased as aftermarket items.
recalls.units: About 6,400 (3,000 units were previously recalled in March 2009)
recalls.description: This recall involves the 2009 Delivery 3i, Delivery 8D, Holiday 3i, Holiday 8i and Surf 3i bicycles with front-mounted trays or baskets. The trays have an alloy frame with wooden slats. The baskets are wicker with a removable tote bag.
recalls.injuries: Electra Bicycle Co. has received 15 reports of the front tray or the basket coming loose including two reports of minor cuts and bruises.

recalls.title: Moser Enterprises Recalls Schwalbe Brand Bicycle Tires Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Schwalbe Ultremo R Bicycle Tires
recalls.hazard: The tire layers could separate causing the inner tube to rupture, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles with the recalled tires and contact their local bicycle dealer for a free replacement set of tires.
recalls.description: This recall includes Schwalbe Ultremo R bicycle tires. "Schwalbe" and "Ultremo R" are printed on the sidewall of the tires.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Bicycle Chains and Chain Connector Links Recalled by SRAM Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 10-Speed SRAM Bicycle Chains with PowerLock connector links
recalls.hazard: The recalled PowerLock connector links, used on bicycle chains, are brittle and can crack, allowing the chain to separate from the bicycle and posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled PowerLock connectors, chains and bicycles with these connectors and contact their SRAM retailer for a free replacement PowerLock connector link.
recalls.description: The recall involves SRAM PowerLock connector links, which are sold individually, on 10-speed bicycle chains and as original equipment on some bicycles.
recalls.injuries: One incident has been reported in the United States and three outside. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Bicycles Recalled by Nirve Sports; Stem Failure Poses Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Cannibal Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle stem can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious injury if the rider falls.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the bicycles and return them to the place of purchase for free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves Cannibal "Chopper" model bicycles with graphic designs by artist Corey Miller. The bicycles have a black matte finish. The affected bicycles have a serial number within the following range: L8E0300001 - L8E1001050.
recalls.injuries: Nirve Sports has received two reports of cracked stems. In both cases, the cracks occurred during assembly of the bicycle. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Cyclocross Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2007/2008 Felt F1X Cyclocross Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's fork steerer tube can break, causing the rider to lose control and fall, posing a risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact a local Felt Bicycles dealer to receive a free inspection and repair.
recalls.description: The recall includes all 2007/2008 Felt F1X Cyclocross Bicycles. These bicycles are available in semimatte black and have aluminum frames with carbon fiber forks with aluminum steerer tubes.
recalls.injuries: Felt Bicycles has received six reports of the bicycle forks breaking, including two reports of minor cuts and scrapes.

recalls.title: Spalding In-Ground Basketball Hoops Recalled By Russell Brands Due to Impact Hazard
recalls.name: Spalding In-Ground Basketball Hoops
recalls.hazard: The bolts at the base can fail, causing the unit to fall. This poses a risk of serious injury to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled basketball hoops immediately and contact Russell Brands for instructions on receiving free replacement bolts. If the product is installed in concrete, the firm will arrange for free deinstallation, repair and reinstallation of the product at the consumer's home.
recalls.description: This recall involves Spalding in-ground basketball hoops with a supporting pole and a clear backboard. The following models are included in the recall: Series Description Model Sold from MC Sports Series (sold exclusively at MC Sports) 88565G, 88565GT,…
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Elliptical Exercise Gliders Recalled by Thane Due to Fall Hazard; New Instructions to Be Provided
recalls.name: Orbitrek Elite and Orbitrek Elite Magnetic Elliptical Exercise Gliders
recalls.hazard: The written instructions incorrectly identify the proper location of the spring washer. An incorrectly installed spring washer can put undue stress on bolts, causing them to loosen, which poses a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled machines until they inspect their unit and confirm that the spring washer is in the correct location. Thane is directly contacting consumers to provide new assembly instructions, which can also be located on the firm's Web site.
recalls.description: This recall involves Orbitrek Elite ("OE") and Orbitrek Elite Magnetic ("OEM") elliptical gliders with model numbers BK2080 (OE) and BK2280 (OEM). The recalled gliders have a blue and gray plastic cover.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Stamina Products Recalls Elliptical Machines; Provides New Warning and Assembly Instructions
recalls.name: Elliptical Cross Trainers
recalls.hazard: Stamina modified the warning/assembly instructions in the owner's manuals to emphasize that the elliptical pedal shafts must be securely tightened to the cranks.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should not assemble or use these elliptical machines until they have reviewed the modified warnings and assembly instructions. Consumers can obtain the new warning and assembly instructions by contacting Stamina.
recalls.description: This recall includes the following elliptical machines: Model Serial Number Magnetic 1772 Cross Trainer Elliptical Model No. 55-1772 08AUG000001-08AUG000360 08AUG000361-08AUG001078 08AUG002521-08AUG002878 08SEP001081-08SEP001438 08SEP001441-08SEP001798…
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Loaded Boards Recalls Orangatang Skateboard Wheels; Blow-outs Pose Risk of Injury to Riders
recalls.name: Orangatang Skateboard Wheels
recalls.hazard: The recalled skateboard wheel's core can shear and blow-out causing the wheel to separate from the skateboard truck's axle and bearings. This poses a risk of serious injury to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the wheels immediately and contact Loaded Boards Inc. or any authorized dealer for a free replacement.
recalls.description: The recall involves Orangatang "In-Heat" skateboard wheels. They were sold in two styles: 75mm/purple/83a durometer and 75mm/orange/80a durometer. The words "orangatang," "In Heat," and the size and durometer are written on the sidewall of the wheel.
recalls.injuries: Loaded Boards has received 10 reports of wheels separating. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Bicycles Recalled by REI Due to Fork Failure
recalls.name: 2005 Novara Trionfo Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The fork can separate from the steerer tube which can cause the rider to lose control, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and return them to an REI retail store for a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves 2005 Novara Trionfo bicycles with Aprebic carbon fiber forks. The bicycles are blue and white with black forks, and have the name "Novara" printed on the bars.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received two reports of forks separating causing riders to fall. Injuries reported include a fractured clavicle, broken teeth, facial damage and…

recalls.title: Trampolines Recalled by Skywalker Holdings; Enclosure Problems Can Result in Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 13-foot Square Trampolines
recalls.hazard: The straps supporting the top of the trampoline's enclosure to the poles can fail. The enclosure could drop if these straps break, posing a risk that a user could fall from the trampoline.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the trampolines and contact Skywalker Holdings to obtain a free repair kit.
recalls.description: This recall involves the Skywalker Holdings 13-foot Square Trampoline and Enclosure Combo. The unit has blue spring pads, a black net enclosure, and a jumping mat.
recalls.injuries: Skywalker Holdings has received at least 250 reports of straps breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Cannondale Recalls Bicycles; JD Forks Can Lose Alignment, Posing Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles with JD suspension forks
recalls.hazard: The recalled bicycle's fork can lose alignment causing the front wheel to turn unexpectedly. This can cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding the recalled bicycles immediately and contact their dealer to arrange for a free repair.
recalls.description: The recall involves model year 2008 Cannondale Adventure 2, Adventure 3, Adventure 2 Feminine and Adventure 3 Feminine bicycles. The model name is printed on the bicycle's frame.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Norco Recalls Bicycle Frames Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Norco Bicycle Frames
recalls.hazard: The bicycle frame can crack and separate, causing a rider to fall from the bicycle and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: All owners should immediately stop using the bicycle frame and contact a local Norco dealer or Norco directly for information regarding receiving a possible replacement frame.
recalls.description: The recalled bicycle frames include the following model year and model names: 2007 Team DH, 2008 Team DH, Aline Park, Aline, Atomik, Shore 1,2,3, 2009 Atomik (without gussets).
recalls.injuries: Norco has received one report of a rider who fractured their collar bone after falling from the bicycle.

recalls.title: Trek Recalls Bicycles; JD Forks Can Lose Alignment, Posing Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles with JD suspension forks
recalls.hazard: The recalled bicycle's fork can lose alignment causing the front wheel to turn unexpectedly. This can cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding the recalled bicycles immediately and contact their dealer to arrange for a free repair.
recalls.description: The recall involves model year 2009 Trek 7300, 7300WSD, and 7500 bicycles. The model name is printed on the bicycle's frame. The bicycles have a suspension fork with the words "Bontrager SPA" printed on them.
recalls.injuries: There have been four reports of misaligned forks. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Dahon and REI Novara Folding Bicycles Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2008 model year Dahon and REI Novara Folding Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The hinge on the handlepost can crack, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles and contact any Dahon California dealer or REI store for a free inspection and repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves model year 2008 Dahon and REI Novara folding bicycles. The models included in the recall are as follows: Dahon Ciao P8, Curve D3, Curve SL, Glide P8, Jetstream P8, Mu P8, Mu P24, MU SL, Mu XL Sport, Vitesse D7 HG, Speed D7, Speed P8,…
recalls.injuries: There have been 25 reports of the handlepost hinge on these bicycles cracking, including one minor injury involving scrapes and bruises.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Roubaix Comp Roubaix Pro bicycles
recalls.hazard: The cable stop on the bicycle can loosen, which can cause the rider to lose control and fall from the bike.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using their bicycle and return their bicycle to a Specialized authorized dealer for an approved repair, at no cost to consumer.
recalls.description: The recalled bicycles are as follows: 2004 Roubaix Comp 18, 2004 Roubaix Comp 27, 2004 Roubaix Pro 18, and 2004 Roubaix Pro frameset models. Only bicycles with a single rivet fastening the cable stop to the frame are subject to recall.
recalls.injuries: Specialized received reports of two falls that resulted in fractures requiring medical attention and surgery.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Serious Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Specialized 2009 Model Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The handlebars can break, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles and contact a Specialized dealer for a free replacement handlebar.
recalls.description: This recall involves HL handlebars on the following 2009 Specialized bicycles: Cross Trail Comp, Myka HT Comp, Myka HT Elite, Rockhopper, Rockhopper Comp and Rockhopper Comp 29.
recalls.injuries: Specialized has received two reports of the handlebar breaking during use, one of which caused a rider to suffer head trauma which resulted in unconsciousness…

recalls.title: Aviva Sports Recalls Trampolines Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Aviva Leaps and Bounds Folding Trampolines with Safety Pad ("L&B") and Aviva Pirate Jump 'N Play Trampolines ("Pirate")
recalls.hazard: The metal support legs of the trampoline can bend or break and the bungee cords that secure the mat to the frame of the trampoline can fray or break, posing a fall hazard to the user.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the trampoline and contact Aviva to receive instructions for returning the trampoline and to receive a full refund.
recalls.description: The recall includes two separate model trampolines. The Leaps & Bounds Trampoline is a 34-inch by 34-inch trampoline with a hold-on handle with model number 12731 printed on the pad that goes around the frame of the product.
recalls.injuries: Aviva Sports has received 24 reports of the legs on the frame of the trampoline bending or breaking.

recalls.title: Cannondale Recalls Road Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2009 Six 5, Six 6, Six Carbon 5, Six Carbon 6 Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycles fail to meet the federal safety standard for bicycles. Spoke protector discs, required on bicycles to prevent the bicycle chain from interfering or suddenly stopping the wheel, are missing from these bicycles.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bicycles immediately and contact any authorized Cannondale bicycle dealer for a free repair.
recalls.description: The following Cannondale bicycles are included in the recall. "Six" is printed on the bicycle's top tube and "Cannondale" is printed on the down tube.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Electra Bicycle Company Recalls Bicycles with Front Trays; Trays Can Come Loose and Pose Fall Hazard to Riders
recalls.name: 2009 Model Electra Bicycles with Front Trays
recalls.hazard: The front tray on the bicycle can come loose and contact the front tire, posing a fall hazard to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles and contact an Electra Bicycle dealer for a free inspection and repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves the following Electra 2009 model bicycles: Delivery 3i, Delivery 8D, Holiday 3i and Surf 3i.
recalls.injuries: Electra Bicycle has received four reports of the front tray coming loose, including one incident that resulted in minor cuts and bruises.

recalls.title: Ice Skates Recalled by Pronto Sports Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
recalls.name: DBX Glide Boys' Ice Skates
recalls.hazard: Surface paint on the ice skates contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled ice skates away from children and contact Pronto Sports for a full refund.
recalls.description: The recalled youth adjustable boys' ice skates are black with lime green and silver accents. "Glide" is printed on a rubber tag on the side of the skates. "DBX" and the DBX logo are located on the ice skate's ankle powerstrap, tongue, and heel.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Off-Road Bike Engine Parts Recalled by Wiseco Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Off-Road Dirt Bike Connecting Rods or Crankshaft Assemblies
recalls.hazard: Engine stress could cause the connecting rods to crack and the engine to lock up, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using off-road bikes on which the recalled connecting rods and crankshaft assemblies were installed and immediately contact Wiseco for free replacement parts and repair, or a full refund if the consumer has already replaced the recalled engine parts.
recalls.description: This recall involves the following connecting rods and crankshaft assemblies used in off-road dirt bike engines. Wiseco's identification number can be found on the neck of the connecting rods between the two circular ends.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Salsa Bicycles Recalls Bicycles; Handlebar Stems Can Break Causing Rider to Fall
recalls.name: Handlebar Stems Used on Salsa Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The handlebar stems can crack or break, posing a fall hazard to the consumer.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately and contact an authorized Salsa Bicycles dealer for a free inspection and replacement stem.
recalls.description: This recall involves all CroMoto S.U.L. stems sold as individual aftermarket units and on these models of complete Salsa bicycles: Ala Carte, El Mariachi, Casseroll Triple, Casseroll Single and La Cruz.
recalls.injuries: Salsa Bicycles has received three reports of handlebar stems breaking. One incident resulted in a rider suffering a broken wrist.

recalls.title: Nordica USA Recalls to Repair Skis; Binding Plates Can Break, Poses Fall Hazard to Skiers
recalls.name: XBi ALU Skis
recalls.hazard: The binding plates could crack or break, causing the skier to lose control or fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled skis immediately and return them to the retailer for a free replacement binding plate.
recalls.description: This recall involves the XBi binding component which has been utilized on the following Nordica ski models and model years: Year Series 2006 MACH3POWER 2007 DOBSPIT 2007 MACH3POWER 2007 MACH3 2007 MACH2 2007 HELLCAT 2007 FIREFOX 2007 DOBPROSL 2008 FIREFOX…
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Marzocchi Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Crash Hazard and Risk of Injury during Repair
recalls.name: Bicycle Forks
recalls.hazard: The suspension system on bikes with the recalled forks could become completely compressed and fail to return to its original position after a forceful landing. This can cause riders to lose control of the bicycle and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bicycle forks immediately, and return them to the dealer where purchased for a free repair. Consumers should not attempt to repair the forks.
recalls.description: The recalled bicycle forks were sold for installation on mountain bikes. The recall involves certain 2008 model year 888RC3 and 888RC3WC suspensions with date codes beginning with T07D07, T07D08 and T07D09.
recalls.injuries: The firm has eight reports of damaged forks outside the U.S., including a report of an injury from a fall.

recalls.title: Golfer's Billiard Games Recalled by Dick's Sporting Goods and Golf Galaxy Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
recalls.name: Golfer's Billiard Games
recalls.hazard: Surface paints on the golf balls can contain excess levels of lead.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product immediately and return it to the store where purchased for a full refund.
recalls.description: The recalled golfer's billiard game includes 15 golf balls (with exterior paint and design to resemble a billiard ball) and six putting cups.
recalls.injuries: None.

recalls.title: Bicycles with R-SYS Wheel Rims Recalled by Mavic USA Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles with R-SYS Front Wheel Rims
recalls.hazard: The spokes on the bicycle's front wheel rim can break during use, posing a fall and crash hazard to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using bicycles with the recalled front wheel rims and contact their bicycle retailer for a free replacement front rim.
recalls.description: This recall includes R-SYS and R-SYS Premium front wheel rims. They were sold as original equipment on various bicycle brands and were also sold separately. R-SYS wheel rims are designed for road bikes. "R-SYS" is printed on the front rim of the wheels.
recalls.injuries: Mavic USA has received one report of an injury involving broken teeth.

recalls.title: L.L. Bean Recalls Ice Cleats Used During Winter Weather Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Stabilicer Lite Cleats
recalls.hazard: The elastic harness system attaching the cleats to footwear can detach, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled cleats and contact L.L. Bean to receive a replacement or refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves Stabilicers Lite cleats with model number BNX9. The cleats are worn over footwear for traction in winter walking conditions. The recalled cleats were sold in blue, orange, and pink.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received two reports of the harness breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Saris Cycling Group Recalls Stationary Bicycle Trainers Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Stationary Bicycle Trainers
recalls.hazard: A handle pin on the bicycle trainer can loosen during use, causing the machine to become disengaged, and pose a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers with the recalled bicycle trainers should immediately stop using the product and contact Saris Cycling Group to receive a replacement trainer.
recalls.description: The recalled trainers are a stationary frame that allows bicycles to be converted into stationary bicycles. The recalled models include: CycleOps Pro Series Trainer models 9014 (SuperMagneto Pro), 9331 (JetFluid Pro), 9460 (PowerBeam Pro), 9321 (JetFluid Pro…
recalls.injuries: No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Giant Bicycle, Inc. Recalls Bicycles; Fork Can Break Causing Rider To Fall
recalls.name: 2009 model year TCR Advanced SL and SL (ISP) Bicycles and Frames
recalls.hazard: The density of the steerer tubes can cause the forks to crack and break, posing a fall hazard to the consumer.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately and contact an authorized Giant Bicycle dealer for a free inspection and replacement fork.
recalls.description: This recall involves 2009 TCR Advanced SL Team, SL 0, SL 1, SL 2, and SL (ISP) model bicycles and frames in silver, charcoal, blue and red. The words "Giant" and "TCR Advanced SL" are printed on the frame.
recalls.injuries: Giant Bicycle has received one report of the fork cracking with no reported injuries.

recalls.title: Bicycles with RockShox Bicycle Forks Recalled by SRAM LLC Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles using RockShox Domain 302 and 318 bicycle forks
recalls.hazard: The steel steerer on the forks can crack, causing the fork to detach from the bicycle frame. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using bicycles equipped with these forks immediately and contact their bicycle retailer for a free replacement fork.
recalls.description: The recall involves RockShox Domain 302 and 318 bicycle forks with steel steerer sold for installation on new bicycles. Only those forks manufactured between March 2008 and October 2008 with dates codes 09T8 through 42T8 are included in this recall.
recalls.injuries: One incident with a minor injury has been reported. Two other incidents without injury have been reported outside of the United States.

recalls.title: Magura USA Recalls Bicycle Suspension Forks Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Durin Race 80/100 Bicycle Suspension Forks
recalls.hazard: The front bicycle suspension fork can break, causing the rider to crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles equipped with the recalled suspension forks and contact Magura or visit www.magura.com, to determine if your bicycle fork is included in the recall and, if it is, to receive a free repair.
recalls.description: The suspension fork is located on the bicycle's front wheel. They are white or black. "Magura" and "MD100R" or "MD80R" are printed on the forks.
recalls.injuries: None reported in the U.S. One reported overseas.

recalls.title: Atomic Skis USA Recalls Ski Bindings Due to Unexpected Release, Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Alpine Ski Bindings
recalls.hazard: The heel housing of the bindings can crack, causing the binding to release unexpectedly. This can cause the skier to lose control or fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these ski bindings immediately and return them to any authorized Atomic Ski dealer for a voucher toward a new heel component.
recalls.units: About 125,000 (an additional 1.0 million were sold outside the U.S.)
recalls.description: The recall affects the heel components of the following Atomic alpine ski bindings: Race 310, Race 412, RaceRace 310, RaceRace 412, Xentrix 310, Xentrix 311, Xentrix 412, C310, C311, C412, CR 310, CR 412, R 310, R 412, SX 310, SX 412, Device 311, Device 412,…
recalls.injuries: The firm has received four reports of injuries, including a concussion and injuries to the shoulder and knee from falls.

recalls.title: Hockey Helmets Recalled by Reebok-CCM Due to Head and Neck Injury Hazard
recalls.name: Hockey Helmets
recalls.hazard: The helmet's chinstrap can unexpectedly disengage while in use. If this happens, the helmet can fall off, posing a head and neck injury risk to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using and return the helmets to the place of purchase for a free replacement helmet.
recalls.description: This recall involves RBK and CCM brand hockey helmets. Helmets included in this recall have a HECC sticker with date code JUN - 2013. HECC stickers and model numbers are located on the back of the helmets.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Lithium-Ion Batteries Used with Bicycle Lights Recalled By DiNotte Lighting Due to Burn Hazard
recalls.name: DiNotte Lighting Lithium-Ion batteries used with bicycle lights
recalls.hazard: A loose wiring connection and improper venting can cause the battery to overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the battery and contact the company to receive a free replacement battery.
recalls.description: DiNotte Lighting Lithium-Ion battery with nylon bags are used with DiNotte 5W Li-Ion bicycle lights and DiNotte 3 LED police lights. The DiNotte logo is printed on the battery cable connector.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Cybex International Recalls Treadmills Due to Fall Hazard; Can Speed Up Unexpectedly
recalls.name: Cybex Treadmills
recalls.hazard: The treadmills can speed up unexpectedly while in use due to a malfunction with the lower control board, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately unplug and stop using the recalled treadmills. Contact Cybex to receive a free replacement fuse. If requested, a Cybex technician can install the fuse free of charge. Cybex is directly contacting known purchasers.
recalls.description: This recall involves 115V ONLY Cybex 445T, 455T, 530T, 450T, 500T, 515T, 520T, and 550T treadmills. The 220V model treadmills are not involved in this recall. The treadmills are black and gray with rectangular uprights.
recalls.injuries: Cybex International has received 24 reports of incidents involving the treadmill unexpectedly increasing speed, including six reports of consumers falling.

recalls.title: Shimano American Corp. Recalls Wheels for Bicycles; Flat Tire Can Pose Injury Risk to Riders
recalls.name: Shimano Dura Ace Carbon Clincher Wheels for Bicycles
recalls.hazard: Rim surface and spoke hole plugs on the wheel can cause a puncture to the inner tube, resulting in a flat tire. This can cause the rider to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles with the recalled wheels, remove the wheels, and return them to their local bike dealer or retailer for a free inspection and repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves the Shimano Dura Ace Carbon Clincher Wheel Sets with model number WH-7850 C24CL sold for road racing bicycles. The rim has labels that read "Shimano WH-7850", "Dura Ace", and "Carbon 1380." These wheels are intended for use with high end…
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Ski-Doo® Snowmobiles Recalled by BRP US Inc. Due to Drive Axle Failure; Riders Can Be Thrown From Snowmobile
recalls.name: Ski-Doo® Snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: Cracks can develop in the welded joints of the drive axle assembly of the snowmobile and can result in complete breakage. If this happens, the track of the vehicle can unexpectedly lock, causing riders to be ejected off the vehicle or lose control and collide…
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the vehicles and contact their local Ski-Doo® dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repair. Consumers with recalled snowmobiles are being sent direct notice from BRP.
recalls.description: This recall involves Ski-Doo® Model Year 2008 and 2009 snowmobiles. Models included in the recall are listed below. Model numbers are printed on the side panels of the snowmobiles.
recalls.injuries: BRP has received 20 reports of locked tracks, including one report of a broken femur and reports of minor injuries, such as bruises.

recalls.title: Razor USA Recalls PowerWing Three-Wheeled Scooters Due to Laceration Hazard
recalls.name: Razor® PowerWing™ Three-Wheeled Scooters
recalls.hazard: The undersides of the foot platforms can have sharp edges, posing a laceration hazard to children.
recalls.remedy: Parents should immediately stop children from using the product. Do not return the product to retailers. Contact Razor for a set of free replacement foot platforms.
recalls.description: The PowerWing is a three-wheeled scooter, which was sold in either black or silver. The recall includes products with serial numbers beginning with: Y708 Y709 Y710 Y711 Y712 Y801 Y802 Y803 Y804 Y805 Y806 Y807 Y808 The serial number is located on the bottom of…
recalls.injuries: Razor has received 10 reports of Achilles tendon or ankle lacerations, including four consumers who required tendon surgery and three who needed stitches.

recalls.title: Regent Sports Recalls Soccer Goal Nets Following Strangulation Death of a Child
recalls.name: MacGregor Folding Soccer Goals, Mitre Folding Soccer Goals
recalls.hazard: The fixed knot flexible openings in the soccer goal net can pose a head and neck entrapment or strangulation hazard to young children.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled soccer goal nets immediately and return them to Regent Sports to receive a free replacement net.
recalls.description: Both soccer goals have a foldable white frame with a white net that is attached by Velcro strips. When upright, the MacGregor goal measures 6 feet wide by 3 feet high and the Mitre net measures 8 feet wide by 6 feet high.
recalls.injuries: Regent Sports and CPSC have received two reports of head entanglement, including the strangulation death of a 20-month-old child, who was found with his arm…

recalls.title: Bicycles with Deda Forza Handlebar Stems Recalled by Deda Elementi Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Deda Forza Bicycle Handlebar Stems
recalls.hazard: The top of the bicycle handlebar stem can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles equipped with the recalled Deda Forza handlebar stems and return them to the place of purchase to receive a free replacement handlebar stem.
recalls.description: The recall involves bicycles with Deda Forza black carbon fiber handlebar stems in gloss finish. "Deda Forza" is printed on the handlebar stem. Deda Forza black carbon fiber handlebar stems in matte finish are not included in this recall.
recalls.injuries: Deda Elementi has received four reports of incidents involving the handlebar stems. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Cervelo SA Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Wolf SL Carbon Fiber Bicycle Forks
recalls.hazard: The fork's steerer can break during normal use, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer serious injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles equipped with the recalled forks and contact their authorized Cervélo dealer to have a free replacement fork installed.
recalls.description: The recalled forks have a clear coating over black painted carbon fiber, with the words "Wolf Superlite" and related logo just below the crown on each fork leg, and the letters "SL" on each leg above the fork blade dropouts.
recalls.injuries: Cervélo has received 12 reports of forks cracking or breaking, resulting in one consumer suffering a broken wrist and another suffering minor abrasions.

recalls.title: Electra Bicycle Company Expands Recall of Amsterdam Bicycles; Chain Can Derail and Pose Injury Risk to Riders
recalls.name: Amsterdam Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The interior alignment tabs of the bicycle's chainguard can be pushed against the chain causing it to derail, which poses a risk of injury to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles and contact Electra Bicycle to determine if his/her bike is included in this recall. Consumers with a recalled bike can bring it to an Electra Bicycle dealer for a free inspection and replacement chainguard part.
recalls.units: About 1,500 (This recall was first announced in July 2008)
recalls.description: This recall involves some Amsterdam model bicycles in the Classic 3, Original 3, Royal 8, and Sport 3 styles. The bicycles have an enclosed chainguard. "Electra" and "Amsterdam" are printed on the bicycle's frame and/or chainguard.
recalls.injuries: Electra has received four reports of the chainguard derailing the chain, including one report of minor cuts and abrasion from a fall.

recalls.title: Rossignol Recalls Snowboard Bindings Due to Strap Failure
recalls.name: 2007 Rossignol HC Snowboard Bindings
recalls.hazard: The t-nuts that attach the buckles to the straps on the snowboard bindings can detach, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bindings and take them to a Rossignol snowboard retailer for inspection and free replacement t-nuts. Consumers can also contact Rossignol to have a repair kit mailed to them. T-nuts marked in red-ink or with an embossed dot have been repaired.
recalls.description: This recall involves 2007 model year Rossignol snowboard bindings. Models included in the recall are: HC 750, HC 1000, HC 2000, HC 3000, HC Mini, HC Amber, HC Diva, HC Harmony, HC Sonar, HC Zena and Jones Brown.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Bicycle Pedals Recalled by Look Cycle; Pedals Can Break Causing Cyclists to Fall
recalls.name: KéO Bicycle Pedals
recalls.hazard: The steel axle inside the pedal can break, posing a fall hazard to cyclists.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycle pedals and return them to any authorized Look Cycle dealer, or contact Look Cycle USA to arrange for shipping and free repair.
recalls.description: The recalled bicycle pedals were sold separately from bicycles. Pedal models include KéO Classic, KéO Sprint, KéO HM and KéO Carbon. The model name is printed in white on the side of the pedal.
recalls.injuries: Look Cycle has received 14 reports of incidents with broken pedals, including 7 injuries which resulted in scrapes, cuts, contusions, elbow pain, and a knee…

recalls.title: New England Ropes Recalls Climbing Lines Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Maxim Apogee and Maxim Pinnacle Dynamic Climbing Lines/Ropes
recalls.hazard: The climbing lines can break, posing a serious fall hazard for climbers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled dynamic climbing lines and contact the manufacturer for a free replacement.
recalls.description: Two types of climbing ropes have been included in this recall, the Maxim Apogee 9.1mm and Maxim Pinnacle 9.5mm. The Maxim Apogee 9.1mm is a 48 carrier climbing rope. The colors are yellow and black, and red and yellow.
recalls.injuries: None.

recalls.title: Reebok International Ltd. Recalls Exercise Cycles Due to Laceration Hazard
recalls.name: Reebok Studio Exercise Cycles
recalls.hazard: The alloy cranks on the exercise cycles can break during use, posing a laceration and abrasion hazard to users.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled Studio Cycle immediately, and owners should contact Reebok International Ltd. to receive a discount on a model currently made by a licensee of Reebok.
recalls.description: The Reebok Studio Cycle is an upright exercise bike used primarily in fitness centers and other institutional settings. The recalled bicycle is black with silver cranks. The unit has an internal belt drive.
recalls.injuries: Reebok International Ltd. has received five reports of cranks breaking and causing lacerations.

recalls.title: Electra Bicycle Company Recalls Amsterdam Bicycles; Chain Can Derail and Pose Injury Risk to Riders
recalls.name: Amsterdam Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The interior alignment tabs of the bicycle's chainguard can be pushed against the chain, causing it to derail, which poses a risk of injury to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the recalled bicycle and bring it to an Electra Bicycle dealer for a free inspection and replacement chainguard part.
recalls.description: This recall involves some Amsterdam model bicycles in the Classic 3, Original 3, Royal 8, and Sport 3 styles. The bicycles have an enclosed chainguard. "Electra" and "Amsterdam" are printed on the bicycle's frame and/or chainguard.
recalls.injuries: Electra has received four reports of the chainguard derailing the chain, including one report of minor cuts and abrasion from a fall.

recalls.title: Hayes Bicycle Group Recalls Quick-Release Devices for Bicycles Due To Fall Hazard
recalls.name: SunRinglé Ringle Hollow Quick Release Devices for Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The quick release devices can unexpectedly fail or break when locked in position on the bicycle, causing the rider to lose control, which poses a serious fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding bicycles with the recalled quick release devices immediately, remove the quick release device and bring it to their local bike dealer or retailer for a free inspection and replacement.
recalls.description: This recall involves the SunRinglé Hollow Quick Release Devices for bicycles and includes models Hollow CroMo Front 100mm, Hollow CroMo Rear 130mm, and Hollow CroMo Rear 135mm. These devices have hollow skewers.
recalls.injuries: Hayes Bicycle Group has received four reports of the quick release device breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: E-Z-GO Recalls RXV Golf Cars Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: RXV Golf Cars
recalls.hazard: The hip restraints on the cars can detach at the base, posing a fall and injury risk to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should contact the nearest E-Z-GO dealer to arrange for a free repair. E-Z-GO and E-Z-GO dealers are contacting known owners.
recalls.description: This recall involves electric and gasoline-powered Fleet RXV, Freedom RXV and RXV Shuttle 2+2 golf cars. The model names and the E-Z-GO logo are printed on the sides and front panel of all three vehicles.
recalls.injuries: E-Z-GO has received 20 reports of hip restraints breaking, including nine reports of broken bones and abrasions from falls.

recalls.title: BRP U.S. Inc. Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Ski-Doo® Snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: Friction between the fuel hose and the cylinder head cover can cause the hose to pierce. This can cause fuel to leak out, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these vehicles immediately and contact any Ski-Doo dealer to schedule a free repair. Consumers with recalled snowmobiles are being sent a direct notice from BRP.
recalls.units: About 430 (This recall was first announced in May 2008)
recalls.description: The recall involves the following Ski-Doo® Models: Model Color 2007 and 2008 Expedition TUV V800 Deep Red/Black 2007 and 2008 Skandic SWT V-800 Yellow/Black The model names are located on the side panel.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received two reports of fuel leakage and five additional reports of hose wear. No injuries or property damage have been reported.

recalls.title: Batting Helmets Recalled by Rawlings Sporting Goods Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
recalls.name: Rawlings Junior Batting Helmets
recalls.hazard: Surface paint on the helmets contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled helmets and contact either the retailer where the product was purchased or Rawlings for a free replacement product.
recalls.description: This recall involves junior batting helmets with model number CFHLJR. The helmets come in yellow and orange with black accents. The model number can be found on the rear of the helmet.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: BRP U.S. Inc. Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Explosion Hazard
recalls.name: Ski-Doo Snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: Under extreme cold and dry weather conditions, an explosion could occur because of sparking in the fuel tank, when it is partially filled with gasoline at a low vapor pressure and the engine is left idling. This could cause serious injuries or death.
recalls.remedy: Consumers with recalled snowmobiles are being sent a direct notice from BRP. Consumers should stop using these vehicles immediately and contact any Ski-Doo dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves Ski-Doo® model names listed below. Model names are located on the side panel. Model Year Name Color 2005 Expedition TUV 600 H.O.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received four reports of explosions, one involving burns to legs, fingers and face.

recalls.title: K2 Sports Recalls Snowboard Bindings Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: K2 "Auto" Series Snowboard Bindings, Model Year 2007
recalls.hazard: The cable that links the toe strap to the binding could break, posing a fall hazard to snowboarders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bindings immediately and take them to the retailer where purchased or contact K2 Sports directly to arrange for free shipment and repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves the 2007 model year K2 "Auto" snowboard bindings. They were sold in black or white. "K2" and "Auto" are printed on the toe strap.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Basketball and Flower Tables Recalled by Avon Products Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard; Sold in Puerto Rico and U.S. Virgin Islands
recalls.name: Basketball and Flower Tables
recalls.hazard: Surface paint on the tables contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take the tables away from children immediately and contact Avon for a full refund. Known purchasers are being directly notified of this recall.
recalls.description: The Basketball Table is about 16 inches tall with white legs and a 19-inch diameter top. The Flower Table is about 30 inches tall with a green petal stand and a 15-inch diameter purple and yellow top.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Trek Recalls Girls' Bicycles Due To Frame Failure
recalls.name: Trek MT220 Girls' Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's frame can break during use, causing the rider to lose control and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled bicycle away from children immediately and return it to a Trek dealer for a free replacement MT220 girls' bicycle or a $100 discount on a different size Trek bicycle.
recalls.description: This recall involves Trek girls' bicycles model MT220 and model years 2005 (light metallic blue), 2006 (metallic silver and metallic purple or pink and pearl white), and 2007 (pink and white pearl or metallic purple).
recalls.injuries: Trek has received 13 reports of frames breaking, including four minor injuries.

recalls.title: Pacific Cycle Recalls Children's Trailer Bicycles; Can Detach from Adult Bicycle and Injure Children
recalls.name: InStep "Pathfinder," Schwinn "Run About," and Mongoose "Alley Cat" Trailer Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The coupler connecting the children's trailer bike to the adult's bicycle has welds that can fail, posing a fall hazard to children.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the trailer bicycle immediately and contact the firm for a free repair kit.
recalls.description: The "Pathfinder," "Run About," and "Alley Cat" are single-wheeled, children's bicycles that connect to an adult's bicycle by a coupler. The recall includes model numbers: 12-PF250, 13-SC250, 13-SC350 and M5101.
recalls.injuries: Pacific Cycle has received one report of the coupler failing, resulting in a fall and abrasions to the rider.

recalls.title: Cannondale Recalls Scalpel Mountain Bikes; Frame Failure Poses Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Cannondale 2008 model year "Scalpel" mountain bikes
recalls.hazard: The frame can break while in use, causing the rider to lose control and suffer injuries from a fall or collision.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycle immediately and contact Cannondale or authorized dealer for a free replacement frame. Consumers have been directly notified.
recalls.description: The 2008 model year Scalpel is a cross-country racing mountain bike, made from carbon fiber and aluminum. They were sold in Black/White, Blue/Black and Black.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received six reports of frames breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Bombardier Recreational Products Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Crash Hazard
recalls.name: Ski-Doo® Model Year 2008 MXZ X 600 RS Snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: A defect in the carburetor can prevent the throttle from freely returning to the idle position. This can result in an unexpected loss of control, leading to a collision, and cause serious injuries or death.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these vehicles immediately and contact any Ski-Doo dealer to schedule a free repair. Consumers with recalled snowmobiles are being sent direct notices from Bombardier.
recalls.description: The recall involves Ski-Doo model year 2008 MXZ X 600 RS snowmobiles. The model name is located on the side panels. The snowmobiles were sold in yellow or black/slate.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received three reports of snowmobiles with stuck throttles. No injuries reported.

recalls.title: Bicycle Helmets Recalled by Specialized Due to Failing Helmet Standard
recalls.name: Specialized Bicycle Helmets
recalls.hazard: The helmets fail testing required under CPSC's safety standard for bicycle helmets. This can pose a head injury hazard to riders in a fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled helmet immediately and return it to an Authorized Specialized Retailer to receive a free replacement or a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves the Specialized helmets, model 2D. Model "2D" is printed on the sides of the helmet in the rear. The helmets were sold for men and women in matte black, white, silver, blue, pink, and team colors.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Full Body Safety Harnesses Recalled by Gorilla Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Full Body Safety Harnesses
recalls.hazard: The harnesses could fail during use, resulting in a hunter falling from the tree stand and suffering serious injuries or death.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled safety harness immediately and contact Gorilla for a free replacement harness.
recalls.description: This recall involves the Pullover Style Full Body Safety Harnesses model SP40300 that were included as an accessory with Gorilla 2007 ladder stands. The harnesses bear batch code numbers 020507, 030507 and 040507.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Gamenamics Inc. Recalls Air-Powered Hockey Tables Due to Burn Hazard
recalls.name: Cordless Air-Powered Hockey Tables with Rechargeable Battery
recalls.hazard: The hockey table's wires can overheat or melt, posing a burn hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the air hockey table until they have installed the free repair kit. If consumers find wire damage, including burnt or melted wires, they should contact Hammacher Schlemmer to return the product for a full refund.
recalls.description: This recall involves cordless air-powered hockey tables with a rechargeable battery. The table can be folded and moved on attached wheels.
recalls.injuries: Gamenamics has received eleven reports of burnt or melted wires. No property damage or injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Fitness Quest Recalls Eclipse Elliptical Trainers Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Eclipse® 1175e Elliptical Trainers
recalls.hazard: The cranks that connect the foot platforms to the rear wheel of the machine can break during exercise, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled elliptical trainers immediately and contact Fitness Quest for a $300 credit towards the purchase of another Fitness Quest exercise machine.
