recalls.description: This recall involves the Eclipse® 1175e elliptical trainers. The elliptical trainer is a cardiovascular exercise machine. The machine has two foot platforms attached to a wheel at the rear of the machine.
recalls.injuries: Fitness Quest has received about 190 reports of cranks breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Bell Racing Recalls Collectible Mini Racing Helmets Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
recalls.name: Collectible Mini Helmets
recalls.hazard: Surface paints on the recalled helmets contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled helmets away from young children immediately and contact Bell Racing to receive a full refund.
recalls.description: The recalled products are six-inch tall, collectible, miniature helmets, modeled after helmets worn by several race car drivers. The follow models are included in the recall: Terry Borcheller helmet, part number 2005740; Kurt Busch helmet, part number…
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Nike Recalls Football Helmet Chin Straps Which Can Break and Pose Risk of Serious Injury
recalls.name: Football Helmet Chin Straps
recalls.hazard: The chin strap's plastic cup can break as a result of contact, exposing the player to facial or head injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the chin strap immediately and contact Nike for a product voucher redeemable at www.nikestore.com.
recalls.description: The recalled football helmet chin strap consists of a plastic cup with a foam liner, straps and four metal snaps. They were sold in both youth and adult sizes and come in black/gray and white/gray color combinations.
recalls.injuries: Nike has received 18 reports of the chin strap breaking, including two reports of concussions, two reports of facial lacerations requiring stitches, and a…

recalls.title: Swimways Corp. Recalls "Skippy" Pool Toys Due to Laceration Hazard
recalls.name: Skippy Pool Toys
recalls.hazard: The elastic tongue of the fish can break and forcefully come out and cut the users' hands during launching of the toy.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take the toy away from children immediately and contact Swimways for a free replacement toy.
recalls.description: This recall involves a rubber pool toy shaped like a fish. The fish are blue, purple or green colored and measure 8 ½ inches long by 5 inches wide.
recalls.injuries: Swimways has received 24 reports of the pool toy breaking during use. There were five reports of injuries to children including one requiring stitches to a…

recalls.title: Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Crash and Fire Hazards
recalls.name: Ski-Doo Model Year 2008 Snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: The snowmobiles' fuel tanks can crack allowing liquid fuel and fuel vapor to leak, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. In addition, a problem with the throttle cable can lead to loss of speed control, posing a crash hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these snowmobiles immediately and contact a local Ski-Doo dealer to schedule a free repair.
recalls.description: Ski-Doo Model Year 2008 MXZ Adrenaline 800R, MXZ X 800R, MXZ TNT 500SS, MXZ Trail 500SS, Summit Everest 154 800R snowmobiles are included in this recall. The model name is located on the side panels. They were sold in black/yellow, yellow, or black/slate.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: DecoPac Inc. Recalls Football Bobble Head Cake Decorations Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
recalls.name: Football Bobble Head Cake Decorations
recalls.hazard: Surface paint on the body of the bobble head contains lead in excess of the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the football bobble heads immediately and contact DecoPac to receive a free product of equal value.
recalls.description: The recall includes plastic miniature football bobble heads with green bases only, which were sold for placement on a cake. The bobble heads represented the following teams: Baltimore Ravens, Green Bay Packers, Oakland Raiders, Chicago Bears, Indianapolis…
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Reynolds Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Reynolds UL Bicycle Forks
recalls.hazard: The fork tips could separate from the fork legs, causing the wheel to come loose from the fork while riding. This could pose a serious fall hazard to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles equipped with the recalled forks immediately and contact Reynolds for a free replacement fork.
recalls.description: This recall involves the Reynolds UL bicycle fork models with 43 mm and 50 mm rakes and with serial numbers 09100 through 10403. The serial number decal is located on the steer tube. To see the serial number, the fork must be removed from the frame.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Ski Boards Recalled by Line Skis Due to Fall Hazard from Binding Failure
recalls.name: 2006 Line X-Fly and Line Pro Ski Boards
recalls.hazard: Screws installed improperly can cause the bindings to come loose or pull off the ski board during use, causing the skier to lose control or fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled ski boards and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund. If consumers are unable to return the ski boards to the place of purchase, contact the firm for instructions.
recalls.description: The 2006 Line X-Fly and Line Pro model ski boards were sold in 90- and 99-centimeter lengths. The Pro model is a twin-tip ski which is turned up at both ends. "Pro 90" or "Pro 98" is printed on the tail.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received one report of the screws that hold the binding to the ski board pulling out during use. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Cybex International Inc. Recalls Treadmills Previously Repaired Due to Fire Hazard
recalls.name: Cybex or Trotter Treadmills
recalls.hazard: During repairs associated with the October 8, 2003 recall, wire nuts were installed improperly, causing the treadmills to overheat and posing a fire hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers whose treadmills were included in the 2003 recall and were repaired should immediately unplug and stop using the treadmills. Consumers with recalled units will be notified directly by Cybex. Consumers should call Cybex directly to schedule a free repair.
recalls.units: 4,700 (This recall was first announced in Oct. 2003)
recalls.description: This recall involves the treadmills "Cybex 400T," "Cybex 410T," "Trotter 510," "Trotter 525", "Trotter 535", and "CXT+" that were recalled on October 8, 2003 and later repaired.
recalls.injuries: Cybex International has received five reports of treadmills overheating or catching fire resulting in damage to the treadmill. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Additional Injuries Prompt Re-announcement of Sportsstuff Recall of Air Pumps
recalls.name: Inflator Air Pumps (sold separately and included with "Launch Pod" Water Trampolines)
recalls.hazard: The air pumps can overheat and explode during use, posing a risk of lacerations.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the pumps and contact Sportsstuff for a free replacement.
recalls.units: About 11,000 (This recall was first announced in Jan. 2007)
recalls.description: The recalled products are air pumps with model numbers 57-1504-A and 57-1504 that are used to inflate low pressure inflatable items such as rafts and toys. The Model 57-1504-A pump was sold separately with an assortment of interlocking nozzles.
recalls.injuries: Since the first recall announcement on January 11, 2007, 16 additional explosions have been reported.

recalls.title: Formula Brake USA Recalls Disc Brakes for Bicycles Due to Risk of Failure
recalls.name: Oro Disc Brakes used on bicycles
recalls.hazard: The brake's hand lever can separate, resulting in loss of braking. This can cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle, posing a risk of injury to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using bicycles equipped with the recalled brakes and contact any Formula Brake dealer to receive a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves Oro disk brakes typically installed on mountain bikes. The brake is operated by a hand lever, which is mounted to the handlebar.
recalls.injuries: Formula Brake USA has received six reports of hand levers detaching. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Huffy Recalls Bicycles Due To Cranks Falling Off; Riders Can Lose Control of Bike
recalls.name: 2007 Huffy "Howler" and "Highland" Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle crank can unexpectedly come off, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer serious injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bicycles immediately and contact Huffy Corp. to receive instructions on tightening the crank.
recalls.description: The recall involves 2007 model year, multi-speed bicycles with 26-inch, 24-inch or 20-inch wheels. The "Howler" was sold in black (model K3587, boy's model), blue (model K4587, men's model), and red (model K6587, men's model).
recalls.injuries: Huffy has received two reports of the crank coming off, resulting in one injury.

recalls.title: Procycle Group Inc. Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Rocky Mountain-Solo Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The head tube can detach from the rest of the frame, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycle immediately and return the frame to the bicycle store where purchased to receive a free replacement frame, a full refund, or credit.
recalls.description: This recall involves the Rocky Mountain Bicycles brand of Solo bicycles. The models included in this recall are: 2006 SOLO CR50, 2006 SOLO CR70, and 2007 SOLO CR LTD. The bicycles have a full carbon Columbus frame.
recalls.injuries: Procycle Group Inc. has received two reports of head tubes detaching from the frames, resulting in shoulder and facial injuries.

recalls.title: Riddell Recalls Collectible Mini Racing Helmets Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
recalls.name: Collectible "Jeff Gordon" Mini Helmets
recalls.hazard: Surface paints on the recalled helmets contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled helmets away from young children immediately and contact Riddell to receive a full refund.
recalls.description: The recalled product is a six-inch tall, collectible, miniature helmet, modeled after the helmet worn by race car driver Jeff Gordon. The helmet is red and blue with a black visor, and is painted with various sponsor logos and playing cards.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Razor USA Recalls E300 Electric Scooters; Handlebars Can Detach Causing Loss of Control
recalls.name: Razor® E300 Electric Scooters
recalls.hazard: A weld can break causing the handlebar to detach. This can cause the rider to lose control and fall from the scooter.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product immediately and contact Razor USA to obtain a free repair kit.
recalls.description: The recall involves Model E300 Electric Scooters, which are powered by battery-operated motors. The model number appears on the tube that connects the head tube to the deck. The recalled scooters are blue or silver.
recalls.injuries: Razor has received 25 reports of welds breaking on the handlebar, including three reports of minor injuries, such as scrapes and bruises.

recalls.title: REI Recalls Children's Trailer Bicycles; Can Detach from Adult Bicycle and Injure Children
recalls.name: Novara Afterburner Trailer Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The children's trailer bicycle can detach from the adult bicycle, posing a fall hazard to children.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bicycle trailer, visit the nearest REI store or contact REI for a free replacement part, a full refund or credit.
recalls.description: This recall involves the Novara Afterburner trailer bicycle, a single-wheel children's bicycle that attaches to, and cannot be operated independently of, an adult bicycle.
recalls.injuries: REI has received one report of a children's trailer bicycle detaching from the adult bicycle. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Raleigh America Recalls Bicycles; Forks Can Break Causing Loss of Control
recalls.name: 2007 Raleigh Cadent Bicycles with Carbonage Carbon Forks
recalls.hazard: The forks can break during normal use, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer serious injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bicycles immediately and return them to place of purchase. Raleigh bicycle dealers will replace the forks at no charge.
recalls.description: The recall involves the 2007 Raleigh Cadent 1.0, Cadent 2.0 and Cadent Carbon bicycle models with carbon forks. "Raleigh" is printed on the down tube of the bicycle, and the model name is printed on the top tube.
recalls.injuries: Raleigh America has received three reports of forks breaking, resulting in injuries, including a dislocated shoulder, a concussion and a broken jaw.

recalls.title: Club Car Inc. Recalls Golf Cars and Other Vehicles; Mechanical Failure Can Result in Loss of Steering Control
recalls.name: Golf Cars; Rough Terrain Vehicles; and Hospitality, Utility & Transport Vehicles
recalls.hazard: The steering gear assembly can fail, resulting in an unexpected loss of steering control, posing a risk of injury to the driver and passenger.
recalls.remedy: Not all 2007 model year vehicles are included in this recall. Owners who have not already been contacted by Club Car should check the vehicle's model and serial number on the firm's Web site or by calling Club Car to determine if their vehicle is included in the recall. Owners should stop using the recalled vehicles immediately. Club Car will inspect the vehicle to determine whether a free replacement of the steering gear assembly is needed.
recalls.description: The recall involves various 2007 model year gasoline or electric-powered vehicles used for transportation around golf courses, hotels, resorts, airports and residential communities.
recalls.injuries: None.

recalls.title: Cannondale Announces Recall of Mountain Bicycles; Lefty Forks Can Break Unexpectedly
recalls.name: Mountain Bicycles with Lefty Speed SL and Lefty Speed DLR Forks
recalls.hazard: The forks can break during use, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall and suffer serious injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately. Cannondale dealers will repair these forks at no charge.
recalls.description: The carbon or aluminum bicycle forks were sold on Cannondale mountain bicycle models listed below: Bicycle model code, product Retail price Lefty Speed Carbon SL 2007 Taurine Carbon Team Replica 2007 Scalpel 1 2007 Scalpel Team Replica 2007 Rush Carbon 1 2007…
recalls.injuries: Cannondale has received 15 reports of the bicycle forks separating, including five reports of injuries including a broken collarbone, a concussion, broken ribs…

recalls.title: Cannondale Recalls Bicycles With Carbon Crankset Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles with Carbon Cranksets
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's crankset could break, posing a fall hazard to user.
recalls.remedy: Cannondale dealers will inspect the bicycle cranksets to determine if a free replacement is needed.
recalls.description: Cranksets are the gears at the front of the bicycle chain with pedals attached to the outer ends. The crankset spins on a bearing and axle assembly called a bottom bracket.
recalls.injuries: Cannondale has received two reports of the cranksets breaking resulting in one minor injury.

recalls.title: Kayak Paddle Floats Recalled by NRS Due to Drowning Hazard
recalls.name: NRS Sea Kayak Paddle Floats
recalls.hazard: The plastic tubes used to inflate the paddle float could break and deflate, posing a drowning hazard to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the paddle floats immediately and contact NRS to determine if you have one of the recalled models. NRS will provide a free replacement paddle float for consumers with recalled units.
recalls.description: The NRS Sea Kayak Paddle Float is an inflatable device that is attached to one side of the paddle to help the kayaker re-enter the kayak in open water. The paddle float is yellow and black and measures 15" wide by 28" long, before inflation.
recalls.injuries: NRS has received five reports of paddle floats breaking and deflating. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: K2 Sports Recalls Marker M1 Demo Ski Bindings Due to Unexpected Release, Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Marker M1 Demo Ski Bindings
recalls.hazard: Skiers can unintentionally displace a lever at the rear of the binding, which is used for fitting adjustment by ski technicians. If it is fully displaced, it can result in the unexpected release of the binding and possibly cause the user to fall.
recalls.remedy: Ski shops have been advised to stop renting skis with these bindings until they have been repaired. All adjustments and inspections of Alpine ski bindings should be performed by a qualified ski shop technician.
recalls.description: This recall involves Marker M1 Demo ski bindings, which fit only on certain K2 skis with the K2/Marker Mod integrated mounting system. These bindings will not mount on other skis.
recalls.injuries: K2 Sports has received at least 10 reports of bindings unexpectedly releasing, which may be due to this hazard, including one report of a skier receiving…

recalls.title: Hunter's View Expands Recall of Safety Harnesses Sold with Tree Stands, Also Recalls Harnesses Provided as Replacements
recalls.name: Safety Harnesses Sold with Tree Stands and Harnesses Provided as Replacements
recalls.hazard: The harnesses could fail during use, resulting in a hunter falling from the tree stand and suffering serious injuries or death.
recalls.remedy: Firm is no longer in business. Remedy is not available. Discard this product.
recalls.units: About 200,000 additional harnesses (This recall was first announced in April 2005)
recalls.description: The recall involves all 2004 and 2005 model year Fall Arrest Systems (FAS), or harnesses with "Model Year 2004" or "Model Year 2005" printed on a white Hunter's View label attached to the harness or the tree strap.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Intex Recreation Corp. Recalls Ladders for Above-Ground Pools Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Intex®, "Easy Set®" and "Sand N Sun™" Above-Ground Pool Ladders
recalls.hazard: The ladder's plastic steps can be assembled backward on the support brackets. If this happens, the ladder steps can break and the user can fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the ladders and contact Intex to obtain information about how to obtain a free replacement ladder.
recalls.description: The recall includes 42-inch, 48-inch, and 52-inch "A" frame pool ladders. The ladders were sold with above ground pools with the brand names "Intex®," "Easy Set®" and "Sand N Sun™" in the following sizes: 15 feet by 42 inches, 15 feet by 48 inches, 16 feet by…
recalls.injuries: Intex has received 172 reports of steps breaking during use. There were 127 reports of injuries, including six leg lacerations requiring up to 21 stitches,…

recalls.title: Dynacraft Recalls Bicycles Sold Exclusively at Target Due to Frame Failure
recalls.name: Triax PK7 and Vertical PK7 Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle frame can crack while in use, causing the rider to lose control and suffer injuries from a fall or collision.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately and return them to the nearest Target store to receive a full refund, including applicable sales tax.
recalls.description: This recall involves Triax PK7 (model 8509-24) and Vertical PK7 (model 8596-71T) 20-inch aluminum cushion framed bicycles. The Triax model was manufactured between November 2005 and October 2006, and the Vertical model was manufactured between August 2004 and…
recalls.injuries: The firm has received two reports of bicycle frames cracking, resulting in minor injuries including scratches to the legs and feet.

recalls.title: Mirraco Recalls Bicycles Due to Wheel Fork Failure Hazard
recalls.name: Mirraco Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The front wheel forks on these bicycles could have been welded improperly. This poses a risk that the weld could fail, and the rider could lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately and have them inspected by a Mirraco dealer. If the inspection shows that the bicycle is part of the recall, the fork will be replaced free of charge.
recalls.description: The recall involves BMX bicycles. The model name is printed on the bicycle. Recalled models include the following: Mirraco Models Blend 3 Black Pearl 3 Fivestar Park Blend 2 Black Pearl 2 Icon Moto Blend 1 Black Pearl 1 Icon 20Forty Blend 1s Blend 16
recalls.injuries: The firm has received four reports of steer tube rotation and one report of a fork separation due to failure of the welds. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Cannondale Recalls 2007 Model Road Bicycles Due to Brake Failure
recalls.name: Cannondale 2007 Model Road Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's front brake can fail, causing the rider to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately until inspected or repaired. Cannondale or Authorized Cannondale Dealers have contacted affected consumers directly for a free inspection and repair, if necessary.
recalls.description: The recalled road racing bicycles are made from aluminum and carbon fiber or all carbon fiber. The model name is printed on the bicycle's top tube. They were sold in the following colors: natural aluminum/carbon, red, black or black and blue.
recalls.injuries: No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Liberty Mountain Recalls Climbing Harnesses Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Edelweiss Challenge Climbing Harnesses
recalls.hazard: The buckles on the harness's leg loops could fail, posing a fall hazard for climbers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled harnesses and contact Liberty Mountain for instructions on returning the harnesses including a return authorization number. Liberty Mountain will provide a free inspection and free repair. Send your harness for repair to: Liberty Mountain, 4375 West 1980 South, Salt Lake City, Utah 84104.
recalls.description: The sit harnesses are worn around climber's waist and legs and attach to climbing ropes to protect climbers from falling. The harnesses have three buckles including one on the waist belt and one on each leg loop. "Edelweiss" is printed on the waist belt.
recalls.injuries: Liberty Mountain has received five reports of the leg buckle failing. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Bicycle Pedals Recalled by Time Sport International Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Time RXS Titan Carbon, RXS Carbon, RXS and RXE Bicycle Pedals
recalls.hazard: The pedal's bearing cap can fail causing the pedal to come off the bicycle. This poses a fall hazard for riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled pedals immediately and contact TIME SPORT INTERNATIONAL to arrange for the pedals to be inspected and, if necessary, receive a free repair.
recalls.description: The recalled pedals are black or gray. They are made of composite material and are mounted to either a steel or titanium pedal axle and bearing unit by using a threaded aluminum bearing cap.
recalls.injuries: The firm has received reports of eight incidents in which the pedal came off the bicycle, resulting in minor injuries.

recalls.title: Petzl America Recalls Climbing Equipment Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Carabiners used for climbing
recalls.hazard: These carabiners have a green button that acts as a safety mechanism to prevent unlocking. The recalled carabiners can unlock unexpectedly without pressing the green button, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled carabiners immediately, and contact Petzl America to have their carabiners inspected and to receive a free replacement, if necessary.
recalls.description: The recall involves the M34 BL Am'D Ball Lock and M36 BL William Ball Lock carabiners with metal locking sleeves. Carabiners with batch number between 06076 and 06178 are included in the recall. The batch number is engraved on the spine of the carabiner.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Light & Motion Recalls Bicycle Light Batteries for Fire and Burn Hazards
recalls.name: ARC Lithium-Ion Bicycle Light Batteries
recalls.hazard: The battery can overheat, posing a fire or burn hazard to users.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the lights immediately and return the battery to Light & Motion for a free replacement.
recalls.description: The recalled batteries are found in Light & Motion 2004 ARC Li-Ion HID lighting systems. The lights are black with "ARC" and "LIGHT & MOTION" written in yellow letters. The recall includes only batteries with a manufacturer date code of 1003 or 1103.
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Cervelo Cycles Inc. Announces Recall of Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: 2005 R2.5 Model Carbon Fiber Bicycles and Bicycle Frames
recalls.hazard: The bicycle frames can loosen or separate, causing the rider to lose control, fall and be injured.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles with the recalled frames and contact Cervèlo to receive a free replacement frame.
recalls.description: This recall only involves the 2005 model year R2.5 model bicycles and bicycle frames with serial numbers higher than R251700. The model numbers and serial numbers are printed on the bicycle frame tubes.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Pool Toys Recalled by Wild Planet Toys Due to Risk of Impalement Injury to Children
recalls.name: Jet Streamers™ Water Blasters Pool Toys
recalls.hazard: When partially filled with water, the pool toy can stand upright on the pool floor with the rigid narrow end pointed upward, posing an impalement risk.
recalls.remedy: Customers should immediately stop using the Jet Streamers and contact Wild Planet for a replacement product. The replacement product has an angled handle that prevents the handle of the toy from standing upright.
recalls.description: The Jet Streamers™ Outdoor Antics! Pump-Action Water Blasters are straight squirt guns for the pool. The Jet Streamers measure 9 inches long with a bulbous water reservoir at one end and a rigid tapering handle containing a small water intake hole at the…
recalls.injuries: Wild Planet has received one report of an impalement injury to an 8-year-old girl, who landed seat first onto a Jet Streamer left in a swimming pool and…

recalls.title: Target Recalls Scooters - Various Breaking Parts Present Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Firestreet Scooters
recalls.hazard: The handlebars, wheels and wheel brakes can break and detach, causing the rider to lose control, fall and possibly suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take these scooters away from children immediately and return the scooter to the nearest Target store for a $24 gift card, plus applicable sales tax.
recalls.description: This recall involves F Forward Firestreet scooters. The red or blue aluminum scooters have a fold-down frame and model number BZ 020 SP. The "F Forward" logo is noted on the stem, wheel or base deck of the scooter.
recalls.injuries: Target has received five reports of incidents and injuries resulting from breaking or collapsing parts.

recalls.title: Speed Buckle Harnesses Used During Mountain and Rock Climbing Recalled for Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Speed Buckle Harnesses
recalls.hazard: The harness could be threaded incorrectly. If threaded incorrectly, the webbing will easily slip when loaded. Incorrectly threaded buckles can loosen, which could cause climbers to slip out of the harness and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using recalled harnesses and contact the firm for a free replacement harness.
recalls.description: These Speed Buckle Harnesses were sold under the following model names: Gym Speed, Focus Speed, Momentum Speed, Vario Speed and Wiz Kid. The names can be found on a tag sewn inside the waist belt of the harnesses.
recalls.injuries: None reported

recalls.title: Felt Bicycles Announce Recall to Repair Mountain Bicycles for Brake Failure
recalls.name: Felt Mountain Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The steel brake boss can detach from the frame, causing the rider to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately and contact your local Felt bicycle dealer to receive a free inspection and repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves all model year 2005 and 2006 Kinesis-made RXC bicycles. The frames on these bicycles are made with carbon fiber rear seat stays and are equipped with V-style brakes, and not equipped with disk brakes from the factory.
recalls.injuries: Felt Bicycles has received three reports of the brake boss coming loose. No injuries reported.

recalls.title: Specialized Bicycle Components Inc. Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Bicycles with SW Carbon Stem with Magnesium Faceplate
recalls.hazard: The bicycle's stem has a magnesium faceplate that holds the handlebar in place. The faceplates on the recalled stems can crack, allowing the handlebar to break off the bicycle, posing a serious fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding the bicycles that have the recalled stems immediately and take them to an authorized Specialized retailer for a free replacement faceplate.
recalls.description: The SW Carbon Stem with Magnesium Faceplate is black with the words "S-Works" and "Magnesium Faceplate" printed on it. The stems were included as original equipment on the following 2006 bicycles models: S-Works Tarmac, Tarmac Pro, S-Works Roubaix, Roubaix…
recalls.injuries: Specialized has received five reports of the magnesium faceplate exhibiting cracks. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Vision Fitness Recalls Treadmill Console to Repair Unexpected Acceleration Hazard
recalls.name: 2006 Model Year Premier Console (sold with Vision Fitness treadmill frames)
recalls.hazard: Due to a programming defect with the console, the treadmill can unexpectedly increase in speed and elevation when the User Programs 4 or 5 are set for longer than 30 minutes. If this happens, the user could fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should contact the retailer where purchased or Vision Fitness to make arrangements for a return, repair or replacement console.
recalls.description: The consoles were sold with Vision Fitness treadmill frames and control the operation of the treadmill. 2006 Premier Consoles can be identified by the word Premier or T9700HRT printed on the console face under the Vision Fitness logo.
recalls.injuries: Vision Fitness has received one report of these treadmills unexpectedly increasing speed and elevation. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Extreme Engineering Recalls Wall Climbing Cable Assemblies Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Cable Assemblies (used in wall climbing)
recalls.hazard: The cable eye, or round metal tube that holds the cable, could have a fracture, reducing the overall strength of the cable assembly. If the cable assembly were to fail, this would result in a free-fall hazard for the climber.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled cable assemblies immediately and contact Extreme Engineering to arrange for inspection details and possible replacement of the cable assembly.
recalls.description: These cable assemblies are used by wall climbers in auto-belay and auto-zip devices to prevent a climber from free-falling. The cable assemblies are made up of a stainless steel cable eye, and 1/4-inch galvanized wire rope.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Full-Body Safety Harnesses Recalled for Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Safety Harnesses Sold with Hunting Tree Stands
recalls.hazard: The harnesses could fail during use, resulting in consumers falling from tree stands and suffering serious injuries or death.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled harnesses and contact the firm for a free replacement harness.
recalls.description: The harnesses are tan or light brown and were sold as an accessory with the following tree stands or ladders: Viper X5, Goliath X5, Razor X5, Summit 180o, Bushmaster X5, Broadhead Backpacker, Bullet Backpacker, Clearshot, Openshot, and MegaSampson.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: Endurance Treadmills Recalled for Unexpected Speed Changes Posing Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Endurance Treadmills
recalls.hazard: The treadmill can unexpectedly accelerate or decelerate, possibly causing the user to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these treadmills immediately and contact Endurance to schedule a free on-site repair.
recalls.description: The recall includes the T7, T7.1, T8 and T9.1 models of the Endurance Treadmills. The treadmills are black and silver. The model number is located along the side of the running surface near the end of the treadmill.
recalls.injuries: Endurance has received nine reports of speed control problems. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Aqua-Leisure Industries Recalls Inflatable Pool Ladders for Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Simple Set Pool Ladders
recalls.hazard: The plastic step support clips can be assembled upside down, causing the ladder steps to break under a user's weight.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the ladders and contact Aqua-Leisure for a free repair kit, including new assembly instructions and color-coded support clips. Ladders should be re-assembled using the new repair kits.
recalls.description: The ladders were included with Aqua® Leisure Simple-Set® inflatable pools that range from 12 to 18 feet in diameter. The white metal arched ladders have two, three or four plastic blue steps on each side of the arch with two blue cross bars just above the top…
recalls.injuries: Aqua-Leisure and CPSC are aware of nine incidents. There have been six reported injuries, including a concussion, a broken arm, fractured ribs and a wrist…

recalls.title: Bicycle Child Carriers Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Schwinn Deluxe Bicycle Child Carriers
recalls.hazard: If the seat is not fully seated on the rack, the plastic guide tabs on the carrier can break. If these tabs break, it could cause the seat to fall off. This poses a risk of serious injury to a child seated in the carrier.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the bicycle child carriers. Do not return the carrier to store. Contact PTI Sports for a free safety bracket and revised installation instructions.
recalls.description: The carrier is a seat for a child that is attached to the back of an adult bicycle. The carrier is gray plastic with a blue rubber back and seat pad, a gray head rest, and black straps.
recalls.injuries: PTI Sports has received five reports of the bicycle child carriers falling, including three reports of minor injuries, such as bumps and scratches.

recalls.title: Trek Recalls Anthem C Elite Bicycle Helmets for Failing Impact Standards
recalls.name: Trek Anthem C Elite and Anthem C Elite WSD Model Bicycle Helmets
recalls.hazard: Product testing has demonstrated that these helmets do not comply with CPSC safety standards for impact resistance. Consumers could suffer impact head injuries in a fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the helmets immediately and return their helmets to an authorized Trek dealer for a full refund.
recalls.description: The recalled helmets are identified by the model name Anthem C Elite and Anthem C Elite WSD. A label inside the helmet identifies the helmet as "Trek Anthem C." The helmets are available in men's sizes in black/charcoal, blue/silver and blue/red, and in…
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CCH Inc. Recalls Mountain Climbing Camming Anchor Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Camming Anchor (used in climbing)
recalls.hazard: The cables that support climbers using these devices can fail, causing climbers to fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these devices immediately and contact the firm for instructions on how to have the units repaired.
recalls.description: These camming anchors or "Alien Cams" are devices used as both a precautionary measure to stop a climber in the event of falls, or it is used to actually support the climber.
recalls.injuries: CCH Inc. has received one report of an anchor cable failing a climber during use.

recalls.title: Serious Injuries Prompt Recall of Mini-Trampolines - New Instructions to Be Provided To Consumers
recalls.name: InMotion Trampolines
recalls.hazard: If a person assembles the trampoline alone and the outside rail is released momentarily, the trampoline can snap back into the folded position and strike the consumer, posing a risk of serious injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should not assemble or disassemble these mini-trampolines until they have the revised assembly instructions. Consumers should contact Stamina immediately for new assembly instructions.
recalls.description: The round, black mini-trampoline measures 36 inches across and has six 7½-inch long metal legs. The mini-trampoline is used for in-place jogging and other cardiovascular exercises.
recalls.injuries: Stamina has received 13 reports of injuries including two concussions; a rotated disc; two reports of facial bone fractures; six injuries requiring stitches to…

recalls.title: LandRoller Inc. Recalls to Repair Roller Skates
recalls.name: LandRoller "Terra 9" Roller Skates
recalls.hazard: The wheels on these roller skates can detach and the brakes can fail. Either one of these hazards can cause the skater to fall and suffer serious injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled LandRoller roller skates. The firm is no longer in business. A remedy is no longer available. Dispose of this recalled product.
recalls.description: LandRoller skates have two oversized wheels on each skate that are angled inward, which is designed to help the user keep balanced on cracked pavement and uneven surfaces.
recalls.injuries: LandRoller Inc. has received nine reports of wheel separation. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Recalls Snowmobiles for Projectile Hazard
recalls.name: Ski-Doo® Model Year 2005 and 2006 Mach Z® and Model Year 2006 MX Z Renegade 1000 Snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: Cracks can appear in the starter ring gears, causing ring gear fragmentation at high speeds. The debris can act as a projectile, causing injury or death to riders or bystanders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers with recalled snowmobiles are being sent direct notice from BRP. Consumers should stop using these vehicles immediately and contact a local Ski-Doo dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repair.
recalls.description: The recall involves all models and packages of the Model Years 2005 and 2006 Mach Z and all models and packages of the Model Year 2006 MX Z Renegade 1000 Ski-Doo® snowmobiles.
recalls.injuries: BRP has received six reported incidents of fragmentation. There have been three reported injuries, including a laceration to a rider's foot that required…

recalls.title: CPSC, Nashbar Direct Announce Recall Bicycle Resistance Trainers for Repair
recalls.name: 2006 Nashbar Bicycle Trainers
recalls.hazard: The base of the trainer has a blocking mechanism that can break, causing the bicycle to disengage from the stand, posing a fall hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycle trainers immediately until repaired.
recalls.description: The Nashbar Watt Master and 2006 Fluid trainers are metallic gray with graphic Nashbar "N" decals running vertically along the rear face of the right rear support leg. The recalled item number is printed on the bottom of the last page of the owner's manual.
recalls.injuries: Nashbar Direct has not received any reports of incidents or injuries.

recalls.title: Snowboard Bindings Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.name: Quechua "Rn'x7FX" snowboard bindings
recalls.hazard: The snowboard binding's plastic base can break during use, posing a risk that snowboarders can fall and suffer a serious injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the snowboard bindings immediately and return them to a Decathlon store for a gift certificate or reimbursement. Consumers will also receive a free pair of self-heating snow gloves.
recalls.description: The model Rn'x7FX Quechua snowboard bindings are white or black. The word "Quechua" is located on the back of the binding. The model number is stamped on the box.
recalls.injuries: Decathlon USA has received one report of a broken binding, though no injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Syntace USA Announce Recall of Bicycle Handlebar Stems
recalls.name: F99 (Force 99) Bicycle Handlebar Stems
recalls.hazard: The recalled bicycle stems can crack or break under normal conditions, causing the rider to fall and suffer serious injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using bicycles equipped with the recalled handlebar stem immediately and contact Syntace for instructions to receive a free replacement stem and installation.
recalls.description: The recalled bicycle handlebar stem is black. Stems with production codes 01 03 through 45 04, and stems with no production code are included in this recall. The production code is the bottom set of numbers located on the end of the stem.
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: Mizuno USA, Inc. Recalls "Gamer" Baseball Gloves Due to Chance of Infection in At-Risk Consumers
recalls.name: Mizuno "Gamer" Baseball Gloves
recalls.hazard: These gloves could contain aspergillus mold. Such mold usually does not affect healthy individuals, but could cause respiratory or other infections in individuals with chronic health problems or in individuals who have impaired immune systems.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the gloves and contact Mizuno USA, Inc. for information on how to receive a free replacement baseball glove.
recalls.description: The recall includes all Mizuno "Gamer" baseball gloves. These gloves have the word "Gamer" printed on the palm of the gloves.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of 2006 Snowmobiles
recalls.name: Certain Model Year 2006 Ski-Doo REV, RT, and RF Snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: The steering columns on these snowmobiles could have a missing weld, which could allow a steering component to become loose. This could lead to a loss of control or possible collision, causing serious injury or even death.
recalls.remedy: Registered owners of affected models have been sent direct notice of this recall. Consumers should stop using these snowmobiles immediately and contact a local Ski-Doo dealer to schedule an appointment for repair service.
recalls.description: The recall involves certain Ski-Doo Model Year 2006 snowmobiles. The platforms involved are the REV, RT, and RF. For a complete list of model numbers and serial numbers affected by this recall please log onto www.ski-doo.com Check the owner's manual for the…
recalls.injuries: No injuries or incidents have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of Additional 2006 Snowmobiles
recalls.name: Certain Model Year 2006 Ski-Doo REV500 SS, REV 600 HO, and REV 600 HO SDI Snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: Cracks could appear in the starter ring gears, allowing gear fragmentation at high speeds. The debris could act like projectiles and cause serious injury or death to riders or bystanders.
recalls.remedy: Registered owners of affected models have been sent direct notice of this recall. Consumers should stop using these snowmobiles immediately and contact a local Ski-Doo dealer to schedule an appointment for repair service.
recalls.description: The recall involves certain Ski-Doo Model Year 2006 REV500 SS, REV 600 HO, and REV 600 HO SDI snowmobiles. For a complete list of model numbers and serial numbers affected by this recall please log onto www.ski-doo.com The model number and serial number can…
recalls.injuries: Bombardier has not received any reports of incidents or injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, Recreational Equipment Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Bicycles
recalls.name: Novara Dirt Rider 20-inch 5-Speed and 6-Speed Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The alloy frame used for these bicycles can be prone to fatigue failure. Frame failure results in the separation of the fork, head tube, and handlebar away from the rest of the bike, causing a loss of control and crash, and posing a risk of serious injury to…
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these bicycles and return them to the nearest REI store for a full refund or credit.
recalls.description: The Novara Dirt Rider 20-inch 5-speed and 6-speed bicycles are children's bicycles with 20-inch wheels, an aluminum frame, and multiple speeds.
recalls.injuries: REI has received four reports of frames failing. All four failures resulted in crashes, with one child sustaining a minor injury.

recalls.title: CPSC, Black Diamond Equipment Announce Recall of Scarpa T2X Telemark Ski Boots
recalls.name: Scarpa T2X Telemark Ski Boots
recalls.hazard: The plastic boot cuff can crack when flexed open in an unbuckled non-skiing position, causing discomfort on the ankle or shin, making the problem evident prior to skiing and thus unsuitable for use.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the ski boots and return them to the nearest dealer for a free replacement.
recalls.description: The two recalled models of T2X Telemark ski boot can be identified by a dual color ankle cuff and the marking T2X on the outside of each boot (boxes are marked with model numbers: 142045 Men's and 142046).
recalls.injuries: The firm has received two reports of cuffs cracking during boot fittings. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Delta Cycle Corp. Announce Recall of Picasso Two-Bike Folding Racks
recalls.name: Picasso Two-Bike Folding Rack
recalls.hazard: The bike racks do not have sufficient hardware to support its weight on the wall. This can cause the bike rack to unexpectedly fall, hitting a nearby consumer.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should contact Delta Cycle immediately to receive additional hardware and installation instructions.
recalls.description: This recall involves Picasso bike racks with a collapsible shelf. The bike rack can be mounted on the wall and has slots to support two bicycles. The metal rack has the Delta logo and name printed on the front of the rack.
recalls.injuries: There has been one report of a bike rack falling. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, E-Z-GO Announce Recall to Repair Golf Cars
recalls.name: E-Z-GO 2002-2005 gasoline-powered Fleet and Freedom Golf Cars, and Shuttle 2+2 Personnel Carriers
recalls.hazard: High engine temperatures can permit fuel to get into the air filter box, posing a risk of fire.
recalls.remedy: Owners of the recalled golf cars should contact the nearest E-Z-GO dealer to arrange for a free repair. E-Z-GO and E-Z-GO dealers will contact known owners to schedule an appointment for a free repair.
recalls.description: The recall involves certain model year 2002 through 2005 E-Z-GO Fleet and E-Z-GO Freedom gasoline-powered golf cars and Shuttle 2+2 personnel carriers. The model names for the recalled products are TXT, Freedom and Shuttle 2+2.
recalls.injuries: There have been 12 reports of fire involving these gasoline-powered golf cars. There have been no injuries reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, World Wide Cycle Supply Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles Sold at Toys "R" Us
recalls.name: Harley-Davidson 16-inch BMX Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The fork that holds the front wheel can separate at the weld, causing the rider to fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding the bicycle immediately and return it to a Toys "R" Us store for store credit in the amount of the purchase price.
recalls.description: The bicycle has a yellow and red painted flame pattern with a yellow fork and a sticker containing the words "Harley-Davidson" on the fork leg.
recalls.injuries: World Wide Cycle Supply Inc. has received 15 reports of fork welds breaking on these bicycles.

recalls.title: CPSC, Aqua Scout Announce Recall of Aqua Scout Water Scooters
recalls.name: Aqua Scout Water Scooters
recalls.hazard: Hydrogen gas can build up in the battery compartment and cause the battery cover and the battery package to forcefully expel from the product, posing a risk of injury to the user or bystanders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled water scooter immediately and return it to Aqua Scout for a free replacement.
recalls.description: The Aqua Scout Water Scooter is a hand-held, battery-powered product used to propel swimmers through the water. The product has a yellow or red plastic enclosure, a black plastic handle and propeller.
recalls.injuries: Aqua Scout has received five reports of the battery cover and/or the battery package being expelled from the water scooter, including two reports of minor…

recalls.title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Back Trails Jr. Bicycle Helmets
recalls.name: Back Trails Jr. Toddler, Youth and Child Bicycle Helmets
recalls.hazard: Some of these helmets do not meet CPSC safety standards for bicycle helmets, which poses a risk of riders suffering head injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take the helmets away from children and return them to the nearest Target Store for a gift card in the amount of a full refund.
recalls.description: The recall includes Target's "Back Trails Jr." brand toddler, youth and child bicycle helmets sold in various colors. They were manufactured after January 1, 2004.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Torelli Imports Announce Recall of Bicycle Tires
recalls.name: Bicycle Tires
recalls.hazard: The tire can separate from the wheel, resulting in a flat tire. This can cause the rider to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the tires immediately and contact their local bicycle retailer or Torelli Imports to receive a free replacement tire.
recalls.description: This recall involves Torelli Verona and Lugano Open Tubular bicycle tires with folding Kevlar beads, used to hold the tire to the rim.
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, American Classic Announce Recall of Bicycle Wheels
recalls.name: American Classic road and mountain bike wheels
recalls.hazard: The hub in the bicycle's rear wheel can fail to engage properly, causing no resistance when pedaling. The bicycle rider could lose balance, fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bike wheels with the recalled hubs and contact your local bicycle retailer to receive a free inspection. If you have a recalled wheel, the dealer will provide a free repair.
recalls.description: The recall includes all American Classic aftermarket rear wheels and hubs, as well as the following 2005 bike models which use American Classic rear wheels or hubs: Fuji Team Super Lite (Team SL); Orbea Aletta, Onix, Lobular 50, Dama Race, Mitis and Mitis…
recalls.injuries: No injuries reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, ICON Health & Fitness, Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Epic T60 Treadmills
recalls.name: Epic T60 treadmill
recalls.hazard: If assembly instructions are not properly followed, the gas spring/shock can be damaged during assembly, if the walking platform is folded up and goes beyond the vertical position.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should contact ICON Health & Fitness for information on how to determine whether their treadmills have been damaged and to obtain revised assembly instructions and warning decals. Damaged units will be inspected and repaired by ICON service technicians free of charge.
recalls.description: These are 2004 Epic T60 silver and gray colored treadmills with black handrails. They have model number EPTL81804 on a decal located on the front frame, near where the power cord enters the machine. "EPIC T60" is written on the hood of the treadmill.
recalls.injuries: ICON has received two reports of minor foot injuries and five reports of minor property damage.

recalls.title: CPSC, Giant Bicycle, Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
recalls.name: 2005 Cypress and Sedona bicycles
recalls.hazard: The rear axle on the bicycle is harder than required by the manufacturer's specification and could crack.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately and contact Giant Bicycle if they have a recalled bicycle. Giant Bicycle will replace the rear wheel (including the rear axle) of recalled bicycles for free.
recalls.description: The recall involves certain 2005 Cypress and Sedona model bicycles. The bicycles come in both men's and ladies' styles and vary in size between 14 to 21 inches. "GIANT" and "Cypress" or "Sedona" are written on the bicycles' frames.
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, WaveCrest Laboratories LLC Announce Recall of Electric Bicycles
recalls.name: TidalForce S-750 High Performance Electric Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The front and/or rear wheel can collapse, causing the rider to fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding the electric bicycle immediately and contact WaveCrest Laboratories, if they purchased an electric bicycle with affected wheels. WaveCrest Laboratories will replace affected wheels at no cost to the consumer.
recalls.description: The recall involves specific front and rear wheels of TidalForce S-750 High Performance Electric Bicycles. The electric bicycle can travel at speeds of up to 20 miles per hour.
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Sportcraft Announce Recall of Treadmills
recalls.name: Tredex 6.0, TX 440 and TX 550 Treadmills
recalls.hazard: The treadmill can unexpectedly accelerate and cause users to fall and sustain injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled treadmills immediately. The firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer available. Please destroy or discard the product.
recalls.description: This recall includes Sportcraft Tredex 6.0, TX 440 and TX 550 treadmills. These 155- to 170-pound motorized treadmills are gray in color and can be folded upright for storage.
recalls.injuries: Sportcraft has received 110 reports of unexpected acceleration, 14 of which resulted in minor injuries, including sprains and bruises.

recalls.title: CPSC, VisionTech USA, Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Aero Bars
recalls.name: VisionTech USA SuperMax, TriMax, TriMax Plus and Pro model Integrated Bicycle Aero Bars
recalls.hazard: The centerpiece of these bicycle aero bars can crack or break, causing the bicycle rider to lose control and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycle aero bars immediately and contact VisionTech USA, Inc. to have their aero bars tested. A free replacement will be provided for any bicycle aero bars found defective.
recalls.description: Aero bars are handlebar extensions typically used on racing and triathlon bicycles that either clip on to the handlebars or are sold as an integrated handlebar and stem system. The aero bars allow riders to ride in an aerodynamic crouching position.
recalls.injuries: VisionTech has received two reports of the centerpiece of these aero bars breaking, resulting in minor scrapes and abrasions.

recalls.title: CPSC, Rolf Prima Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Wheels
recalls.name: 2003 Rolf Prima Vigor and Elan Bicycle Wheels (rear wheel only)
recalls.hazard: The rear wheel freehub mechanism can malfunction, causing no resistance when pedaling. The bicycle rider could lose balance, fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Contact your local bicycle retailer to have them inspect your wheels to determine if they are included in the recall. If so, the dealer will provide a free repair. Repair kits will be available in 6 to 8 weeks.
recalls.description: These 2003 Rolf Prima Vigor and Elan wheels were sold in a front and rear wheel set. Only the rear wheel is affected. "Rolf Prima Vigor" or "Rolf Prima Elan" are written on the wheel rim. The wheel models have serial numbers between 03926 and 06586.
recalls.injuries: No injuries reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Club Car Announce Recall of Golf Cars
recalls.name: Precedent and Precedent Champion Golf Cars
recalls.hazard: The accelerator pedal can temporarily stick when depressed, resulting in unexpected acceleration or difficulty braking.
recalls.remedy: Club Car will repair the accelerator pedal return assembly on these vehicles free of charge. Vehicle owners should immediately stop using any vehicle if they hear a grinding noise while depressing the accelerator pedal. Most vehicle owners have already been contacted by Club Car about this recall. Any owners not notified should contact their authorized Club Car dealer or call Club Car direct to schedule their free repair.
recalls.description: The Precedent and Precedent Champion golf cars are branded with the Precedent name on the steering wheel. The affected vehicles have serial number prefixes beginning with the two-letter combination CE, CF, PE, PF, PQ or PR.
recalls.injuries: Club Car has received two reports of Precedent golf cars having difficulty braking, due to accelerator pedals sticking.

recalls.title: CPSC, CSK Auto Announce Recall of Aqua Water Scooters
recalls.name: Aqua Water Scooters
recalls.hazard: Hydrogen gas can build up in the battery compartment and cause the battery cover and the battery package to forcefully expel from the product, posing a risk of injury to the user or bystanders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled water scooter immediately and return it to the store where purchased for a full refund.
recalls.description: The Aqua Water Scooter is a hand-held battery-powered product used to propel swimmers through the water. The product has either a yellow or red plastic enclosure, a black plastic handle and propeller and a shark face on the front.
recalls.injuries: CSK has received nine reports of the battery cover and/or the battery package being expelled from the water scooter, including three reports of facial…

recalls.title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Scooters and Mini Bikes
recalls.name: Fisher-Price® Power Wheels® Lightning PAC Scooters and Fisher-Price® Power Wheels® MX3™ Mini Bikes
recalls.hazard: If tires are over-inflated, the plastic rim within the wheel can break, causing the tire to rupture. This poses the risk of facial and hand injuries while inflating the tire.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled scooters and mini bikes away from children immediately and contact Fisher-Price to receive new warning labels and a free tire gauge to provide assistance during inflation. To prevent over-inflation, Fisher-Price recommends using a manual pump to inflate the tires.
recalls.description: The recalled Lightning PAC Scooters and MX3 Mini Bikes are battery-powered ride-on toys designed for children ages six and older. The product names are located on the side of the scooter or mini bike. The recalled scooter's model number is 73530.
recalls.injuries: For the Lightning PAC Scooter, Fisher-Price has received six reports of incidents, including two reports of facial injuries and two reports of hand injuries to…

recalls.title: CPSC, Razor USA Announce Recall of Electric Scooters
recalls.name: Razor™ Electric Scooters
recalls.hazard: A weld can break, causing the handlebar to detach from the scooter. This can cause the rider to lose control and fall from the scooter.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the scooters immediately and contact Razor to arrange a free repair. The recall repair also will include a new battery charger to address a risk of overheating that is being announced as a separate recall today.
recalls.description: The recall involves models E300, E300S, E200 and E200S Razor Electric Scooters, which are powered by battery motors. The model numbers appear on the down tube attaching the handlebars to the deck.
recalls.injuries: Razor USA has received 261 reports of handlebar welds breaking or bending. This has resulted in reports of 16 injuries, including three broken arms and one…

recalls.title: CPSC, Razor USA Announce Recall of PowMax Battery Chargers Sold with Razor Electric Scooters, Motorcycles and Go Karts
recalls.name: PowMax™ battery chargers sold with certain Razor™ battery-powered scooters and ride-on vehicles
recalls.hazard: The battery charger can overheat and cause minor burns when touched. Also, nearby items can become damaged by the hot chargers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the battery charger and contact Razor for a free replacement. Razor model E300, E300S, E200, and E200S scooters will be repaired as part of another recall announced today.
recalls.description: The recall involves PowMax battery chargers distributed with Razor battery-powered scooters and ride-on vehicles. The name "PowMax" appears prominently on the face of the battery charger unit.
recalls.injuries: Razor USA has received 144 reports of battery chargers overheating. There have been no reports of injuries and six reports of minor property damage, such as a…

recalls.title: CPSC, ITECH Announce Recall of Hockey Goalie Masks and Replacement Wires
recalls.name: ITECH Profile 2100, 1100 and 8.0 hockey goalie masks and ITECH RP607 and RP609 goalie mask replacement wires
recalls.hazard: The metal wire on these products could break at or near a weld point, exposing a hockey goalie to facial injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the masks and replacement wires immediately and return them to the company for a free replacement unit.
recalls.description: The recalled hockey goalie masks and replacement wires are non-certified models with a cat-eye design and have the word "ITECH" printed on the sides and front of the mask. The ITECH Profile 2100, 1100 and 8.0 goalie masks came in black or white.
recalls.injuries: ITECH received three reports of injuries sustained from the wire breaking at or near a weld point. The injuries included superficial facial and eye injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, Quality Bicycle Products Announce Recall of Bicycle Handlebar Stems
recalls.name: Dimension Bicycle Road and Mountain Threadless Handlebar Stems
recalls.hazard: These handlebar stems can crack or break, causing the bicycle rider to fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Contact your local bicycle retailer to have them check your handlebar stem and obtain a replacement stem, if necessary.
recalls.description: The recall involves all Dimension-brand road and mountain threadless bicycle stems with a 130 degree rise. The stems are black or silver and have the word "Dimension" painted on the extension.
recalls.injuries: There has been one report of a handlebar stem breaking that resulted in minor abrasions and bruises to the rider.

recalls.title: CPSC, Hunter's View Announce Recall of Safety Harnesses Sold with Tree Stands
recalls.name: Safety Harnesses Sold with Tree Stands
recalls.hazard: The harnesses could fail during use, resulting in consumers falling from tree stands and suffering serious injuries or death.
recalls.remedy: Firm is no longer in business. Remedy is not available. Discard this product.
recalls.description: These 2004 model year Fall Arrest Systems (harnesses) have model number 3333 and Model Year 2004 written on a white label attached to the harness or the tree strap.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, MGA Entertainment Inc. Announce Recall of Bratz™ Stylin' Scooters™
recalls.name: Bratz™ Stylin' Scooter™
recalls.hazard: The wheels of the scooter can break or become damaged, and users of the scooters can fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the scooter immediately and contact MGA for a refund or a replacement scooter.
recalls.description: The product is a non-motorized two-wheeled scooter with a folding hinge and an adjustable handlebar. The scooter platform is purple with a bright pink Bratz logo on the top surface. Scooters containing information identifying the product as Item No.
recalls.injuries: MGA has received six reports of cracked wheels on the recalled scooters. All six incidents resulted in cuts, scrapes, and bruises.

recalls.title: CPSC, CF Roark Welding & Engineering Announce Recall of Bicycle Frames
recalls.name: Titanium bicycle frame for road bicycles
recalls.hazard: The frames on these bicycles can crack and fail during use, posing a risk of injury to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should inspect their bicycle frame immediately for a crack in the chain stay bridge area or return the bicycle frame to Roark for inspection. Contact Roark for shipping or delivery instructions, at Roark's expense. The company will offer a $100 discount on their "frame refreshment program," as an incentive for consumers who have their bicycle frame inspected by Roark. Bicycle frames that exhibit a crack in the chain stay bridge area will either be repaired or replaced at no cost to the consumer.
recalls.description: The recall involves custom titanium bicycle frames for road bicycles manufactured and distributed by Roark. The bicycle frames have a "Titanium" sticker on the top tube and a "Roark" sticker on the down tube.
recalls.injuries: Roark has received nine reports of bicycle frames cracking, but no injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Montrail Inc. Announce Recall of Crampons; Products Used for Ice Climbing and Mountaineering
recalls.name: Crampons (used for ice climbing and mountaineering)
recalls.hazard: The vertical rails at the front of these crampons can break, which could result in falls and injuries to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these crampons immediately and contact Montrail to find out how to return them and for further recall details.
recalls.description: The recall includes models I354, I356, and K364 sold under brand names I.C.E. 9 and Khumbu. The recall includes products with UPC numbers beginning with 619120036 and ending with 204, 211, 464, or 457.
recalls.injuries: Montrail has received three reports of crampons breaking. No injuries were reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Cannondale Bicycle Corporation Announce Recall of Bicycle Suspension Seat Posts
recalls.name: 1-X Bicycle Suspension Seat Post
recalls.hazard: The seat posts may have been improperly manufactured, which could cause the seat post to fail prematurely. A failure could lead to a crack in the bicycle seat post, which may cause the rider to fall or crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycle immediately and contact their local Cannondale dealer for a replacement seat post at no cost to the consumer. Authorized dealers have the exact models and serial numbers of bicycles with affected seat posts.
recalls.description: The recall involves Lee Chi model 1-X bicycle suspension seat posts. The seat post was manufactured by a component manufacturer for Cannondale and installed on various 2005 model year Cannondale brand bicycles.
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, GSI Commerce Solutions Announce Recall of Electric Scooters
recalls.name: Electric Scooters
recalls.hazard: A knob can loosen and cause the handlebar to detach from the scooter. Additionally, the folding joint lock on the model FS-101 scooter can break, causing the handlebars to release from the upright position.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product and contact GSI Commerce Solutions to receive a free repair kit.
recalls.description: The recall involves models FS-101 and FS-102 Spartan Sports electric scooters, which are powered by 250-watt electric motors and made of steel. The model numbers do not appear on the product but are on the users' manual.
recalls.injuries: GSI Commerce Solutions has received 28 reports involving the scooters' handlebars.

recalls.title: CPSC, Shimano American Corp. Announce Brake Inner Cable Recall
recalls.name: Shimano Road Racing Bicycle Brake Inner Cables
recalls.hazard: The bicycle brake cable can detach during braking, causing the rider to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should contact their local bicycle dealer immediately to arrange for a free inspection. Consumers with the recalled brake cables will have a replacement cable installed free of charge.
recalls.description: This recall involves aftermarket Shimano 1.6 mm X 1,700 mm brake inner cables for ATB and road racing bicycles. Dual ended brake cables packaged in quantities of ten have a part number of Y80098400/Z80098400.
recalls.injuries: Shimano has received one report of the brake inner cable detaching. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. ("BRP") Announce Recall of Snowmobiles
recalls.name: 2005 Mach Z® 995 and Summit® 995 Ski-Doo® Snowmobiles without functional electric starter
recalls.hazard: Inappropriate clutch ring gear installed on some units. This may cause ring gear fragmentation at high speeds and debris could act as projectiles. A projectile could cause serious injury or death.
recalls.remedy: Owners of affected units will be notified directly. Consumers should stop using the snowmobile immediately and contact an authorized Ski-Doo dealer to schedule an appointment for repair, free of charge.
recalls.description: 2005 Ski-Doo Mach Z 995 and Summit 995 snowmobiles without functional electric starter. Recalled models are listed below in this table: Year Model Package Model Number 2005 Mach Z Adrenaline™ AB5A Summit Highmark CA5A / CA5B Highmark X CD5A / CD5B / CD5C
recalls.injuries: No incidents or injuries reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Rossignol, and Dynastar Announce Recall of Snowboard Bindings
recalls.name: Rossignol and Dynastar Snowboard Bindings
recalls.hazard: The baseplate of the binding can break, resulting in loss of control and possible fall and injury to the snowboarder.
recalls.remedy: Recalled snowboard bindings should be returned to the place of purchase for a free replacement binding of equal value. This recall was implemented in December 2003.
recalls.description: This recall includes all 2003/2004 model year Rossignol-brand HC 500, Zena, Unit Pack, HC Rental, and Unit Rental snowboard bindings. Also included are the 2003/2004 model year Dynastar-brand Classic RL and Classic Pack snowboard bindings.
recalls.injuries: There have been reports of 23 broken bindings. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Jumpking Inc.® Announce Recall of Trampolines, Enclosures
recalls.name: Jumpking Trampolines and "FunRing" Enclosures
recalls.hazard: Welds on the frame of these trampolines can break during use, resulting in falls and possible injuries. Additionally, the mounting brackets of the FunRing enclosures have sharp edges, which can cause lacerations.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the trampolines and/or the enclosures, and contact Jumpking to receive free repair kits.
recalls.units: About 1 million trampolines and about 296,000 "FunRing" enclosures
recalls.description: The recall includes 14-foot and 15-foot Jumpking trampolines sold separately and with FunRing enclosures. The brand name "Jumpking, Inc." is written on a warning label wrapped around a leg of the trampoline.
recalls.injuries: Jumpking has received 47 reports of one or more welds breaking on these trampolines.

recalls.title: CPSC, Selle Royal/fi'zi:k Announce Recall of Bicycle Seats
recalls.name: Bicycle Seats
recalls.hazard: The plastic scuff guard underneath the front of the seat, which secures the seat rails, may crack or break, causing the rider to lose control and/or fall, resulting in a serious injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycle immediately and contact their local REI stores for a replacement seat, at no cost to the consumer.
recalls.description: The recall involves Selle Royal/fi'zi:k [cp] pavé bicycle seat part number 7403SXS 03 9072 with a manufacture date of 10/03. The bicycle seat is an original equipment (OEM) seat installed on 2004 model year Recreational Equipment Inc.
recalls.injuries: Three reports of the seat breaking. One injury reported, causing the rider to sustain a mild concussion.

recalls.title: CPSC, Club Car Inc. Announce Recall to Repair DS Golf Cars, Hospitality, Utility & Transport Vehicles and Rough Terrain Vehicles
recalls.name: 2004 and 2005 model year gasoline and electric powered DS Golf Cars, Hospitality, Utility & Transport Vehicles and Rough Terrain Vehicles
recalls.hazard: Microscopic cracks in the brake equalizer rods on certain vehicles may cause the rods to fatigue and fail prematurely in continuous use. Such failure could result in a loss of braking ability.
recalls.remedy: Owners who have not already been contacted by Club Car should contact the dealer from whom they purchased their vehicle, or call Club Car toll free to have the equalizer rod repaired free of charge.
recalls.description: The recalled vehicles are used for short distance transportation around golf courses, hotels, resorts, airports, and residential communities.
recalls.injuries: Club Car has received one report of one vehicle losing braking ability. No accidents, injuries, or damage have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Flow International Announce Recall of Snowboard Bindings
recalls.name: 2004 Flow MK Series Snowboard Bindings
recalls.hazard: The pin used to secure the rear snaplock lever to the bindings can bend or break.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bindings and return them to a Flow dealer to receive a free replacement axle pin used to secure the rear snaplock lever. Consumers also can contact Flow International to have a repair kit with instructions sent by mail.
recalls.description: This recall includes 2004 Flow MK series snowboard bindings with model numbers MK03, MK04, MK05 and MK110. The bindings affected by this recall can be identified by the shape of the rear lock lever and the cable adjustment wheel on the side of the baseplate…
recalls.injuries: Flow International has received 40 reports of the pins bending or breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Norco Products Ltd. Announce Recall of Bicycle Attachment
recalls.name: Adams Trail-a-Bike or Adams Slipstream Bicycle Attachment
recalls.hazard: The hardware used in the assembly of the universal hitch may come loose, causing the unit to separate from the lead bicycle, which could lead to a serious injury or death to the rider of the bicycle attachment.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the product and contact their local bicycle dealer to arrange for an inspection and to receive a no-charge repair kit to be installed for free.
recalls.description: The recall involves the Adams Trail-A-Bike or Adams Slipstream sold under the following models: Starter, Folder, Shifter, Shocker, Ultimate Tandem, Deluxe Folder, Me 2 and Original.
recalls.injuries: Norco Products has received two reports of hardware falling out of the hitch assembly. One minor injury reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, First Team Inc. Announce Recall of Basketball Hoops
recalls.name: Basketball Hoops
recalls.hazard: The bolt attaching the arm to the vertical post can break, causing the backboard to fall and injure someone standing below.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using their basketball hoops and contact First Team Customer Service to receive a free repair kit.
recalls.description: This recall involves First Team Attack, Force, and Titan basketball hoops. The hoops have a spring-loaded E-Z crank, adjustable backboard that goes from 6 feet, 6 inches to 10 feet tall.
recalls.injuries: First Team received one report of a backboard falling. No injuries were reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Classic Sport Companies Inc. Announce Recall of Table Soccer Games
recalls.name: Table Soccer Game
recalls.hazard: The lighting structures may spark if the tube lights are not properly installed, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately disconnect all power to the table soccer game. Consumers may return the unit for a full refund or contact Classic Sport for a rebate for the removal of the lighting fixture.
recalls.description: The recall involves Classic Sport Underlit Table Soccer game, models X0725, X0743 and X0761. The table soccer game is a soccer table with a glass playing surface and fluorescent tube lighting mounted underneath, causing the playing surface to illuminate when…
recalls.injuries: Two reports of the table catching fire. No injuries were reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, J.C. Penney Corporation Announce Recall of Children's Pajama Sets
recalls.name: Okie Dokie Alligator Football Pajama Set
recalls.hazard: The heat-sealed patches on the front of the garment can detach, posing a possible choking hazard to young children.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the pajama sets and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
recalls.description: The recalled pajama shirts are heather gray with red or blue sleeves with heat-sealed alligator and football patches on the front. The collar tag reads "Okie Dokie." The pajama pants are red or blue with cartoon pictures of alligators, footballs, and stars,…
recalls.injuries: There has been one report of a patch detaching. No injuries reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Answer Products Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Suspension Forks
recalls.name: Manitou Bicycle Suspension Forks
recalls.hazard: The top of the Manitou bicycle suspension fork, when fully compressed, may contact the front tire, resulting in a loss of control of the bicycle and presenting a fall hazard to a bicyclist.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should check the back of the lower leg portion of the fork for a decal stating, "Tire Clearance Upgrade Installed". If absent, consumers should stop using the bicycle immediately and contact Answer to arrange for a free travel upgrade kit to be installed at no cost. Consumers should discard the old Owners' Manual and contact Answer to send a free Owners' Manual.
recalls.description: The recall involves 2005 Manitou Nixon, Stance, and Sherman bicycle suspension forks installed on various high-end mountain bicycles. The Manitou bicycle suspension forks have the model names printed on the sides of the lower leg portions of the fork.
recalls.injuries: One report of a Manitou Stance allowing the tire to rub against the top of the fork. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Quality Bicycle Products Announce Recall of Bicycle Forks
recalls.name: Salsa Campeon Bicycle Forks
recalls.hazard: The steering tube on the bicycle fork can crack or break, causing a sudden loss of steering control and causing a fall hazard to bicyclists.
