recalls.remedy: Contact your local Salsa dealer to schedule a free repair. Salsa dealers have notified consumers directly about this recall.
recalls.description: The recall involves carbon fiber/aluminum forks included with the Salsa model F-01 Campeon frame set in either White/Black or Red/Black color combinations. Units included in this recall have a code of CK, DA, or DB and a serial number from 03400 to 04600.
recalls.injuries: There have been two reports of forks cracking or breaking, including one incident resulting in abrasions and bruises to the rider.

recalls.title: CPSC, Giant Bicycle Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
recalls.name: Rainier Mountain Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The front brake mounting tabs can break, causing the brakes to fail and the rider to lose control of the bicycle.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should contact Giant Bicycle to determine whether their bicycle is included in this recall. Authorized dealers who sold these bicycles will schedule an inspection and free repair.
recalls.description: The recall involves only 2004 Rainier model mountain bicycles with Marzocchi EXR Comp front forks. Model numbers included in the recall are 333502, 333503, 333504 and 333505. The bicycle is blue and silver and is made of aluminum.
recalls.injuries: The company has received six reports of the tabs breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of Snowmobiles
recalls.name: Ski-Doo® 2004 MX Z (E) 800 HO and GSX LTD (E) 800 HO snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: The starter ring gear may crack, causing fragmentation and debris, which may act as a projectile at high speeds. A projectile could cause serious injury or death.
recalls.remedy: Owners of affected units will be notified directly. Consumers should contact an authorized Ski-Doo dealer to schedule an appointment for repair, free of charge.
recalls.description: BRP snowmobiles come in black, blue, gray, white, and yellow. Recalled models are listed in this table: YEAR MODEL MODEL NUMBER SERIAL NUMBER 2004MX Z™ 800 HO…
recalls.injuries: BRP has received one report of debris from the ring gear causing a minor injury to the driver's hand.

recalls.title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of Snowmobiles
recalls.name: Ski-Doo® 2003 Grand Touring 800 SDI SE; Legend 800 SDI SE Ski-Doo® 2004 Legend 600 HO SDI SE, SE GT, Sport and Sport GT; Legend 800 HO SDI SE and SE GT; MX Z X, Adrenaline and Renegade X; GSX Limited, Limited 1+1, Sport and Sport 1+1 Ski-Doo® 2005 MX Z Renegade
recalls.hazard: The throttle lever could become stuck, leading to loss of speed control and possible collision.
recalls.remedy: Owners of affected units will be notified directly. Consumers should contact an authorized Ski-Doo dealer to schedule an appointment for repair, free of charge.
recalls.description: BRP snowmobiles come in black, blue, gray, white, yellow and autumn/black. Recalled models are listed in this table: YEAR MODEL PACKAGE MODEL NUMBER 2005 REV MX Z™ Renegade BX5A/BX5B 2004 REV MX Z X 2862/2863/2864/2865/2866/2867/2868/ 2869/2870/2871/2872/2873…
recalls.injuries: BRP has received two reports alleging stuck throttles. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Full Speed Ahead Announce Recall of Scatto Bicycle Wheel Quick Releases Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
recalls.name: Full Speed Ahead (FSA) Scatto bicycle wheel quick releases
recalls.hazard: An internal part in the lever mechanism can break, reducing clamping effectiveness and rendering the unit inoperable, potentially causing a bicyclist to fall.
recalls.remedy: Free replacement. Consumers should stop using the quick releases and call Full Speed Ahead toll-free at (877) 743-3372 from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, or write to Full Speed Ahead, Inc., 12810 NE 178th St #102, Woodinville, WA 98072.
recalls.description: The Full Speed Ahead Scatto quick release was sold as standard equipment for RD-400 and XC-300 bicycle wheelsets and also separately. The levers are laser etched "FSA" and the end pieces have a distinctive round shape.
recalls.injuries: There have been 12 reports of the quick release mechanism failing, but no injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Specialized Bicycle Components Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
recalls.name: Allez Sport, Allez Elite, Roubaix, and Sequoia Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The handlebar may loosen and turn unexpectedly, which can cause the rider to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles with these recalled handlebars and return the recalled handlebars to the place of purchase for replacement handlebars.
recalls.description: The recalled handlebars were sold on the 2005 Allez Sport, 2005 Allez Elite, 2005 Roubaix (base model) and 2005 Sequoia (base model) bicycles. The model names are on the frame of the handlebar.
recalls.injuries: Specialized has received two reports of the handlebars loosening. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Wild Country Ltd. Announce Recall of Helium Carabiners
recalls.name: Wild Country-brand Helium carabiners used in rock climbing
recalls.hazard: The carabiner gate may come open under a heavy load, which will significantly reduce the strength of the carabiner. The carabiner could break if the climber falls, posing a risk of serious injury or death to the climber.
recalls.remedy: Consumer should call the firm for instructions on returning these carabiners. The firm will reimburse shipping expenses and send the consumer a replacement.
recalls.description: These are Wild Country-brand carabiners sold under the following model names: Helium Dyneema, Helium DYN QD 5 X 13, Helium Clean Wire, and Oxygen-Helium. They are marked with batch codes AAA, AAB, AAC, AAD, AAE, and AAF.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Electric Scooters
recalls.name: Leoch Electric Scooters (also known as "Red Dragon" and "E-Scooter")
recalls.hazard: Improper wiring can cause a short circuit, posing a fire hazard in the scooter. In addition, inadequate insulation may expose electrical wiring, which poses a shock hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the scooters immediately and return them to any Target store for a full refund.
recalls.description: The recall involves Leoch-brand scooters that were also sold under the names "E-Scooter" and "Red Dragon." The scooters have a seat, two wheels and footrests on each side.
recalls.injuries: Target has received two reports of the scooters catching fire. There have been 13 reports of scooters starting and/or moving on their own.

recalls.title: CPSC, BMW Announce Recall of SlideCarver Scooters
recalls.name: SlideCarver Scooter
recalls.hazard: The front column of the scooter does not meet impact resistance standards. The handlebar column can break if the scooter hits an object, which can cause the rider to fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should return the SlideCarver scooters to any BMW dealership or contact the firm for information on returning the scooter to receive a refund. Additionally, consumers will receive a $200 gift certificate for BMW lifestyle merchandise.
recalls.description: The SlideCarver is a three-wheeled scooter which is designed to be steered both in the front and back. The steering design allows riders to shift weight and change direction while maintaining control.
recalls.injuries: BMW has received one report of a scooter front column breaking, causing a rider to fall and suffer minor injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, PTI Sports Inc. Announce Recall of Schwinn Toddler Bicycle Helmets
recalls.name: Schwinn-brand Toddler Bicycle Helmets
recalls.hazard: The helmets do not comply with impact testing requirements in the Consumer Product Safety Act.
recalls.remedy: Return the recalled helmet to the store where purchased for a replacement or refund. Consumers also can send the helmet back to the manufacturer.
recalls.description: These Schwinn-brand Toddler Bicycle Helmets have "SCHWINN" written on the back of the helmets. A white label inside the helmets reads, "Lot# 791913." This number is followed by a date from "12-01-03" through "5-15-04." This label also contains the model…
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Geartec/Mackarl Announce Recall of Bicycle Helmets
recalls.name: DBX Engage (VT-3), DBX Ravage (FX-2), and Geartec ESPY bicycle helmets
recalls.hazard: The helmets may not meet CPSC safety regulations for helmets, which poses a risk of a rider sustaining a serious head injury if he/she falls from a bicycle.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these helmets immediately and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund or replacement.
recalls.description: The recalled Geartec ESPY and FX-2 (DBX Ravage) model helmets come in carbon yellow, silver, or blue, and have a carbon fiber graphic on the front to middle part of the helmet.
recalls.injuries: The firms have not received any reports of incidents. This recall is being conducted to prevent the possibility of injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, Jumpking Inc. Announce Recall of Chrome Dumbbells
recalls.name: Reebok and NordicTrack Chrome Dumbbells
recalls.hazard: Because they do not fit together properly, the weights can fall off the handles of these dumbbells and strike the user.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should examine their dumbbells to make sure the weights on both ends are tightly secured to the handle. If they are loose, contact Jumpking to obtain instructions on how to receive the free repair kit.
recalls.description: The chrome dumbbells weigh between 2 and 50 pounds and have the Reebok or NordicTrack trademark name on the outside of the bells, along with the weight of the dumbbell.
recalls.injuries: Jumpking has received nine reports of weights falling off handles, including five consumers who received injuries such as bruising, a broken nose, and a broken…

recalls.title: CPSC, Huffy Bicycle Company Announce Recall of "Cranbrook" Bicycles Sold at Wal-Mart
recalls.name: Huffy "Cranbrook" Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The handlebar could unexpectedly loosen, causing the rider to lose control of bicycle.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles and contact Huffy Bicycle to determine if the product is a part of the recall. Consumers will receive a free replacement handlebar and stem.
recalls.description: The recall involves single-speed "Cranbrook" bicycles with 26-inch wheels. The bicycles were sold in both men's (model 56462) and ladies' (model 56472) style frames. The name "Cranbrook" is printed on the frame of the bicycle.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Sportcraft Announce Recall of Tredex Treadmills
recalls.name: Tredex 10.0 treadmill
recalls.hazard: The treadmill's circuitry can overheat, causing it to unexpectedly accelerate during use. When this happens, the user can fall.
recalls.remedy: Stop using the Tredex 10.0 treadmill immediately. Firm no longer in business. Recall remedy no longer available. Discard the product. Do not donate or resell.
recalls.description: The treadmill measures 62 inches high, 79 inches long, and 35 inches wide. It is gray and has a gray control panel. The name "Tredex 10.0" appears on the control console of the treadmill and on the motor cover of the treadmill.
recalls.injuries: Sportcraft received nine reports of unexpected acceleration, including five reports of injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, Pacific Cycle Inc. Announce Recall of Mongoose 20-Inch Mountain Bicycles
recalls.name: Mongoose aluminum 20-inch-wheel "D-XR AL" mountain bicycles
recalls.hazard: The rear shock absorber allows the aluminum dual-suspension frame to flex severely, causing the frame to become unstable and break, posing the risk of injury to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately and call Pacific Cycle Inc. to receive a free replacement rear shock and instructions.
recalls.description: These are Mongoose aluminum 20-inch-wheel, D-XR AL, dual-suspension mountain bicycles. They have model number "R1590WMET" written on the service sticker, located on the bottom bracket tube near the pedals. The bicycles are silver and red colored.
recalls.injuries: Pacific Cycle Inc. has received two reports of the frames on these bicycles breaking, resulting in abrasions and bruises to the rider.

recalls.title: CPSC, Valley Dynamo Announce Recall of Air Hockey Tables
recalls.name: Air Hockey Tables
recalls.hazard: The blower motor, located under the table, has an opening large enough for a child's finger, posing a laceration hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product and contact Dynamo for instructions on receiving a free repair kit.
recalls.description: This recall involves Arctic Flash, Arctic Wind and Air Elegance model air hockey tables. The Arctic Flash model has an overhead scoring display and black-light graphics. It measures 42.5 inches wide and 71 inches high and 82.5 inches long.
recalls.injuries: Valley Dynamo is aware of a minor laceration injury to a child, who crawled under the air hockey table and stuck his finger in an exposed opening.

recalls.title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Accessory Skis for Snowmobiles
recalls.name: Accessory Skis for Polaris snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: The accessory skis sold for Polaris snowmobiles could break, resulting in injury or death.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using their snowmobiles immediately if they have installed red accessory skis and bring the skis or snowmobile to their Polaris dealer for replacement.
recalls.description: The recalled skis are the red composite (nonmetallic) skis and were sold as an accessory item for use on Polaris snowmobiles. The part number is inscribed on the tail of the snowmobile ski.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Hasbro Inc. Announce Recall of NERF® Big Play Football™
recalls.name: NERF® Big Play Football™
recalls.hazard: The football contains a hard plastic interior frame that can pose a risk of facial cuts if a child is hit during play.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using this football immediately and return it to the company for a replacement NERF product of equal value. Hasbro will provide consumers with a postage-prepaid label to return the product.
recalls.description: The NERF® Big Play Football™ is a red and silver NERF football with a silver flip-open top that reveals an erasable writing pad to plan football plays on, in the center of the ball.
recalls.injuries: There have been nine reports of facial injuries, including eight requiring stitches or medical attention.

recalls.title: CPSC, Specialized Announce Recall of Brake Rotors On Mountain Bikes
recalls.name: Specialized mountain bikes
recalls.hazard: During heavy braking, the brake tabs on the front forks could break off, possibly causing a loss of control and fall from the bicycle.
recalls.remedy: Specialized has agreed to replace the 8-inch brake rotors on these bikes with 6-inch rotors at no cost to the consumer. Consumers should stop riding these bikes and return them to an authorized retailer.
recalls.description: These are 2004 S Works Enduro and 2004 Enduro Expert mountain bikes with 8-inch brake rotors in the front.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Scooters and Mini Bikes
recalls.name: Lightning PAC Scooters and MX3 Mini Bikes
recalls.hazard: The motor control circuits can malfunction, causing the scooters and mini bikes to continue to run after the power or throttle button is released, posing a risk of injury to children.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take the toy vehicle(s) away from children immediately and contact Fisher-Price to receive information on how to have their toys serviced for free at a certified Power Wheels Service Center. The Service Centers will make modifications to the toy vehicles' circuitry.
recalls.units: About 30,000 Lightning PAC Scooters, and about 55,000 MX3 Mini Bikes
recalls.description: The recalled Lightning PAC Scooters and MX3 Mini Bikes are battery powered ride-on toys designed for children ages six years and older. The product names are located on the side of the toy.
recalls.injuries: Fisher-Price has received 56 reports of incidents with the scooters, including one report of a chipped tooth and one report of a broken arm.

recalls.title: CPSC, Cybex International Inc. Announce Recall of Treadmills
recalls.name: Cybex or Trotter Treadmill
recalls.hazard: Fire hazard because of overheating and ignition of dust inside the treadmill's hood. The dust accumulates because of lack of regular maintenance.
recalls.remedy: Unplug and stop using the treadmill immediately. Repairs will be scheduled free of charge, with a certified Cybex service technician.
recalls.description: Treadmill is black with gray coloring and has rectangular uprights. It is 69" in length and 30" in width. It has a small display panel that is almost as wide as the treadmill.
recalls.injuries: Five reports of fire, resulting in property damage to the treadmill and, in some instances, smoke-related damage to the surrounding area. No injuries reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Park Tool USA Announce Recall of Bicycle Floor Pump
recalls.name: Professional Bicycle Floor Pump
recalls.hazard: The bicycle pump can become over-pressurized with air, forcing the handle to quickly and unexpectedly rise upward, possibly injuring the user.
recalls.remedy: Contact Park Tool to receive a replacement pump and instructions on how to switch the parts from the old pump to the new pump.
recalls.description: The pump is chrome and "Park Tool USA" is written in white letters on the side. Only units manufactured prior to August 2003 with a black indicator on the pressure gauge are included in the recall.
recalls.injuries: Park Tool USA has received reports of three injuries. They include a chipped tooth, a small laceration on the chin and bruises.

recalls.title: CPSC, Swimways Corp. Announce Recall of Swim Trainers
recalls.name: Sandy Claws Swim Trainers
recalls.hazard: The nylon body strap on the swim trainer can detach or tear from the flotation device and release a child into water, posing a serious drowning hazard to young children.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the swim trainers immediately and return them to the company for a full refund. Swimways will provide consumers with a self-addressed envelope to return the product.
recalls.description: The recalled "Sandy Claws" Swim Trainer is a red-and-yellow-colored fabric crab with eight stuffed legs and two eyes covering a styrofoam buoyancy float. Black straps are attached to the side seams to fasten around a child.
recalls.injuries: There have been seven reports of the body straps detaching and two reports of the seams splitting, though no injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Life Fitness Announce Recall to Repair Treadmills
recalls.name: Life Fitness Treadmill
recalls.hazard: The treadmill can unexpectedly accelerate, possibly causing the user to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Life Fitness is contacting all registered owners and scheduling an on-site repair at no charge.
recalls.description: This program includes the following Life Fitness treadmills: Model 9000HR: Serial numbers CTB100000-CTB101618, Model 8500: Serial numbers MTB100000-MTB100646, T9I: Serial numbers CTI100000-CTI100746
recalls.injuries: Life Fitness has received 7 reports of unexpected acceleration.

recalls.title: CPSC, Cervélo Cycles Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Forks
recalls.name: Wolf Bicycle Forks
recalls.hazard: The forks on the bicycles can develop cracks near the crown area, resulting in failure of the fork and posing a risk of injury to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Return the bicycles with the recalled forks to the dealer where purchased or contact Cervélo's recall hotline to locate the nearest service dealer to receive a free replacement.
recalls.description: The recall involves "Wolf" all-carbon road bike forks with a 1-inch diameter threadless steer tube. The bicycle forks were sold with 2003 model Soloist Team and Super Prodigy bicycles and framesets.
recalls.injuries: None.

recalls.title: CPSC, Hedstrom Corp. Announce Recall of Trampolines
recalls.name: Hedstrom and NBF Trampolines
recalls.hazard: Welds on the frame of these trampolines can break during use, causing consumers to fall to the ground and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer available. Consumers should stop using and discard or destroy the product immediately, to prevent injuries.
recalls.description: These are 12-foot, 13-foot, and 14-foot trampolines, which were sold separately, and also banded together with safety enclosures. They were sold under the brand names Hedstrom and NBF. The brand name is written on the warning labels found on the products.
recalls.injuries: Hedstrom had received about 700 reports of one or more welds breaking from the trampoline frame rails during use, resulting in 10 minor injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, Bombardier Motor Corporation of America Announce Recall of Snowmobiles
recalls.name: Ski-Doo® snowmobiles
recalls.hazard: The Start/RER switch for the SDI models and the Start switch for the V-1000 models may be defective, creating two potential problems: Condition A: If the operator leaves the engine cut out switch in the "ON" position and the tether cut out switch cap on the…
recalls.remedy: Consumers should contact their Bombardier dealer to schedule an appointment. The dealer will replace the Start/RER switch (SDI models) or Start switch (V-1000 models). Bombardier Motor Corporation of America has notified consumers directly about this recall.
recalls.description: The recalled snowmobiles are 2-tone blue or all black. The name of the engine is written on the hood: Rotax 4-TEC V-1000 or Rotax 2-TEC 800 SDI.
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Monarch Velo, LLC doing business as Catlike USA Announce Recall of Bike Helmets
recalls.name: Catlike Kompact™ Bike Helmets
recalls.hazard: The helmets fail impact testing required under CPSC's safety standard for bicycle helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act.
recalls.remedy: Monarch Velo is no longer in business and has no product or ability to refund the consumers purchase price. Consumers can either get another type of helmet from the retailer they purchased the helmet from, or contact Catlike in Spain, who was the manufacturer of the helmets.
recalls.description: This recall involves Catlike Kompact™ adult bicycle helmets. The helmets were sold in two sizes (small/medium and large/extra large) and various colors. The sizing label inside the helmets reads "Kompact" and "SM/MD" or "LG/XL."
recalls.injuries: None reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Dynacraft Industries Inc. Announce Recall of BMX Bicycles
recalls.name: Next Voltage and "Vertical Street Blade" BMX bicycles
recalls.hazard: The stems on these bicycles can loosen during use, causing riders to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately and contact Dynacraft Industries for information on receiving a replacement stem.
recalls.description: The recall includes two models of 20-inch BMX bicycles. The Next Voltage model bicycles are metallic green, have model number 8535-99 and were manufactured between March 2002 and June 2002.
recalls.injuries: Dynacraft Industries has received 35 reports of stems loosening on these bicycles, resulting in one report of an injury (a broken finger).

recalls.title: CPSC, Black Diamond Equipment Announce Recall of Bionic Crampons
recalls.name: Bionic Crampons (used for ice climbing)
recalls.hazard: Front rail of crampon could be improperly heat-treated and toe points could bend, resulting in malfunction of the crampon.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should return to Black Diamond Equipment for hardness inspection, and the front rail will be replaced, if needed.
recalls.description: The Bionic-model Crampons have product date codes of 1360, 2235, or 2250 written on the top of the crampon steel adjustment strap.
recalls.injuries: Black Diamond has received 13 reports of crampon rails bending. No injuries were reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, MOSA Sports Announce Recall of Bicycle Helmets
recalls.name: Five 40 brand bicycle helmets
recalls.hazard: These helmets fail impact testing required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act. Riders wearing these helmets are not adequately protected from falls, and could suffer head injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these helmets immediately and return them to the store where purchased or MOSA Sports for a refund or free replacement helmet.
recalls.description: The Five 40 helmets are black, white or red, and have the name "Five 40" printed on the front and back of the helmet. The "V" in the "Five" is much larger than the other letters. A label inside the helmet reads "990803" along with the model name "540."
recalls.injuries: CPSC and MOSA Sports have not received any reports of injuries or incidents involving these helmets.

recalls.title: CPSC, Sun Rise Industrial Co., Ltd. and Raleigh America Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
recalls.name: 2002 Diamondback X-10 and X-20 Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The frames on these bicycles can break, which can cause riders to lose control and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these bicycles and return them to an authorized Diamondback dealer to receive a free replacement frame.
recalls.description: The recall involves the 2002 Diamondback X-10 and X-20 Bicycles. These are full-suspension, Y-frame mountain bikes. They are either silver and black or black and blue. "Diamondback" and "X10" or "X20" are written on the down and bottom tubes.
recalls.injuries: Raleigh America has received 13 reports of frames breaking, including one incident where a consumer reported a broken heel.

recalls.title: CPSC, Gen-X Sports Incorporated Announce Recall of Skateboard Ramp
recalls.name: Skateboard Ramp
recalls.hazard: The ramps can crack, causing users to fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these ramps immediately and contact Gen-X to receive a refund.
recalls.description: The recalled ramps include the Rage SSD (model 310937) and Skate Attack SSD (model 312912). The ramps are black and have a sticker with the Rage or Skate Attack logo and name on each side.
recalls.injuries: Gen-X Sports has received one report of the ramp cracking. The user, who was riding a scooter at the time of the incident, fell and broke his collarbone.

recalls.title: CPSC, Cannondale Corp. Announce Recall of Gemini Bicycles
recalls.name: Gemini Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The frames on some of these bicycles have been improperly manufactured, causing too much of the thickest portion of the downtube to be removed. This could cause the frame to break during use, resulting in falls and serious injury to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately and contact their local Cannondale retailer for a free inspection of their bicycle frame. Consumers with improperly manufactured frames will have a free replacement frame installed.
recalls.description: The recall involves the following bicycle models with medium- and large-sized frames: 2002 Gemini 1000 2003 Gemini 2000 2002 Gemini 2000 2003 Gemini 1000 2003 Gemini 900 The bicycles have "Cannondale" written on the downtube, and "Gemini" and the model number…
recalls.injuries: Cannondale has received three reports of frames breaking. One minor injury was reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Lida Bicycle Co. Announce Recall of Men's Bicycles
recalls.name: Men's Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The frames of these bicycles can break apart, causing the rider to fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately, and return them to the store where purchased for a refund or store credit.
recalls.description: The bicycle is a 26-inch, 21-speed, dual-suspension men's bicycle with a double-bar, white frame. "Kent" is written on the down tube and head tube of the bicycle. The decal reading "2100DH" or "PRO-X" appears on the top tube near the head of the bicycle.
recalls.injuries: Lida Bicycle and the bicycle distributor, Kent International Inc., of Parsippany, N.J., have received four reports of the frames of these bicycles breaking.

recalls.title: CPSC, Performance Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Handlebar Attachments
recalls.name: Performance Forte Pro Stix Bar Ends (Bicycle Handlebar Extensions)
recalls.hazard: The bar ends can crack when tightened and come loose during use, which can cause riders to lose control of the bicycle and possibly suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bar ends immediately and return them for a replacement or refund. Consumers can return the bar ends to the nearest Performance Store or by mailing them to Performance Inc., Attn: Returns Dept., One Performance Way, Chapel Hill, NC 27514.
recalls.description: The recalled Performance Forte Pro Stix Bar Ends are three to four inches in length and attach to the ends of the handlebar. The bar ends are primarily used during hill climbing when mountain biking, as they give a rider added leverage when he/she is off the…
recalls.injuries: Performance Inc. has received two reports of the bar ends cracking, though no injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC and EV Global Motors Co. Announce Recall of Lithium Batteries in Electric Bikes
recalls.name: Lithium Batteries in Electric Bikes
recalls.hazard: The lithium ion batteries in these bicycles can overheat and pose a fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately. The firm is no longer in business and a remedy is no longer available.
recalls.description: The recalled lithium ion batteries are used to power EV Global's folding Mini E-Bike. The battery, which is located in the battery compartment just in front of the seat, is supplied with most models of the Mini E-Bike.
recalls.injuries: EV Global Motors has received five reports of the batteries overheating, three of which caught fire, though no injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Huffy Sports Company Announce Recall to Repair Portable Basketball Hoops
recalls.name: Portable Basketball Hoops
recalls.hazard: The basketball hoops can have a sharp protruding bolt on the player's side of the pole, that can cause serious leg or body lacerations to consumers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should examine their units immediately. If there is a protruding bolt in the area of play, contact Huffy Sports to receive free bolt covers.
recalls.description: These are portable, vertically mounted Huffy-brand basketball systems that come unassembled with a plastic base, that is weighted down by either sand or water, that is added during assembly.
recalls.injuries: CPSC and Huffy Sports have received 11 reports of injuries from protruding bolts that include scrapes and lacerations.

recalls.title: CPSC, Haro Bicycle Corp. Announce Recall of Bicycles
recalls.name: BMX freestyle bicycles
recalls.hazard: The length of the crank arm in the 2003 model fails to allow sufficient space between the rider's foot and the front wheel, when the front wheel is turned backwards.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bicycles immediately and contact Haro to learn where to take their bicycles to have the crankset replaced free of charge.
recalls.description: The recall includes the 2003 Haro BMX freestyle bicycles. The models involved are the F2 and the Backtrail XO. The model names are printed on the top and down tube of the F2, and on the top tube of the Backtrail XO.
recalls.injuries: Haro has not received any reports of incidents or injuries. This recall is being conducted to prevent the possibility of injury.

recalls.title: CPSC, Todson Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Tire Floor Pumps
recalls.name: Bicycle Tire Floor Pumps
recalls.hazard: The pressure gauge lens can separate from the pump and strike a consumer, causing injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using this pump immediately and contact Todson to receive a replacement pump.
recalls.description: The recalled Topeak Joe Blow Comp Floor Pumps are black (with gray or silver trim) and stand about 26 inches tall. The plastic pumps have the following date codes, which are located under the pressure gauge: 200003 through 200012 and 200101 through 200108.
recalls.injuries: Todson has received one report of a pressure gauge lens detaching and striking a consumer, who suffered an eye injury.

recalls.title: CPSC, Answer Products Inc. Announce Recall of Mountain Bicycles
recalls.name: Suspension Forks on Specialized Rockhopper A-1 Comp and Mongoose Hot Link Sommet series bicycles
recalls.hazard: The spring and adjuster can separate from the suspension fork and strike the rider, causing injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles and contact Answer Products, Inc. to determine if your bicycle is among the recalled models. Consumers should take their bicycle to the dealer where it was purchased or to any authorized Answer Products dealer, for a free repair.
recalls.description: The recalled 2002 model forks were installed on Specialized Rockhopper A-1 Comp and Mongoose Hot Link Sommet series bicycles. "MANITOU" is printed on the side of the fork and the model name - "Six Elite" and "Six Super" - is printed on the arch of the fork…
recalls.injuries: Answer Products has received 18 reports of these adjusters separating from the fork and being projected at riders, causing four consumers to suffer cuts,…

recalls.title: CPSC, Cannondale Corp. Announce Recall of Bicycles With Defective Stems
recalls.name: Bicycle stems installed on 2002 and 2003 Cannondale bicycles
recalls.hazard: The stem can break away from the bicycle, causing a loss of control, falls and serious injury to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding bicycles with these stems immediately and contact a local Cannondale retailer for a free repair.
recalls.description: The recalled stems are black and have the model name 3T ZEPP XL printed in white on the sides of the body of the stem. The faceplate also has "3T" printed in white at the front of the stem.
recalls.injuries: Cannondale has received four reports of stems breaking, including one minor injury.

recalls.title: CPSC, Marin Mountain Bikes Announce Recall of Mountain Bikes
recalls.name: Marin-brand mountain bikes with aluminum frames
recalls.hazard: The steer tube on the front of these bicycles can break off from the two main tubes of the frame, causing the rider to lose control, fall and possibly suffer serious injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bikes immediately and contact Marin Mountain Bikes to learn where to take their bikes to have the frames replaced free of charge.
recalls.description: The recall involves Marin-brand mountain bikes with aluminum frames. There are seven model bikes with 11.5-inch frames and one model with a 13.5-inch frame.
recalls.injuries: Marin has received two reports of the steer tube breaking off, resulting in two injuries that included broken bones, broken teeth, cuts and abrasions.

recalls.title: CPSC, Dynacraft Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles Sold at Target
recalls.name: Vertical XL2 mountain bicycles
recalls.hazard: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall, and suffer serious injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately and contact Dynacraft Industries for information on receiving a free replacement fork and free installation.
recalls.description: The recall includes only 24-inch Vertical XL2 mountain bicycles, with model number 8524-21. A label on the frame near the crank housing identifies the model number. The bicycles are red.
recalls.injuries: Dynacraft has received six reports of the forks breaking apart on these bicycles, resulting in injuries that include abrasions, cuts, bruises and broken teeth.

recalls.title: CPSC, BY US International Co. Announce Recall of "NEXT" Ultra Shock Bicycles Sold at Wal-Mart
recalls.name: Next Ultra Shock mountain bicycles with "Ballistic 105" front suspension forks
recalls.hazard: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall and suffer serious injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately and call Dynacraft Industries for information on receiving a free replacement fork and free installation.
recalls.description: The recall includes only Next Ultra Shock bicycles, which are blue, with model numbers 8524-14 and 8526-20. They were manufactured between April 1999 and November 9, 1999.
recalls.injuries: There have been 20 reports of the suspension forks breaking on the Next Ultra Shock bicycles, resulting in 19 riders suffering injuries that include abrasions,…

recalls.title: CPSC, Rocky Mountain Bicycles Announce Recall of Mountain Bicycles
recalls.name: Slayer and "Edge" Rocky Mountain Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The chainstay that holds the rear wheel in place can fail, causing the rear wheel to separate from the bicycle. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a free repair.
recalls.description: This recall involves 16.5-, 18- and 19-inch Slayer and Edge full-suspension mountain bicycles. The Slayer model is black metallic with red decals on the top tube and downtube, that read "Slayer" and "Rocky Mountain." The Edge model is royal blue with yellow…
recalls.injuries: Rocky Mountain Bicycles have received one report of an incident where the rear wheel separated from the bicycle.

recalls.title: CPSC, Club Car, Inc. Announce Recall of Golf Cars
recalls.name: Club Car DS Golf Cars and Utility Vehicles
recalls.hazard: The fuel tank may leak, posing a potential fire hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled vehicles immediately and inspect the tank and storage areas for any sign of leakage prior to use. If signs of leakage are present, consumers should discontinue use of car and contact the nearest Club Car Dealer immediately. The fuel tank replacement will be done free of charge. Club Car has notified consumers directly about this updated recall, to schedule a tank replacement.
recalls.description: The recalled vehicles are serial numbers 0229-169750 through 0236-197543. The serial number is located on a decal just above and to the right of the accelerator pedal.
recalls.injuries: Club Car and CPSC first announced a recall/inspection program of these cars May 7, 2002, after two reports of leaking fuel tanks.

recalls.title: CPSC, Specialized Bicycle Components Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
recalls.name: 2002 Enduro-brand bicycles
recalls.hazard: The rear seatstays, the tube behind the seat that connects the rear axle to the rear shock, can break, possibly causing the rider to lose control and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately, and return them to their local Specialized dealer for a new rear seatstay, which will be installed, at no charge.
recalls.description: The recall involves model year 2002 Enduro-brand bicycles. The Enduro Pro FSR is silver; the Enduro Expert FSR is black; the Enduro Comp FSR is yellow; and the Enduro FSR is blue.
recalls.injuries: Specialized Bicycles has received 39 reports of the seatstays on these bicycles breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, InSTEP LLC Announce Recall of Trailer Bikes
recalls.name: Hitchhiker III Trailer Bikes
recalls.hazard: The bike's universal joint system can fail, causing a rider to lose control of the bike. This poses a risk of injury to either of the two riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these trailer bikes immediately and contact InSTEP for a free repair kit with instructions.
recalls.description: The recalled Hitchhiker III trailer bikes are attached to a lead bicycle by a universal joint system with two side bolts and a top-mounted quick-release bolt (as seen in the picture).
recalls.injuries: CPSC and InSTEP have received 10 reports of universal joint systems failing, including three reports of consumers who suffered contusions and abrasions.

recalls.title: CPSC, Horizon Fitness Announce Recall of Treadmills
recalls.name: 2000/2001 Paragon, Quantum and Omega treadmills
recalls.hazard: A component of the electronic control panel can malfunction, causing the motor and walking belt to rapidly accelerate and the user can lose balance and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these treadmills immediately and contact Horizon Fitness to receive a repair kit and to set up an appointment to receive an in-home repair.
recalls.description: The models included in the recall are the model year 2000/2001 Paragon, Quantum and Omega treadmills. This recall does not include any 2002 model product, which include the Omega II, Quantum II, Paragon II, and Alpine.
recalls.injuries: Horizon Fitness and CPSC have received 15 reports of consumers losing their balance and falling off of the treadmill. Injuries include cuts and abrasions.

recalls.title: CPSC, Brunswick Corp. Announce Another Expanded Recall of Mongoose and Roadmaster Mountain Bicycles
recalls.name: Mongoose and Roadmaster mountain bicycles with Ballistic 105 front suspension forks
recalls.hazard: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall and suffer serious injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these bicycles and call the firm to obtain information on receiving a $65 refund for the bicycle fork. This applies to all owners of bicycles with Ballistic model 105 forks manufactured by Brunswick (except the Mongoose A40), even if they received a new Ballistic model 105 fork, as a result of participating in a previous recall.
recalls.description: The recall includes only Ballistic 105 forks installed on Mongoose and Roadmaster model bicycles manufactured by Brunswick Corp. The forks on these bikes are black with decals that read "BALLISTIC" and "105" on the sides of the suspension fork legs.
recalls.injuries: There have been 34 reports of forks on these bicycles breaking, resulting in 31 riders, including children and teenagers, suffering serious head and bodily…

recalls.title: CPSC, Lifetime Products Inc. and Escalade Sports Announce Recall to Repair Portable Basketball Hoops
recalls.name: Portable basketball hoops
recalls.hazard: The basketball hoops may have a sharp protruding bolt on the players' side of the pole, that can cause serious leg or body lacerations to consumers, when the bolt is exposed.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the basketball hoops immediately and contact Lifetime Products or Escalade Sports to receive free cap nuts to cover the bolts. Consumers should call and get a cap nut, regardless of whether their bolt protrudes or not.
recalls.units: About 1.7 million Lifetime portable hoops, and about 16,000 Escalade portable hoops
recalls.description: All Lifetime portable basketball system models, except the "Quick Court" are included in the recall. The Escalade Sports basketball hoop models included in the recall are the Harvard, The Big Easy, B3100, B3301, B3302, B3303, B3304, B3305, B3306, B3403,…
recalls.injuries: CPSC and Lifetime Products Inc. have received 27 reports of injuries and Escalade Sports has received one report of injury from the basketball hoop bolt.

recalls.title: CPSC, BikeE Corp. Announce Recall of Recumbent Bicycles
recalls.name: BikeE Recumbent Bicycle
recalls.hazard: The recumbent seats on these bicycles can crack and break, causing the seat to come off the frame and resulting in injury to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately. As the firm is no longer involved with this recall, consumers can take a recalled bicycle to the dealer from which purchased, but it is up to the dealer as to whether the repair can be performed, and whether there is a charge.
recalls.description: The recall includes all 1999 through 2001 model BikeE bicycles with 27- inch-tall seat backs, silver-colored seat frames with black mesh seat backs. "BikeE" is written on the frame of these bicycles.
recalls.injuries: BikeE Corp. has received two reports of seats on these bicycles breaking while riding, resulting in one injury, that included a broken leg.

recalls.title: CPSC, Kent International Inc. Announce Recall of "Midget Racer" Mini-Bicycles
recalls.name: Midget Racer mini-bicycle
recalls.hazard: The front fork assembly on these mini-bicycles can loosen or break, and cause the rider to lose control and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these Midget Racer mini-bicycles immediately and return them to the place of purchase for a refund or to receive a replacement mini-bicycle.
recalls.description: The "Midget Racer" mini-bicycle is yellow with 8-inch black rubber tires, black seat and black handgrips. The mini-bicycle is about 31 inches long and 23 inches high. "MIDGET RACER" and "KENT" are written in red lettering on the frame of the bicycle.
recalls.injuries: Kent International has not received any reports of injuries or incidents relating to the front forks on these mini-bicycles breaking.

recalls.title: CPSC, Game Tracker Announce Recall of Climbing Sticks and Tree Steps
recalls.name: Climbing Sticks and Tree Steps
recalls.hazard: The buckles on the climbing sticks and tree steps can fail, posing a risk of serious injury to hunters.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these climbing sticks and tree steps immediately. Consumers should return the product to the company, by writing to: The Game Tracker Inc., Attn: Product Safety Coordinator, PO Box 380, 3475 Eastman Dr., Flushing, MI 48433. Game Tracker will provide a free repair of the climbing sticks and a free replacement for the tree steps.
recalls.description: The recalled Gorilla Ultralite Climbing Sticks, model number 3163, have the serial numbers 040501, 050501, and 060801 printed on the main brace of the stick.
recalls.injuries: Game Tracker and CPSC have received 16 reports of buckles failing, including one hunter who suffered a partial finger amputation and five others who suffered…

recalls.title: CPSC, Raleigh America Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
recalls.name: 2001 Diamondback XSL-Race and XSL-Pro Mountain Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The bottom bracket spindle inside the crankset of the bicycle can break, causing the rider to lose control and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles and contact the authorized Diamondback dealer where the bicycle was purchased to arrange for a free repair.
recalls.description: The recalled bicycles are the 2001 Diamondback XSL-Race and XSL-Pro Mountain models. The XSL-Race model is white with red and black decals. The XSL-Pro model is yellow with white decals.
recalls.injuries: Raleigh America has received five reports of bottom bracket spindles breaking. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, BikeE Announce Recall of Recumbent Tandem Bicycle
recalls.name: BikeE recumbent tandem bicycles
recalls.hazard: The steerer tube on the front forks can separate, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall, and possibly suffer serious injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately. The firm, BikeE, is out of business and cannot be contacted. As the firm is no longer involved with this recall, consumers can take a recalled bicycle to the dealer from which it was purchased, but it is up to the dealer as to whether the repair can be performed, and whether there is a charge.
recalls.description: The recalled bikes were manufactured in 2000 and 2001. These bikes have two handlebars and two seats, which are in a lowered, horizontal riding position. The name "BikeE" appears on both sides of the main frame.
recalls.injuries: BikeE Corp. has received three reports of steerer tubes beginning to separate; though, no injuries to riders have occurred.

recalls.title: CPSC, Pacific Cycle, LLC Announce Recall to Repair Ally Cat Tandem Bicycle Accessories
recalls.name: Moongoose "Ally Cat" tandem bicycle accessories
recalls.hazard: The hitch connecting the tandem accessory to the host bicycle can fail, causing the tandem accessory to become unstable, which poses the risk of injury to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycle accessories immediately and call Pacific Cycle for a free replacement hitch and instructions. In addition, L.L.Bean Inc., which sold these bicycle accessories by catalog, will contact each of their known purchasers to provide the needed replacement parts.
recalls.description: The "Ally Cat" tandem bicycle accessory consists of a wheel, seat, pedals, and handlebars, and attaches to the host bicycle by a hitch.
recalls.injuries: Pacific Cycle has received one report of the tandem bicycle accessory connection failing, resulting in abrasions to the rider of the tandem.

recalls.title: CPSC, Performance Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Rims
recalls.name: Performance Road 2001 Bicycle Rims
recalls.hazard: The rims can crack, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately and return the wheels to a Performance Store for free replacement rims.
recalls.description: The recalled rims were used on both the front and rear wheels of the 2001 Model bicycles (with the R-101 model name), Performance Forte/Forte SL rims, and Performance Forte SL road wheels.
recalls.injuries: Performance has received two reports of rims failing, though no injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Wysco Inc. Announce Recall of "Runt"™ Mini-Bicycles
recalls.name: Runt™ brand mini-bicycles
recalls.hazard: These bicycles do not have any brakes, which are required by the CPSC standard for bicycles of this type. The CPSC standard also requires that these bicycles have chain guards, to prevent riders from getting fingers, toes and clothing caught in the gears.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these Runt bicycles immediately and get a free repair kit. To order a free repair kit and for more information, call Wysco.
recalls.description: The "Runt"™ mini-bicycles are about 24 inches long and 26 inches high with 6-inch wheels. They have adjustable seats and handlebars with quick release levers. The bicycles are red, blue, black or chrome in color with black seats and handle grips.
recalls.injuries: Wysco has not received any reports of incidents or injuries involving these mini-bicycles.

recalls.title: CPSC, Salsa Cycles Announce Recall of Bicycle Rims
recalls.name: Salsa Alto disk-brake bicycle rims
recalls.hazard: The rims can unexpectedly fail during normal use, posing the risk of falls and serious injury to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers with the recalled rims should stop using them immediately and return them to the store where they were purchased, for a full refund or free replacement.
recalls.description: The recalled rims are the Salsa Alto models, which have a black anodized finish and are labeled "Salsa" and "Salsa Alto" in yellow, red and white.
recalls.injuries: Salsa Cycles has received six reports of rims failing during use; though, no injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, TH!NK Mobility Recall Electrically Assisted Bicycles
recalls.name: TH!NK bike traveler electric bicycles
recalls.hazard: The top of the handlebar stem binder bolt may twist off, while being tightened.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should be aware of this possible condition while tightening the stem binder bolt and contact TH!NK Mobility to receive a free repair kit. Purchasers were sent direct mail notification of this recall.
recalls.description: The TH!NK traveler is an electric, power assisted bike with 20" wheels and a folding frame. The serial number is stamped into the inside of the left rear "dropout" of the frame (the dropout is the piece of frame that holds the left-side axle of the rear…
recalls.injuries: There is no incidence of the bolt breaking during bike use. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, SoloRider Industries Announce Recall of Single Rider Golf Carts
recalls.name: SoloRider AteeA Model 32 golf carts
recalls.hazard: The golf cart's software can be corrupted by static electricity, allowing it to move forward without assistance. Riders or bystanders could suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled golf carts immediately and contact the SoloRider dealer where purchased for a free repair. SoloRider has notified consumers directly about this recall.
recalls.description: The AteeA model 32 is a single-rider electric golf cart that came in hunter green, or Daytona white. The four-wheeled cart has dual-hand controls, a front-mounted golf bag rack, and a seat basket mounted on the back of the seat.
recalls.injuries: SoloRider has received one report of a showroom golf cart that continued to operate after it was turned off. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, World Industries Announce Recall of Skateboard Helmets
recalls.name: World Industries skateboard helmets
recalls.hazard: These helmets failed impact testing required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets. Riders wearing these helmets are not adequately protected from falls and could suffer head injuries or death.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these helmets immediately and return them to the stores where purchased, for a full refund.
recalls.description: The recalled helmets come in black, blue and white and have the name "World Industries" printed on the chin strap, the back of the helmet, and the inside padding.
recalls.injuries: CPSC and World Industries have not received any reports of injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, BikeE Announce Recall of Recumbent Bicycle Suspension Forks
recalls.name: Suspension forks on FX and RX model recumbent bicycles
recalls.hazard: The link pins in the forks can fall out, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall, and possibly suffer serious injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately. The firm, BikeE, is out of business and cannot be contacted. As the firm is no longer involved with this recall, consumers can take a recalled bicycle to the dealer from which purchased, but it is up to the dealer as to whether the repair can be performed, and whether there is a charge.
recalls.description: The recalled forks were used on the front suspension of the BikeE FX models and on the full suspension of the RX models. The 2000 and 2001 model year bicycles can be identified by a serial number located below the crank bottom bracket on the frame.
recalls.injuries: BikeE Corp. has received two reports of pins falling out of forks, resulting in two minor injuries to riders.

recalls.title: CPSC, Acetrike Bicycle Co. Announce Recall of Children's Bicycles
recalls.name: Children's sidewalk bicycles
recalls.hazard: The frames of these bikes can break, causing the riders to fall and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately, and call Huffy Bicycle Co. to determine if their bicycle is part of the recall. Consumers with a recalled bicycle will receive a replacement bicycle free of charge.
recalls.description: The recall includes bicycles having date codes of April 2000 and earlier. The date code is molded on the bicycles' left rear frame, at the point of attachment of the rear wheel. The model name is written on the bike's frame.
recalls.injuries: Acetrike and the distributor of the bicycles, Huffy Bicycle Co., have received four reports of the frames on these bicycles breaking.

recalls.title: CPSC, Giant Bicycle, Inc. Recall Giant Bicycle Forks
recalls.name: Giant-brand bicycle front forks
recalls.hazard: The forks can break during use, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall and suffer serious injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately, and return them to the nearest Giant Authorized Dealer for a free inspection, and, if necessary, repair.
recalls.description: These carbon fiber forks were sold on 2001-model Giant TCR Team, TCR 0, TCR 1, TCR 2 and OCR 1 bicycles and framesets (an unassembled bicycle frame and fork). The recalled forks have a date code on the steerer tubes.
recalls.injuries: Giant Bicycle, Inc. has received two reports of the forks on these bicycles breaking, resulting in one minor injury.

recalls.title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Basketball Sets
recalls.name: Grow-to-Pro Basketball Set
recalls.hazard: Some of the nets have enlarged openings. If children put their heads into these enlarged openings, the net can get tangled around their necks and they could strangle.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the basketball set immediately. Consumers should call Fisher-Price to order a free replacement net.
recalls.description: The recalled Grow-to-Pro Basketball set has a black pole that adjusts from 3 to 6 feet. A nylon net with an orange plastic hoop is attached to the pole, along with a gray backboard.
recalls.injuries: Fisher-Price has not received any reports of injuries. This recall is being conducted to prevent the possibility of injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, Dynacraft Announce Recall of Mountain Bicycles Sold at Toys R Us
recalls.name: Magna Equator mountain bicycles
recalls.hazard: The pedals on these bicycles can loosen and fall off while riding, resulting in serious injury to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately, and call Dynacraft to receive a free replacement pedal/crank set and to arrange for free installation.
recalls.description: These are men's and women's Magna Equator mountain bicycles. The 26-inch, 18-speed bicycles have the model names "Magna" and "Equator" written on the green-colored women's and red-colored men's bicycle frames in black lettering.
recalls.injuries: Dynacraft and CPSC have received 31 reports of pedals falling off, causing the riders to fall.

recalls.title: CPSC, Dynacraft Announce Recall of Boys' Mountain Bicycles Sold at Wal-Mart
recalls.name: Dynacraft "NEXT SHOCKZONE" Mountain Bicycles
recalls.hazard: The front-suspension forks on these bicycles can break during use, resulting in serious injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately, and call Dynacraft to receive a free replacement fork and to arrange for free installation.
recalls.description: These 20-inch, 21-speed, dual-suspension bicycles have the model name "NEXT SHOCKZONE" written on their orange frame in black lettering.
recalls.injuries: Dynacraft has received 33 reports of the front-suspension forks on these bicycles breaking, resulting in 32 injuries that included a blood clot in the brain,…

recalls.title: CPSC, ASICS TIGER Corp. Announce Recall of Wrestling Ear Guards
recalls.name: ASIC Gel Wrestling Ear Guard with Neoprene
recalls.hazard: The plastic protective shell of these guards can break when it is hit against a hard surface, resulting in impact injuries to the wrestler's head.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these ear guards immediately, and return them to the store where purchased or to the firm for a free replacement.
recalls.description: The recall involves ASIC Gel Wrestling Ear Guard with Neoprene. The guard includes two plastic ear pieces covered with neoprene nylon. The ASICS red logo is on a label on the guard's strap.
recalls.injuries: ASICS TIGER Corp. has received 10 reports of the plastic shells of these guards breaking, resulting in three injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, Pacific Cycle LLC Announce Recall of Water Bottles Included With Girls' Bikes
recalls.name: Water bottles included with girl's Mongoose Heart Breaker bicycles
recalls.hazard: The drinking valve on the cap can detach, presenting a potential choking hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take the bottles away from children immediately and discard them. To receive a replacement water bottle, contact Pacific Cycle.
recalls.description: The recalled water bottles are 12 oz. translucent blue bottles with a white cap and a silver decal that bears the "Heart Breaker" logo. The water bottles are an accessory to Mongoose Heart Breaker Bicycles.
recalls.injuries: Pacific Cycle has received two reports of drinking valves detaching. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Radica USA Ltd. Recall Baseball Video Games to Replace Bats
recalls.name: Play TV Baseball video games
recalls.hazard: The bats can separate during a swing. Broken pieces can hit a bystander and cause injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately take these recalled toys away from children and contact Radica to arrange for the return of the Play TV Baseball to receive a replacement of Play TV Baseball III.
recalls.description: Play TV Baseball is a video game that plugs directly into a television set, and simulates hitting a baseball. It contains an electronic home plate, ball and plastic bat.
recalls.injuries: Radica USA Ltd. has received seven reports of consumers, including children, being hit by pieces of the broken bat, resulting in a split lip, facial…

recalls.title: CPSC, McDonald's Announce Recall of "Scooter Bug" Happy Meal Toys
recalls.name: Scooter Bug toddler toys
recalls.hazard: The bug's antenna can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
recalls.remedy: Parents should take the toy away from children immediately and return the toy to any McDonald's restaurant for a replacement toy.
recalls.description: The Scooter Bug toy is about 3 inches long and 2-1/2 inch wide. When rolled across the floor, the bug's legs move back and forth. The bug has a yellow face with red antennas, orange feet and a purple body with green spots.
recalls.injuries: McDonald's has received two reports of children choking and one report of a child gagging on the broken off antenna.

recalls.title: CPSC, By Us International Co. Ltd. Announce Expanded Recall of Bicycle Forks Installed on Mountain Bicycles
recalls.name: Ballistic front suspension forks installed on Mongoose S-20 and MGX S-20 bicycles and Roadmaster Ridge Rider bicycles
recalls.hazard: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these bicycles and call the firm to determine if the fork on their bike is part of the recall. Consumers should have the serial number of the forks available. The serial number is located on the inside of the suspension fork leg. Consumers with recalled forks will receive a free replacement fork and free installation.
recalls.description: The recalled forks were installed on Mongoose S-20 and MGX S-20 bicycles, which are orange, and the Roadmaster Ridge Rider bicycles, which is red.
recalls.injuries: There have been 26 reports of forks on these bicycles breaking, resulting in nine riders, including teenagers, suffering serious head and bodily injuries,…

recalls.title: CPSC, Seattle Bike Supply Announce Recall of Children's Bicycles
recalls.name: 2001 Torker Blaster 16-inch Boy's bicycles and Sunflower 16-inch Girl's bicycles
recalls.hazard: Because the bikes' pedals are too low to the ground, they fail to meet federal bicycle standards. Children can lose control when a pedal strikes the ground, causing falls and injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately, and return them to the store where purchased for a free repair.
recalls.description: Bicycles that are part of this recall are all model year 2001 Torker Blaster 16-inch Boy's bicycles in red, black, blue, or chrome, and Sunflower 16-inch Girl's bicycles in yellow, pink or florescent green.
recalls.injuries: Seattle Bike Supply has received one report of a 4-year-old boy whose pedal struck the ground, while riding one of these bikes, causing him to fall.

recalls.title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Bicycles and Bicycle Components
recalls.name: Bicycles and Bicycle Components
recalls.hazard: The recumbent bicycle's front fork steering tube can break, the frame of the 12-inch children's bicycle can break during use, the Cannondale bicycle forks can break, the Magura brakes could fail, the Supergo handlebars can crack and break, causing the rider…
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the Hemi bicycles, and return them to a Specialized dealer, for a refund. Stop using the Cannondale bicycles and return them to a Cannondale retailer to have the fork rebuilt and upgraded, at no charge. Stop using bicycles with the Gustav M hydraulic disc brakes and contact a Magura dealer for repair or a brake upgrade kit. Stop using bicycles with recalled handlebars and bar ends, to obtain a refund or a free replacement handlebar, to be installed at Supergo stores.
recalls.description: RANS Bicycles long-wheelbase recumbent bicycles being recalled are the RANS Stratus, Stratus XL, Gliss, Tailwind, Wave, Response and Nimbus.
recalls.injuries: RANS Inc. has received eight reports of forks breaking on these bicycles. The company has received no reports of injuries. Specialized Bicycles Inc.

recalls.title: CPSC, Excite Ltd. Announce Recall of Scooters
recalls.name: Excite Super Speeder II and Viper scooter
recalls.hazard: The front of the folding mechanism, where the steering column meets the base of the scooter, can create a pinch-point. Fingers can be injured while folding or unfolding the scooter.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these Excite scooters immediately and contact Excite Ltd. to receive a free cap that will cover the front of the folding mechanism.
recalls.description: The recall involves Excite Super Speeder II and Viper scooters. The scooter has a lightweight aluminum frame with black, foam handle grips. "Super Speeder II" or "Viper" is printed on the standing platform and on the steering column.
recalls.injuries: Excite has received nine reports of pinch-point injuries to children including one partially amputated fingertip and eight lacerations, one of which required…

recalls.title: CPSC, Kent International and Kash 'N Gold Ltd. Announce Recall of Scooters
recalls.name: Kent Kickin' Mini-Scooters and Kash 'N Gold Racer X20TM Scooters
recalls.hazard: The Kent scooter handles can unexpectedly come out of the steering column if the clamp holding them in is not tight, causing the rider to lose control, fall and possibly suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Kent: Consumers should stop riding these Kent scooters immediately, and call Kent International to receive a free replacement handlebar with pins to secure the handlebars. Kash 'N Gold: Consumers should stop riding these scooters immediately, and return them to the store where purchased for a refund or a new scooter with a metal "T" joint.
recalls.units: About 90,000 Kent Kickin' Mini-Scooters and about 7,500 Kash 'N Gold Racer X20TM Scooters
recalls.description: Kent Kickin' Mini-Scooters These are Kickin' Mini-Scooters made of chrome-plated steel. A vertical decal on the steering column reads "KICKIN' MINI SCOOTER." The scooter's black plastic platform measures about 15 inches long, and it has 4-inch translucent…
recalls.injuries: Kent has received four reports of the handles coming out, resulting in four children suffering injuries, including broken arms, a broken wrist, bruises,…

recalls.title: CPSC, DiaTech USA and Derby USA Announce Recall of Bicycles
recalls.name: Disc bakes on DiaTech 2000 model bicycles
recalls.hazard: The disc brakes on these bicycles can stick and prevent the brake pads from returning to the proper position, when the brake lever is released. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately, and return them to their dealer for free replacement of the front and rear brake calipers.
recalls.description: These are 2000 model bicycles with the following brands and models: Brand Model Raleigh M600, M800, M8000 Diamondback Zetec Comp, X-2 Univega DS950, Alpina 700 They have ballistic spiral stop disc brakes. "DIATECH" is written on the brake.
recalls.injuries: DiaTech USA, the manufacturer of the brakes, and Derby USA, the importer and distributor, have received one report of a consumer who lost control of his…

recalls.title: CPSC, Profile Design Announce Recall of Bicycle Handlebar Stems
recalls.name: Mountain bike handlebar stems
recalls.hazard: The stem connects the bicycle's handlebars to the fork. These stems can break during use, causing the bicycle rider to crash and suffer serious injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using bicycles with these stems immediately, and either call Profile Design to get a free replacement stem, or return the bicycle with the recalled stem to a Profile-Design retailer, to have the stem replaced free of charge.
recalls.description: This recall only involves "Stiffy"™ threadless mountain bike stems. Threadless stems clamp directly around the fork's steering tube.
recalls.injuries: Profile Design has received reports of six riders crashing when the stems on their bicycles broke, resulting in teeth injuries, bruises and abrasions.

recalls.title: CPSC, Three Firms Announce Recall of Bicycle Helmets
recalls.name: Variflex Inc. "X-Games Aggressive" Bicycle Helmets, NHS TSG Helmets, and First Team Sports "Guardian Junior Helmets"
recalls.hazard: These helmets fail impact testing required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act. Riders wearing these helmets are not adequately protected from falls, and could suffer severe head injuries or death.
recalls.remedy: Variflex Inc.: Consumers should stop using these helmets immediately, and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund or replacement helmet. NHS: Consumers should stop using these helmets immediately and return them to NHS Inc., not to the store where purchased, for a refund. First Team Sports: Consumers should stop using these helmets immediately, and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund.
recalls.description: Variflex Inc. "X-Games Aggressive" Bicycle Helmets: These helmets are either black, white or chrome. They have a red "X- Games" insignia on the front and "X-Games" is written on the back.
recalls.injuries: CPSC and these firms are not aware of any injuries or incidents involving these helmets.

recalls.title: CPSC, RockShox Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Forks
recalls.name: 2001 Judy TT, Judy TT Special, Jett and Metro model RockShox bicycle forks
recalls.hazard: The compression rods inside these forks can break, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall, and possibly suffer serious injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding bicycles with the recalled forks immediately, and return them to the bicycle dealer where purchased for inspection and repair if needed.
recalls.description: Only 2001 Judy TT, Judy TT Special, Jett and Metro model RockShox front suspension bicycle forks are included in this recall. They have serial numbers beginning with "01." The serial number can be found engraved on the back side of the fork's crown and on a…
recalls.injuries: RockShox received 23 reports of compression rods in these forks breaking, and two reports of injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, I-Tech Sport Products Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Hockey Face Guards
recalls.name: Hockey face guards
recalls.hazard: These face guards, which attach to helmets, can become dislodged on impact, causing them to fall off, leaving the user's face exposed to possible injury.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled hockey face guards immediately. Consumers should take the recalled face guards back to the store where purchased for a free replacement, or they can contact I-Tech Sport Products Inc. to get a free replacement face guard sent to them.
recalls.description: Only face guards with "OPTECH System," written on the black side clips, which lock on the plastic eye shield, are part of this recall. "ITECH" is written at the top center of the plastic eye shield, on the chin guard and on the chin guard strap.
recalls.injuries: I-Tech has received one report of a hockey face guard becoming dislodged. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.hazard: Vehicle Accident
