recalls.title: CPSC, Minoura Announce Recall of Bicycle Indoor Training Stands
recalls.name: Bicycle Indoor Training Stands
recalls.hazard: These stands allow regular bicycles to be used as stationary bicycles. The flywheels, which are red or blue, can fracture in use. Metal pieces of broken flywheels can hit riders or bystanders, causing cuts and bruises.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these stands immediately, and call Minoura, to receive a free repair kit.
recalls.description: This recall only involves Minoura, Schwinn, Performance or Univega brand stands with painted red or blue exposed flywheels. The brand names are written on the stand and the flywheels are about 5 inches in diameter.
recalls.injuries: Minoura has received three reports of injuries from pieces of broken flywheels, resulting in lacerations on riders' legs.

recalls.title: CPSC, Cycle Express Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Helmets
recalls.name: "Hearts & Flowers" bicycle helmets
recalls.hazard: These helmets fail impact testing and labeling required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycle helmets immediately, and return them to the store where purchased. They will receive a $7 refund, which is the assessed value of the helmet.
recalls.description: The recalled girls' helmets are mostly pink mixed with silver glitter. The pink portion of the helmet is bordered by purple tape. Decals on the helmets read "Hearts & Flowers." These helmets are size small, for ages 2 through 5 years.
recalls.injuries: CPSC and Cycle Express are not aware of any injuries or incidents involving these helmets.

recalls.title: CPSC, Rand International Announce Recall of Bicycle Helmets
recalls.name: L.A. Cruisin' bicycle helmets
recalls.hazard: These bicycle helmets fail impact testing and labeling required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop wearing these bicycle helmets immediately, and return them to Rand International for a free replacement helmet.
recalls.description: The recalled helmets are various models of the L.A. Cruisin' bicycle helmets. The helmets were sold in various child, youth and adult sizes. The youth and adult-sized helmets are white or black and the child sizes are either blue or pink.
recalls.injuries: CPSC and Rand International are not aware of any injuries or incidents involving these products.

recalls.title: CPSC, Burley Design Cooperative Announce Recall to Repair Burely-Bravo™ Bicycle Trailers
recalls.name: Burley-Bravo™ bicycle trailers
recalls.hazard: The wheel can separate from these trailers during use, and result in crashes and injuries to children riding inside. Loss of control to the bicycle pulling these trailers also can cause the riders to crash and suffer injuries.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using these Burley-Bravo™ trailers immediately, and return them to the store where purchased, for a free inspection and repair, if needed.
recalls.description: Burley-Bravo™ trailers included in this recall were made between November 1999 and June 2000 with serial numbers 430-01-1 through 430-29- 160.
recalls.injuries: Burley has received one report of a wheel coming off of one of these trailers, causing the bicycle rider to fall and suffer minor injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, Answer Products Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Components
recalls.name: Answer and Manitou brand bicycle forks
recalls.hazard: The tube that attaches the fork to the bicycle can fail, causing riders to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding the bicycles with these forks and take them to an authorized Answer Products dealer, for a free inspection and repair.
recalls.description: These 2000 model bicycle forks have been installed on more than 30 models of bicycles and sold under Answer and Manitou brand names. Either "ANSWER" or "MANITOU" is written on the side of the fork and the model name is written on the front of the fork.
recalls.injuries: Answer Products has received six reports of these forks failing, resulting in two consumers suffering minor injuries, including cuts, bruises and chipped teeth.

recalls.title: CPSC, By Us International Co. Ltd. Announce Recall of Bicycle Components
recalls.name: Ballistic front suspension forks installed on Mongoose S-20 and MGX S-20 bicycles
recalls.hazard: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control and fall.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these bicycles and call Brunswick Bicycles for information on receiving a free replacement fork, including installation.
recalls.description: The recalled forks were installed on Mongoose S-20 and MGX S-20 bicycles, which are orange, and the Roadmaster Ridge Rider bicycles, which is red.
recalls.injuries: By Us and Brunswick have received 18 reports of forks on these bicycles breaking, resulting in nine riders, including teenagers, suffering serious head and…

recalls.title: CPSC, Dynacraft Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Mountain Bikes
recalls.name: Vertical XL2 mountain bikes
recalls.hazard: The front suspension forks on these bikes might not have been welded properly, and can break apart during use, resulting in serious injury to the rider.
recalls.remedy: Stop riding these bikes immediately and take them to the Target store where purchased, for a choice of a free replacement fork or a free replacement bike.
recalls.description: The recall involves "Vertical XL2" mountain bikes with chrome-colored frames. The model name is written on the bike frame in yellow and black lettering. A label affixed to the frame near the crank reads "Model No.
recalls.injuries: Dynacraft has received eight reports of injury to riders when the front forks on these bikes broke apart.

recalls.title: CPSC, Vermont Teddy Bear Co.® and Zany Brainy, Inc.® Announce Recall of Skateboard Keychains Sold With Teddy Bears
recalls.name: Miniature skateboard keychains attached to Z.Z. Jamboarder teddy bears
recalls.hazard: The skateboards' wheels can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should take these skateboard keychains away from young children immediately, and return them to any Zany Brainy® store to receive a Zooolennium bean-filled plush baby animal toy. Consumers also can return the teddy bear and skateboard keychain set to receive a refund.
recalls.description: The skateboard keychain is about 3.75 inches long with red wheels. Z.Z. Jamboarder is a light brown teddy bear, about 15 inches long and wears a white shirt, jeans, a purple hat and sunglasses.
recalls.injuries: The firms are aware of two reports of wheels coming off these skateboards, but no injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Huffy Bicycle Co. Announce Recall of Men's Mountain Bicycles
recalls.name: Huffy ALX 1000 bicycles (model no. 26809); ALX 1500 bicycles (model no. 26849), and Aluminum 300 bicycles (model no. K6809)
recalls.hazard: The frames of these bicycles can break apart, causing falls and serious injuries to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles, and call Huffy for information on receiving a free replacement bicycle.
recalls.description: The recall involves ALX 1000 bicycles with model number 26809, which are silver and blue; ALX 1500 bicycles with model number 26849, which are silver and green; and Aluminum 300 bicycles with model number K6809, which are silver and black.
recalls.injuries: Huffy has received two reports of the bicycle frames breaking, resulting in serious head and back injuries, as well as abrasions and contusions to riders.

recalls.title: CPSC, Royce Union Bicycles Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Men's Mountain Bicycles
recalls.name: Royce Union ABT 2000 Mountain Bicycles (model no. 16368)
recalls.hazard: The frames of these bikes can break apart, causing falls and serious injuries to riders.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles, and call Royce Union for information on receiving a free replacement bicycle.
recalls.description: The recall involves ABT 2000 bikes with model number 16368. The model number is located on the bottom of the frame near the crank and pedals. The 26-inch bicycles are silver and red and have "Aluminum 2000" written on the top tube.
recalls.injuries: Royce Union has received four reports of the bicycle frames breaking resulting in serious head and back injuries, as well as abrasions and contusions to riders.

recalls.title: CPSC & Dynacraft Industries Recall Mountain Bikes
recalls.name: Magna "Great Divide" mountain bikes
recalls.hazard: These bikes could have defective handlebar stems, which will not tighten sufficiently to lock onto the bicycles. This can cause the front wheel not to turn properly, resulting in serious injuries to the rider, from falls.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bikes immediately and take them to the Fred Meyer Store where purchased, for a free inspection and repair, if needed.
recalls.description: The recalled 21-speed mountain bikes, sold in the 24-inch size for girls and boys, and the 26-inch size for women and men. The bikes have a model number on the left side of the seat post. The girls' bikes have model number 8504-50 and are purple.
recalls.injuries: Dynacraft Industries is not aware of any injuries or incidents involving these bicycles. This recall is being conducted to prevent the possibility of injuries.

recalls.title: CPSC, JumpSport Recalls Trampoline Safety Net Enclosures
recalls.name: Trampoline safety net enclosures
recalls.hazard: The straps on the bottom of the net can break. Children can fall out under the net and off the trampoline and be injured.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the safety nets immediately and contact JumpSport. JumpSport will send consumers free replacement bottom straps.
recalls.description: The safety net enclosures are sold separately to be attached to trampolines that measure 10 to 14 feet in diameter. The net enclosure extends 6 feet above the trampoline, caging the jumpers.
recalls.injuries: JumpSport has received two reports of children falling off the trampoline when the straps on the bottom of the enclosure broke. No injuries have been reported.

recalls.title: CPSC, Manufacturers Announce Recall to Replace Toy and Youth Basketball Nets
recalls.name: Nets of Toy Basketball Sets
recalls.hazard: Children could strangle on loops or openings in nets that come unhooked from the rim or have knots that slide. If children put their heads into these openings, the net can get tangled around their necks.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should remove and throw away nets that can unhook or have knots that slide. Manufacturers will send consumers new nets that securely attach to the rim and do not have sliding knots. The basketball set can be used without a net until the new net arrives. Consumers should not return the product to stores.
recalls.description: The basketball sets with nets that need to be replaced come in a variety of colors and include a nylon net and plastic or metal hoop attached to a plastic, youth-sized pole. The pole is set in a plastic base and adjusts from 3 to 6 feet high.
recalls.injuries: Franklin Sports has received one report of a 3-year-old boy getting his head and neck caught in a basketball net.
